Result: CrossTimeEdit在三项编辑准则上总体性能较预训练基线提升17.12%，并在场景一致性、视觉真实性与感知质量方面优于跨视角生成模型。代码、数据集与模型权重已开源于 https://luhanwen67.github.io/CrossTimeEdit-release/。

Conclusion: 该工作通过数据集与“生成即编辑”的建模框架，结合多奖励在线强化学习，有效缓解历史街景数据稀疏问题，实现结构变化恢复与持久内容保持的统一，为跨时序城市街景生成提供了可复现的基准与模型。

Abstract: Historical street-view imagery records urban evolution, but uneven coverage leaves substantial gaps in historical records. Generating plausible past appearances requires restoring changed structures while preserving persistent scene content. We construct VIGOR-his, a decade-spanning cross-view dataset containing 43,653 location-level quadruplets across 11 cities on three continents. Its automated pipeline performs spatial pairing, consistency screening, change classification, and the generation and validation of satellite-based change descriptions and local editing instructions. Based on VIGOR-his, we propose CrossTimeEdit, a model that reformulates historical street-view generation as editing, using recent street views to constrain viewpoint and unchanged appearance and temporal satellite differences as change evidence. Starting from FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B, we train CrossTimeEdit through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by online reinforcement learning (RL). We design three street-view editing criteria, namely Instruction Alignment (IA), Background Preservation (BP), and Quality and Physical Plausibility (QP), as both RL reward dimensions and evaluation metrics. We optimize this multi-reward objective using Within Group Relative Policy Optimization for flow-matching models (Flow-GRPO) with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO), which normalizes each reward dimension before aggregation. CrossTimeEdit improves overall performance across the three editing criteria by 17.12\% over the pretrained baseline and outperforms cross-view generation models in scene consistency, visual realism, and perceptual quality. The implementation code, dataset, and model weights are available at https://luhanwen67.github.io/CrossTimeEdit-release/.

</details>


### [50] [Beyond Binary Preferences: Graded Preference Optimization for Limb-Motion Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36628)
*Yanan Wang,Tingsong Li,Kaixun Jiang,Chongyang Zhong,Chenwei Xoe,Zhaohe Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出FlexBench基准与GPA评分体系，并设计GM-DPO偏好优化方法，在细粒度人物-肢体动作描述上显著降低幻觉、提升准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate rich video captions, yet often misidentify which person performs an action or which limb is involved, particularly across camera cuts. Improving these details requires evaluation and training that distinguish missing information from incorrect assertions. We introduce FlexBench, a benchmark spanning 3,105 shots and 18,161 evaluation queries, with human-verified identities and systematic per-person coverage of fine-grained limb actions and states. Its reference-derived checklists support automated assessment of complete captions in their person and shot contexts. Our Graded Physical Alignment score (GPA) awards credit for correct content and deducts points for incorrect or fabricated actions, making these errors explicit in the aggregate score. Building on this rubric, we propose Graded Margin Direct Preference Optimization (GM-DPO), which assigns stronger preference margins and greater training weight to more severe action errors. Across three VLM backbones, GM-DPO achieves the highest substantive-action and GPA scores among the evaluated preference objectives, improving GPA over DPO by 2.02-3.40 points. On Qwen3-8B, it reduces the weighted hallucination rate by 21.3% relative to DPO. These gains accompany sustained long-form output, improved shot structure, and competitive performance on three additional multimodal benchmarks.

</details>


### [51] [OCA: ODE-Driven Cross-Attention for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36644)
*Pei An,Jiaqi Yang,Yulong Wang,Siwen Quan,Liangliang Nan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对图像到点云配准中的注意力歧义问题，提出基于常微分方程（ODE）建模的ODE驱动交叉注意力模块（OCA），可无缝嵌入现有框架，并在多个基准上显著提升配准召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像到点云（I2P）配准中的交叉注意力虽已取得进展，但“注意力歧义”仍是阻碍学习判别性2D-3D对应关系的根本挑战。作者希望从特征交互的理想建模出发，重新审视交叉注意力以缓解该问题。

Method: 作者将理想的I2P特征交互建模为常微分方程（ODE），据此设计ODE驱动的交叉注意力（OCA）模块，通过ODE对特征表示与注意力矩阵进行迭代式精炼；该模块具有通用性，可无缝集成到现有I2P配准框架中。为了验证有效性，作者把OCA嵌入五种先进基线，并在四个公开基准数据集上进行评估。

Result: 实验表明OCA能够提升配准召回率，在标准（standard）、微调（fine-tuning）与零样本（zero-shot）三种设置下分别最高提升5%、9%和15%。

Conclusion: 通过ODE建模交叉注意力并迭代精炼特征与注意力矩阵，OCA有效缓解注意力歧义，作为通用模块可稳定提升多类I2P配准基线的性能，显示其良好的泛化性与实用价值。

Abstract: Cross-attention is a crucial component in learning-based image-to-point-cloud (I2P) registration. Although existing cross-attention mechanisms have achieved promising progress, attention ambiguity remains a fundamental challenge that hinders the learning of discriminative 2D-3D correspondences. To address this problem, we revisit cross-attention and establish ordinary differential equations (ODEs) to model the ideal I2P feature interaction. Based on this formulation, we develop an ODE-driven cross-attention (OCA) module that refines feature representations and attention matrices through ODEs. In practice, OCA can be seamlessly integrated into existing I2P registration frameworks. To validate its effectiveness, we incorporate OCA into five state-of-the-art baselines and evaluate on four public benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that OCA improves registration recall by up to 5\%, 9\%, and 15\% under the standard, fine-tuning, and zero-shot settings, respectively.

</details>


### [52] [VLM4Cluster: Benchmarking Deep Clustering In the Era of Vision-Language Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36648)
*Yuanwei Hu,Bo Peng,Yuheng Jia,Xinting Hu,Yadan Luo,Wenjie Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VLM4Cluster基准，系统评测语言辅助图像聚类（LaIC）相对于经典与深度图像聚类方法的真实进展，涵盖17种方法、20个数据集及效果、鲁棒性、泛化与效率四个维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LaIC方法快速涌现，但已有研究因实验设置不一致、数据集选择不足、评测维度单一，难以判断其真实进展。

Method: 构建VLM4Cluster基准：集成17种代表性方法（经典、深度、语言辅助），在20个数据集（经典、挑战性、细粒度、大规模、分布外）上评测，并系统分析对抗鲁棒性、分布漂移泛化与计算效率。

Result: LaIC在语义要求高的基准上显著推进聚类性能边界，在分布漂移下泛化更强，并具有更优的效果—效率权衡；但在大规模和细粒度数据集上收益不稳定，且语言辅助并未系统性降低对抗扰动敏感性。

Conclusion: VLM4Cluster提供了VLM时代图像聚类的统一评测框架，揭示了LaIC的优势与局限，代码已开源。

Abstract: Vision-language pre-training has reshaped image clustering, giving rise to language-assisted image clustering (LaIC), which leverages textual semantics to complement visual representations. Despite the rapid proliferation of LaIC methods, it remains unclear how much LaIC has actually advanced image clustering, as existing studies generally suffer from major limitations, including inconsistent experimental settings, inadequate dataset selection, and limited evaluation dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce VLM4Cluster, a comprehensive benchmark for image clustering in the era of pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs). VLM4Cluster implements 17 representative methods spanning classical, deep, and language-assisted image clustering, and evaluates them on 20 datasets covering classical, challenging, fine-grained, large-scale, and out-of-distribution settings. Beyond effectiveness, VLM4Cluster systematically investigates image clustering along three complementary dimensions: robustness to adversarial perturbations, generalization under distribution shifts, and computational efficiency. Our study shows that LaIC substantially advances the clustering performance frontier on many semantically demanding benchmarks, generally exhibits stronger generalization under distribution shifts, and achieves a more favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off. However, its gains become less consistent on large-scale and fine-grained datasets, while language assistance does not systematically reduce sensitivity to adversarial perturbations. VLM4Cluster is released at https://github.com/YuanweiHuu/VLM4Cluster.

</details>


### [53] [FocusVTC: Efficient and High-Performance Visual Text Compression with Adaptive Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36651)
*FangZhi Zhong,Xuerui Qiu,Yuqi Pan,Ya Liu,Shaowei Gu,Bo Xu,Guoqi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FocusVTC通过自适应分辨率打破视觉文本压缩中"低DPI省token但难辨认、高DPI辨认但浪费token"的权衡，在压缩率与性能上同时超越基线，并保持通用多模态能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理带来巨大计算与内存开销。视觉文本压缩（VTC）虽能缩短输入长度，但固定分辨率渲染存在压缩—性能权衡：低DPI节省token却损失可读性，高DPI则为无关内容消耗token。作者希望打破这一权衡。

Method: 提出FocusVTC：融合低DPI压缩全局视图与选择性区域增强，并将增强视图融入持续推理。构建29.4K高质量"推理—证据定位"（REL）思维链数据（REL-CoT），将推理轨迹与页索引和边界框关联；通过多分辨率REL监督微调（REL-SFT）让模型学会定位相关区域，再用组相对策略优化（GRPO）学习何时增强分辨率以及如何利用增强后的观测，且无需单独的持续预训练阶段。

Result: 在RULER v1上以72 DPI、含工具观测的2.9倍输入压缩率下得分87.4，而Glyph在3.0倍压缩下仅57.5；在LongBench上超过其文本输入骨干（56.40 vs 55.86）；MRCR宏平均提升13.91分；VTCBench宏平均达51.19。MRCR延迟评估显示相对纯文本有2.79倍在线端到端加速。通用多模态能力保持：MMMU从65.12升至66.73，MME从2424.02升至2457.62。

Conclusion: FocusVTC通过自适应分辨率与强化学习驱动的区域增强，在保持通用多模态能力的同时，显著提升压缩效率与长上下文推理性能，并能实现明显的推理加速。

Abstract: Long-context reasoning in large language models incurs substantial computation and memory costs. Visual text compression (VTC) reduces input length by rendering text as images, but fixed-resolution rendering creates a compression-performance trade-off: low DPI saves tokens at the expense of legibility, whereas high DPI spends tokens on irrelevant content. We introduce FocusVTC, which breaks this trade-off through adaptive resolution while preserving general multimodal capabilities. It combines compressed low-DPI global views with selective region enhancement, integrating enhanced views into ongoing reasoning. We construct 29.4K high-quality Reasoning-Evidence Localization (REL) chain-of-thought examples (REL-CoT) that link reasoning traces to page indices and bounding boxes. Multi-resolution REL supervised fine-tuning (REL-SFT) teaches the model to localize relevant regions, and Group Relative Policy Optimization learns when to enhance resolution and how to use the resulting observations, without a separate continual-pretraining stage. At 72 DPI on RULER v1, FocusVTC scores 87.4 at $2.9\times$ input compression, including tool observations, versus 57.5 for Glyph at $3.0\times$ input compression. It surpasses its text-input backbone on LongBench (56.40 versus 55.86), improves the MRCR macro-average by 13.91 points, and achieves a 51.19 macro-average on VTCBench. The MRCR latency evaluation also shows a $2.79\times$ online end-to-end speedup over Text. General multimodal capabilities are preserved, with MMMU increasing from 65.12 to 66.73 and MME from 2424.02 to 2457.62.

</details>


### [54] [Not Every Correction Helps: Gain-Guided Continual Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36655)
*Youjia Zhang,Huiling Liu,Soyun Choi,Jaehong Yoon,Sungeun Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GAIN框架：用"历史提议、增益决定"原则实现免反向传播的持续测试时自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CTTA方法用置信度或熵评估预测可靠性，仅反映模型对当前样本的自确定性；而累积的目标观测虽可提供互补证据，却会随目标分布漂移而失配。核心问题不在于修正量与源预测差异多大，而在于是否以及以多大强度施加该修正。

Method: GAIN维护紧凑的目标统计量以形成修正提议，并构建考虑估计不确定性的后验预测评估器，据此估计源相对增益，沿连续路径通过高效一维优化确定样本级干预强度。增益受控的预测在线更新目标统计量，抑制不可靠修正的传播；全程无需反向传播、样本存储或回放。

Result: 在五个基准上取得强预测性能，在持续自适应中兼具精度—校准—效率的良好权衡。例如在ImageNet-C上达到61.9%精度且校准接近源模型，在多样且困难的持续漂移下保持稳定，运行速度比代表性优化型CTTA基线快15.9倍。

Conclusion: 以增益感知干预替代单纯的可靠性度量，可有效调控历史信息的应用强度，实现免反向传播、无需回放的稳定持续测试时自适应。

Abstract: Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) adapts a source model to an unlabeled test stream whose distribution may change over time. Existing TTA methods often assess prediction reliability using confidence or entropy, which primarily reflect the model's self-certainty for the current sample. In CTTA, accumulated target observations can provide complementary evidence for correcting the source prediction, but this history may become misaligned as the target distribution changes. The key question is therefore not how much the correction differs from the source prediction, but whether and how strongly it should be applied. This paper proposes Gain-Aware INtervention (GAIN), a backpropagation-free CTTA framework guided by a simple principle: history proposes, gain decides. GAIN maintains compact target statistics to form a correction proposal and a posterior-predictive evaluator that accounts for estimation uncertainty. The resulting source-relative gain estimates the proposal's benefit and determines a sample-specific intervention strength along a continuous path through efficient one-dimensional optimization. Gain-controlled predictions then update the target statistics online, limiting the propagation of unreliable corrections, all without backpropagation, sample storage, or replay. Across five benchmarks, our method achieves strong predictive performance, with favorable accuracy--calibration--efficiency trade-offs in continual adaptation. On ImageNet-C, for example, GAIN achieves 61.9% accuracy with near-source calibration. It remains stable under diverse and challenging continual shifts while running 15.9x faster than a representative optimization-based CTTA baseline.

</details>


### [55] [You Only Reprogram Once: Rethinking Prolonged Training for Visual Reprogramming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36661)
*Zizhao Li,Mohammed Yaqoob Ansari,Xinyu Su,Jiayang Ao,Joseph West,Kourosh Khoshelham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: YORO提出在冻结模型的响应空间上做一次前向遍历即构建下游预测器，无需反向传播与重复访问训练集；当需要输入适配时可选YORO-FP微调视觉提示仅20个epoch。该方法在三个全数据设置上较最强无梯度映射提升18.4–24.4%，并在16-shot CLIP上将四主干平均准确率从71.4%提升至77.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉重编程（visual reprogramming）是一种参数高效地适配预训练模型的方法，但其训练成本仍较高：即便主干冻结，视觉提示通常仍需通过完整模型优化数百个epoch。作者质疑：在改变预训练模型"看到什么"之前，是否已充分利用它"已经告诉我们什么"。其动机是发现对完整源响应的建模本身就能产生较强的下游预测，而无需提示优化，因此希望避免昂贵的提示优化过程。

Method: 提出You Only Reprogram Once（YORO），在冻结的响应空间中以单次仅前向（forward-only）遍历构建下游预测器。其核心为贝叶斯判别映射（Bayesian Discriminant Mapping, BDM），基于流式（streaming）类统计量推导出协方差感知的仿射映射，不需要反向传播、优化器更新或重复访问训练集。当输入适配仍有帮助时，YORO-FP可选地对视觉提示进行20个epoch的精调。BDM还可自然扩展至CLIP：将属性-提示相似度视为源响应。

Result: 在三个全数据（full-data）设置中，YORO相较最强的先验无梯度映射（gradient-free mapping）平均准确率提升18.4–24.4%。在16-shot CLIP上，将四种主干（four-backbone）的平均准确率从71.4%提升至77.2%。YORO-FP在部分任务上带来进一步提升，而验证（validation）常常仍保留单次遍历（one-pass）预测器。

Conclusion: 结果表明视觉重编程应确立一种不同的默认范式：先读出冻结的响应，仅在有需要时才优化输入。YORO以单次前向遍历即可获得强预测，避免了昂贵的提示优化；YORO-FP则在确有增益时提供可选的轻量精调。

Abstract: Visual reprogramming is a parameter-efficient method for adapting pretrained models, yet its training can remain computationally expensive: even with a frozen backbone, visual prompts are often optimized through the full model for hundreds of epochs. Before changing what the pretrained model sees, we ask whether we are fully using what it already tells us. We find that modeling the full source response can already yield strong downstream predictions without prompt optimization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce You Only Reprogram Once (YORO), which constructs a downstream predictor from the frozen response space in a single forward-only traversal. Its Bayesian Discriminant Mapping (BDM) derives a covariance-aware affine mapping from streaming class statistics, requiring no backpropagation, optimizer updates, or repeated visits to the training set. When further input adaptation helps, YORO-FP optionally refines the visual prompt for 20 epochs. BDM also extends naturally to CLIP by treating attribute-prompt similarities as source responses. Across three full-data settings, YORO improves average accuracy over the strongest prior gradient-free mapping by 18.4--24.4\%. On 16-shot CLIP, it raises the four-backbone average from 71.4\% to 77.2\%. YORO-FP provides further gains on selected tasks, while validation often retains the one-pass predictor. These results suggest a different default for visual reprogramming: read out the frozen response first, and optimize the input only when needed.

</details>


### [56] [ReWorld-Track: A Recursive Event World Model for Language-Guided Multi-Camera Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36677)
*Haoyang Wu,Shoudong Han,Chaoyue Li,Sijia Chen,Zhenyang Xie,Wang sihan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ReWorld-Track，一种递归事件世界模型，将关联不确定性纳入未来预测，跨未观测间隙保持目标身份，在 CityFlowV2 与 MTMMC 上取得 HOTA 65.19 和 45.36。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言引导的多摄像头跟踪需在目标未被观测的间隙中保持身份，而相似候选与不确定回归易导致早期关联不可靠。一次错误匹配会污染用于预测后续观测的历史，并在后续摄像头交接中传播身份错误。

Method: 将候选匹配与继续等待定义为目标的替代状态，用其后验概率更新持续循环信念，从而在连续观测中保留替代轨迹的不确定性；该信念预测下一摄像头、到达时间与进入区域，并以外观与语言证据引导关联；通过在连续交接上训练，学习保留对后续预测与身份决策有用的不确定性。

Result: 在 CityFlowV2 上 HOTA 达 65.19，MTMMC 上达 45.36，多次交接下的身份连续性提升。MTMMC 上结构化后验更新较同规模通用更新器高 0.50 HOTA，较固定时刻软关联高 0.94 HOTA；下一摄像头准确率由 86.03% 提升至 87.41%，后续目标回归的到达时间中位误差由 0.78 s 降至 0.71 s。

Conclusion: 显式建模并保留关联不确定性可有效抑制身份误差传播，提升跨摄像头交接的身份连续性与预测精度。

Abstract: Language-guided multi-camera tracking must preserve a target identity across unobserved gaps, where similar candidates and uncertain returns can make early associations unreliable. A wrong match can corrupt the history used to predict later observations and propagate identity errors across subsequent camera handoffs. We propose ReWorld-Track, a recursive event world model that carries association uncertainty into future predictions. Candidate matches and continued waiting define alternative target states, whose posterior probabilities are used to update a persistent recurrent belief. This representation preserves uncertainty about alternative trajectories through successive observations. This belief predicts the next camera, arrival time, and entry region, while appearance and language evidence guide association. By training across successive handoffs, the model learns to retain uncertainty that remains useful for later predictions and identity decisions. ReWorld-Track achieves HOTA scores of 65.19 on CityFlowV2 and 45.36 on MTMMC, with improved identity continuity across repeated handoffs. On MTMMC, its structured posterior update gains 0.50 HOTA points over a similarly sized generic updater and 0.94 points over fixed-moment soft association, raising next-camera accuracy from 86.03% to 87.41% and reducing median arrival-time error from 0.78 s to 0.71 s for subsequent target returns.

</details>


### [57] [Reprogramming Vision-Language Models via Structured Prompt Reparameterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36680)
*Zizhao Li,Chengyi Cai,Mohammed Yaqoob Ansari,Feng Liu,Joseph West,Kourosh Khoshelham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RVP框架，通过类内多提示聚合与类间残差校正，并以结构化重参数化将CLIP视觉重编程建模为冻结图像嵌入到下游logits的线性映射，仅用单个视觉提示且在推理时可重参数化为线性分类器，几乎无额外开销，在11个基准、4个CLIP骨干上一致优于既有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉重编程方法主要依赖类内提示聚合，未显式建模类间关系；而细粒度类别在文本嵌入空间中属性描述高度重叠、类间相关性强，判别线索存在于低方差细微分量中，因此需要跨类建模与结构化校正。

Method: RVP在每个类内聚合多个文本提示，并施加跨类残差校正；理论上证明基于CLIP、具有输入无关线性输出聚合的视觉重编程可表示为从冻结图像嵌入到下游logits的线性映射，据此设计结构化重参数化，同时建模共享语义分量与类特有差异；仅使用单个视觉提示，推理时可重参数化为冻结骨干加线性分类器。

Result: 在11个少样本分类基准和4种CLIP骨干上，RVP一致优于先前的视觉重编程方法，且推理效率相当或更优。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模类间关系并与结构化重参数化结合，RVP在保持骨干冻结与近乎零额外计算开销的前提下提升了细粒度少样本分类性能，为视觉重编程提供了一种兼顾效果与效率的框架。

Abstract: Visual reprogramming adapts pretrained models to downstream tasks by modifying their input and output interfaces while keeping the backbone fixed. In vision-language models, existing methods mainly rely on intra-class prompt aggregation and do not explicitly model relationships among classes. However, fine-grained categories often exhibit highly overlapping attribute descriptions and strong inter-class correlation in the text embedding space, where discriminative cues lie in subtle low-variance components. We propose Reparameterized Inter-Class Visual Reprogramming (RVP), a structured framework that aggregates multiple text prompts within each class and applies residual correction across classes. We also show that CLIP-based visual reprogramming with input-independent linear output aggregation can be expressed as a linear mapping from frozen image embeddings to downstream logits, and use this view to design a structured reparameterization that models shared semantic components and class-specific differences. RVP uses only a single visual prompt and can be reparameterized at inference into a frozen backbone followed by a linear classifier, incurring nearly zero computational overhead. Across 11 few-shot classification benchmarks and four CLIP backbones, RVP consistently improves over prior visual reprogramming methods with comparable or better inference efficiency.

</details>


### [58] [When Semantics Matter: Reliability-Aware Semantic-Rhythm Control for Co-Speech Gesture Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36685)
*Zhirui Xing,Long Ye,Kaige Li,Ziyi Xu,Ming Meng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可靠性感知的语义-节奏控制框架，通过双分支语义贡献估计与噪声条件调制，实现语义表达、节奏同步、多样性与鲁棒性的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有协同语音手势生成方法虽能产生节奏合理的动作，但过度依赖声学韵律、对文本语义利用不足，尤其在语义标注不完整、含噪或缺失时，生成的手势仅跟随语音节奏而无法表达预期语义。

Method: 1) 学习离散运动先验，将连续手势表征为紧凑结构化的运动码空间；2) 设计双分支语义贡献估计机制（全多模态分支与纯音频分支），以分布差异作为条件信息增益，量化文本语义对预测动作的改变程度；3) 基于该估计构建可控语义-节奏目标，在内容相关片段强化语义引导、在节奏主导片段限制语义干预；4) 将背景噪声视为声学可靠性条件，引入噪声条件特征调制与有益潜在扰动以提升真实声环境下的鲁棒性。

Result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，该框架在语义表达力、节奏同步、运动多样性与鲁棒性之间取得良好平衡，实现了可靠且可控的协同语音手势生成。

Conclusion: 通过可靠性感知的语义-节奏控制与噪声条件建模，可有效缓解语义利用不足与声学噪声干扰问题，为协同语音手势生成提供可靠、可控的解决方案。

Abstract: Co-speech gesture generation aims to synthesize natural gestures that are both temporally synchronized with speech and semantically consistent with the spoken content. Although recent methods can generate rhythmically plausible motions, they often rely heavily on acoustic prosody while underutilizing textual semantics, especially when semantic annotations are incomplete, noisy, or unavailable. Consequently, the generated gestures may follow speech rhythm while failing to express the intended semantics. To address this problem, we propose a reliability-aware semantic-rhythm control framework for co-speech gesture generation. We first learn a discrete motion prior that represents continuous gestures in a compact and structured motion-code space. We then introduce a dual-branch semantic contribution estimation mechanism consisting of a full multimodal branch and an audio-only branch. Their distributional discrepancy is formulated as conditional information gain to quantify how much textual semantics changes the predicted motion. Based on this estimate, a controllable semantic-rhythm objective selectively strengthens semantic guidance in content-relevant segments while limiting unnecessary semantic intervention in rhythm-dominant segments. Furthermore, we treat background noise as an acoustic reliability condition and introduce noise-conditioned feature modulation together with beneficial latent perturbation to improve generation robustness under realistic acoustic environments. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a favorable balance among semantic expressiveness, rhythmic synchronization, motion diversity, and robustness, enabling reliable and controllable co-speech gesture generation.

</details>


### [59] [AESplat: Advancing Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Decoupled Appearance Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36693)
*Shiwei Ren,Zhiang Liu,Yongchun Fang,Hongwei Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AESplat 提出一种面向无位姿前馈 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）的解耦外观建模框架，将零阶 SH 系数（视图无关外观）直接从输入图像解析获得，高阶 SH 系数（视图相关外观）由带 3D 感知归纳偏置的浅层 MLP 预测，从而提升渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无位姿前馈 3DGS 方法通常以相同方式预测由球谐函数（SH）表示的高斯外观属性，忽略了视图无关与视图相关外观的本质区别，导致渲染质量次优。作者基于对 SH 的分析，认为应将两类外观成分解耦建模。

Method: AESplat 采用解耦外观建模策略：零阶 SH 系数表示视图无关的基础外观分量，直接由输入图像推导得到而不需训练；高阶 SH 系数由浅层多层感知机进行预测，并引入两种高效的 3D 感知归纳偏置以建模视图相关的外观变化。

Result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进方法。在 RealEstate10K 数据集上，相较无位姿方法 NAS3R 提升 0.8 dB PSNR，相需要位姿的方法 DepthSplat 提升 1.1 dB PSNR。

Conclusion: AESplat 是一个通用且有效的无位姿前馈 3DGS 框架，通过基于 SH 分析的解耦外观建模，兼顾视图无关与视图相关外观特征，实现了更高质量的渲染，并可适用于多种数据集场景。项目主页：https://aesplat.github.io/。

Abstract: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable potential for generalized novel view synthesis. However, existing methods typically predict Gaussian appearance attributes represented by spherical harmonics (SH) in the same manner, overlooking the fundamental distinction between view-independent and view-dependent appearance, which results in suboptimal rendering quality. In this paper, we present AESplat, a novel and general framework for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS that introduces an effective decoupled appearance modeling strategy based on an analysis of SH, enabling higher-quality rendering. Specifically, AESplat directly derives the zeroth-order SH coefficient, which represents the base view-independent appearance component, from the input images without training. The higher-order SH coefficients are subsequently predicted by a shallow multilayer perceptron equipped with two efficient 3D-aware inductive biases to model view-dependent appearance variations. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a $0.8$ dB improvement in PSNR over the pose-free method NAS3R and a $1.1$ dB improvement over the pose-required method DepthSplat on the RealEstate10K dataset. Project page: https://aesplat.github.io/.

</details>


### [60] [Drag as Evidence: Motion-Grounded Latent Recomposition for Drag-Based Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36755)
*Xinyu Pu,Hongsong Wang,Jie Gui,Pan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MoRe-Drag，将像素空间形变视为粗粒度运动证据并注入生成采样轨迹，实现高精度、意图对齐的拖拽式图像编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像编辑器擅长语义操作与视觉合成，但空间控制精度有限；已有拖拽式编辑方法难以兼顾拖拽准确性与自然、合理、意图对齐的生成效果。

Method: 以像素空间形变作为粗运动证据注入生成采样过程；对精修区、修复区与锚点区进行区域感知的隐空间重组；采用阶段自适应条件，由运动引导的结构构建逐步过渡到语义精修；并改造基于MLLM的文本编码器以支持免指令接口的拖拽感知指令推断。

Result: 在DragBench-SR与DragBench-DR上，相比强基线编辑器显著提升拖拽精度，在SOTA拖拽编辑方法中取得更优拖拽准确度，同时具备强语义一致性与视觉真实感。

Conclusion: MoRe-Drag通过运动证据引导的采样轨迹与区域感知重组，有效平衡拖拽精度与生成质量，并支持免指令交互，代码与数据集将公开。

Abstract: Modern image editors excel at semantic manipulation and visual synthesis, yet remain limited in precise spatial control, motivating the development of drag-based editing. However, existing drag-based methods often struggle to balance drag accuracy with natural, plausible, and intent-aligned generation. We propose MoRe-Drag, a motion-grounded drag-based editing method. Our key insight is to treat pixel-space warping as coarse motion evidence, and to inject this evidence into the generative sampling trajectory. Specifically, MoRe-Drag performs region-aware latent recomposition over refinement, inpainting, and anchor regions, coupled with stage-adaptive conditioning that progressively shifts from motion-grounded structure formation to semantic refinement. We further support an instruction-free interface by adapting the MLLM-based text encoder for drag-aware instruction inference. Experiments on DragBench-SR and DragBench-DR show that MoRe-Drag substantially improves drag precision over strong base editors and achieves superior drag accuracy among SOTA drag-based methods, while delivering strong semantic consistency and visually realistic results. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

</details>


### [61] [NesTok: Nested Self-Aligned 1D Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36756)
*Jiawei Zhang,Shuhao Liu,Rong Huang,Yuancheng Li,Zhihui Li,Xiaojun Chang,Changlin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出NesTok，一种面向动态视觉tokenizer的嵌套自对齐框架，通过跨长度训练提升可变长度tokenizer的重建与生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于嵌套dropout的一维可变长度视觉tokenizer未能充分利用tokenizer的表示能力，导致图像重建与生成性能次优。

Method: NesTok引入跨长度训练，在联合优化不同token长度下的重建时，用全长序列引导较短的序列，使短token序列逼近全长序列的重建质量。

Result: 在ImageNet上，NesTok显著优于标准训练，重建rFID达0.98；下游图像生成在ImageNet 256×256上取得现有可变长度自回归图像生成方法中最优的gFID 1.46。

Conclusion: NesTok通过嵌套自对齐有效释放可变长度视觉tokenizer的表示潜力，实现更优的压缩自适应重建与生成。

Abstract: One-dimensional (1D) variable-length visual tokenizers enable adaptive compression by varying the number of tokens, allowing downstream autoregressive (AR) models to flexibly trade off generation quality against computational cost using a single tokenizer. However, existing approaches based on nested dropout often fail to fully exploit the representational capacity of the tokenizer, resulting in suboptimal performance in both image reconstruction and generation. In this work, we introduce NesTok, a nested self-alignment framework tailored to dynamic visual tokenizers. NesTok introduces cross-length training, which jointly optimizes reconstruction across token lengths while using the full-length sequence to guide shorter counterparts, enabling shorter token sequences to approach the reconstruction quality of full-length sequences. On ImageNet, NesTok improves substantially over standard training and achieves an rFID score of 0.98. On downstream image generation, it achieves the state-of-the-art gFID score of 1.46 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 among existing variable-length autoregressive image generation methods. Code will be available at https://github.com/jaiwei804/NesTok.

</details>


### [62] [FastVR: Efficient Streaming Video Restoration with One-Step Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36757)
*Xiaoxu Chen,Qin Yang,Haoran Bai,Sibin Deng,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FastVR：基于一步扩散模型的流式视频修复框架，通过轻量VAE、分块因果注意力与训练正则化，在单张H20上以11 FPS处理1080p视频，达到SOTA质量与效率平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式视频修复能恢复真实细节，但实际部署受两大效率瓶颈制约：VAE编解码开销大，以及DiT中全自注意力的二次计算成本。

Method: 基于一步扩散模型的流式修复框架；推理侧采用轻量VAE与chunk-wise因果注意力降低计算量；训练侧引入速度一致性正则化（velocity consistency regularization）与连续轨迹学习（continuous trajectory learning）提升修复质量。

Result: 在单张H20 GPU上以11 FPS处理1080p视频；在合成与真实世界基准上达到SOTA性能，且效率优于所对比的扩散基线。

Conclusion: FastVR在保证强修复质量与时序一致性的同时显著提升效率，为扩散视频修复的实际部署提供可行方案，并期望推动社区后续研究。

Abstract: Diffusion-based video restoration recovers realistic details, but its practical deployment is limited by two efficiency bottlenecks: costly VAE encoding and decoding, and the quadratic cost of full self-attention in diffusion transformers (DiTs). This paper presents FastVR, a streaming video restoration framework built on a one-step diffusion model, which delivers strong restoration quality and temporal consistency while processing 1080p video at 11 FPS on a single H20 GPU. To improve inference efficiency, FastVR combines a lightweight VAE with chunk-wise causal attention, which substantially reduces the computational cost. During training, it further adopts velocity consistency regularization and continuous trajectory learning, which improve restoration quality. Extensive experiments show that FastVR is more efficient than the evaluated diffusion baselines while achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. We hope that this work supports further progress in the community.

</details>


### [63] [Dual-Mode Low-Rank Learner with Bridge-Prototype Ensemble for Vision-Language Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36759)
*Chiyuan He,Zihuan Qiu,Fanman Meng,Chao Wang,Liangjiang Chen,Linfeng Xu,Qingbo Wu,Hongliang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DuLBE方法，通过双模式低秩学习与桥原型集成分类器，解决无样本类增量学习中知识覆盖与可塑性受限问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于CLIP的类增量学习方法要么反复更新共享组件导致知识覆盖，要么过度隔离新任务更新，妨碍CLIP可迁移知识复用并限制可塑性；同时文本或双模态分类器设计未能有效整合视觉与文本的互补信息。

Method: DuLBE耦合双模式低秩学习与桥原型集成分类器。按梯度需求分配两种视觉低秩更新模式并用梯度路由协调：从历史占用的视觉方向中选择紧凑可重写的共享模式以复用可迁移知识，残差模式为任务特定变化提供低干扰通道；在稳定的模态间结构上，于单位超球面上构建视觉原型与文本嵌入的测地桥，并集成可靠桥原型以补偿文本决策边界的模态鸿沟。

Result: 多种设置下的广泛实验表明，DuLBE达到当前最优的类增量学习性能，同时保持低秩微调的高参数效率。

Conclusion: DuLBE在无样本类增量学习中兼顾可塑性与稳定性，兼具性能与参数效率优势。

Abstract: Benefiting from transferable visual-textual alignment, CLIP has been widely adopted for class-incremental learning (CIL). However, existing learners either repeatedly update components shared across tasks, leading to knowledge overwriting, or overly isolate new-task updates, hindering the reuse of CLIP's transferable knowledge and limiting plasticity. Moreover, the text-based or bimodal classifier designs still fail to effectively integrate complementary information from the visual and textual modalities. To address these challenges, we introduce DuLBE, which couples dual-mode low-rank learning with a bridge-prototype ensemble classifier for exemplar-free CIL. DuLBE allocates two visual low-rank update modes according to the gradient demand and uses gradient routing to coordinate them: a compact and rewritable shared mode is selected from historically occupied visual directions to reuse transferable knowledge, while residual modes provide low-interference channels for task-specific variations. Building on the resulting stable inter-modal structure, we further construct geodesic bridges between visual prototypes and text embeddings on the unit hypersphere, and ensemble reliable bridge prototypes to compensate for the modality-gap limitations of textual decision boundaries. Extensive experiments under multiple settings show that DuLBE achieves state-of-the-art CIL performance while retaining the high parameter efficiency of low-rank tuning.

</details>


### [64] [DSPO: Diversity-aware Subjective Policy Optimization for Robust Emotional Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36775)
*Cheng Ye,Weidong Chen,Bingyan Xu,Zhendong Mao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DSPO强化学习框架，通过分布对齐的情感多样性奖励与反事实视觉干预门控，同时提升MLLM情感推理的主观覆盖度与视觉 grounding，跨域准确率平均提升+10.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL算法在情感推理任务上存在严重失效：一是过度依赖确定性硬标签监督与逐点孤立评估，与人类情感主观、连续分布的本质存在根本性差距；二是情感状态隐含于视觉线索中，这种抽象性加剧了MLLM的视觉幻觉，产生看似合理却缺乏依据的情感证据。

Method: 1) 在VAD空间中，结合标注情感的词汇先验与图像特定上下文信息，构建上下文锚定的情感分布先验；2) 提出分布对齐情感多样性奖励（DEDR），以留一法边际贡献衡量每个候选情感在rollout中的作用，奖励那些使预测情感集合更接近先验的候选；3) 提出反事实视觉干预门控（CVIG），遮蔽推理过程中高亮的视觉区域，依据候选概率变化降低缺乏视觉证据支持的解读权重。

Result: 在多个公开基准上取得SOTA性能，跨域性能提升尤为显著，平均跨域准确率较EMO-R3提升+10.8%。

Conclusion: DSPO通过联合建模主观情感覆盖与视觉grounding，缓解了硬标签监督与视觉幻觉问题，验证了分布先验与反事实视觉干预在情感推理RL中的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning has significantly advanced the complex reasoning capabilities of MLLMs. However, prevailing RL algorithms suffer a severe failure in emotion reasoning tasks. These methods heavily rely on deterministic hard-label supervision and point-wise isolated evaluation, creating a fundamental gap with the inherently subjective and continuously distributed nature of human emotions. Furthermore, unlike explicit physical objects, emotional states are deeply implicit within visual cues. This abstract nature exacerbates visual hallucinations in MLLMs, leading to plausible yet ungrounded emotional evidence. To address these limitations, we propose Diversity-Aware Subjective Policy Optimization (DSPO), a reinforcement learning framework that jointly promotes subjective affective coverage and visual grounding. First, we construct a context-grounded emotional distribution prior in the VAD space by combining the lexical prior of the annotated emotion with image-specific contextual information. Based on this prior, we introduce a Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward (DEDR), which measures the leave-one-out marginal contribution of each candidate emotion within a rollout. DEDR rewards candidates whose inclusion brings the predicted affective set closer to the context-grounded prior, thereby preserving plausible subjective interpretations without encouraging unconstrained dispersion. We further develop Counterfactual Visual Intervention Gating (CVIG), which masks the visual region highlighted in the reasoning process and uses the resulting candidate-wise probability changes to reduce the weights of interpretations unsupported by visual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple public benchmarks, especially on the cross-domain performance, i.e., improving +10.8\% on average cross-domain accuracy than EMO-R3.

</details>


### [65] [Causal-EVC: Breaking Emotional Spurious Causality via Spatiotemporal Grounding and Counterfactual Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36776)
*Cheng Ye,Weidong Chen,Peipei Song,Zhendong Mao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对情感视频描述中视觉因果被简单注意力匹配导致的因果冗余与虚假相关问题，构建了带密集时空因果标注的基准EVC-CauseGround（含因果忠实子集），并提出Causal-EVC框架，通过运动引导因果时空定位、可解释稀疏情感路由及反事实对比目标，使情感预测锚定真实因果触发，在语义指标与因果忠实子集上均取得最佳表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有情感视频描述方法虽已重视视觉因果对情感感知与描述的引导作用，但基本依赖简单的注意力匹配，难以避免共现偏差引发的因果冗余与虚假相关（如把阳光沙滩误判为"快乐"），导致模型从混淆背景中进行严重的捷径学习；同时现有评测无法验证模型是否真正掌握因果推理，还是仅利用了背景混淆因子。

Method: 一是构建EVC-CauseGround基准，提供密集的时空因果标注，并引入精选的Causal-Faithfulness Subset以显式量化真实的情感-因果归因；二是提出Causal-EVC情感接地描述框架，包含Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization模块，将因果触发因素从背景混淆因子中精确解耦，以及Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing模块，通过合成反事实表征并设计新的反事实对比目标，迫使模型将情感预测严格锚定在真实因果触发上。

Result: 大量实验表明，Causal-EVC不仅在语义指标上取得最佳性能，而且在因果忠实子集上表现出显著优势。

Conclusion: 该模型能够从真实视觉因果中挖掘情感线索，缓解共现偏差，实现可解释的多模态情感理解。

Abstract: Emotional Video Captioning aims to generate factually accurate and emotionally empathetic descriptions. While recent methods have recognized the importance of visual causes to guide emotion perception and caption generation, they fundamentally rely on simple attention matching, which inevitably suffers from {causal redundancy and spurious correlations} in co-occurrence bias (e.g., misclassifying ``sadness'' as ``joy'' on a sunny beach), leading to severe shortcut learning from confusing backgrounds. Furthermore, existing evaluations fail to verify whether models have genuinely mastered causal reasoning or merely exploited background confounders. To address these limitations, we first construct {EVC-CauseGround}, a comprehensive benchmark with dense spatio-temporal causal annotations. Crucially, it introduces a carefully selected {Causal-Faithfulness Subset} to explicitly quantify genuine emotion-cause attribution. Second, we propose {Causal-EVC}, an emotion-grounding captioning framework, which introduces a Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization module to precisely decouple causal triggers from background confounders. Besides, we introduce an Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing module. By synthesizing counterfactual representations and formulating a novel counterfactual contrastive objective, we enforce the model to anchor its emotion predictions strictly on authentic causal triggers instead of confusing background. Extensive experiments show that Causal-EVC not only achieves the best performance on semantic metrics but also exhibits significant advantages in the causal-faithfulness subset, which demonstrates that our model could mine emotional cues from genuine visual causes and mitigate co-occurrence bias for interpretable multimodal emotion understanding.

</details>


### [66] [Decoding Affective Nuances: Enhancing MLLMs via Hierarchical Emotion Reasoning and Contrastive Discriminative Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36782)
*Cheng Ye,Weidong Chen,Zhaobo Qi,Beier Zhu,Zhendong Mao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练推理期优化框架 DAN，通过分层情感推理链与对比判别视觉剪枝，提升多模态大模型对细粒度相近情感的辨识能力，在 WebEmo25 上提升 10.47%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型在客观理解任务上表现优异，但情感推理远逊于人类。作者认为核心能力缺口在于：模型难以基于细粒度视觉证据可靠区分语义相近的情感，具体表现为两方面局限：1）归因不足，传统全局推理范式稀释了细粒度情感线索，细微情感常被隐式编码，导致复杂场景下误判；2）判别不足，现有方法只能定位与情感泛相关的区域，无法区分语义相似情感间的判别性区域，造成情感判断模糊。

Method: 提出免训练的推理期优化框架 Decoding Affective Nuances（DAN），包含两个模块：1）分层情感推理链（HERC），通过协调细粒度场景级与物体级线索并进行软门控推理，缓解归因不足问题；2）对比判别视觉剪枝（CDVP），通过计算相似情感注意力分布之间的绝对差异，隔离出判别性视觉 token 以推断最终情感类别，从而区分语义相近情感。

Result: 在多个基准上验证，DAN 在不消耗额外训练资源的前提下显著提升了对情感细微差别的判别能力，尤其在包含 25 个细粒度情感类别的 WebEmo25 数据集上，配合 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 取得 +10.47% 的提升。

Conclusion: DAN 作为一种免训练、推理期即插即用的优化框架，能够有效弥补 MLLM 在细粒度情感归因与相似情感判别上的能力缺口，显著增强情感细微差别的识别性能，且无需额外训练开销。

Abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in objective understanding tasks, their performance in affective reasoning still falls significantly short of human standards. We attribute it to a central capability gap: MLLMs are difficult to reliably distinguish semantically proximal emotions based on fine-grained visual evidence, which could be decoupled as two limitations: 1) Insufficient Attribution. The global reasoning paradigm of conventional MLLMs severely dilutes fine-grained emotion cues, where subtle emotional states are usually implicitly encoded, thereby generating emotional misjudgments in complex scenarios. 2) Insufficient Discrimination. Existing methods could only identify regions generally associated with emotions, which fails to distinguish discriminative regions between semantically similar emotions, leading to ambiguous emotion judgements. To overcome these limitations, we present a training-free inference-time optimization framework, named Decoding Affective Nuances (DAN). Specifically, we propose a Hierarchical Emotional Reasoning Chain (HERC) that enhances the insufficient attribution by harmonizing fine-grained scene/object-level cues and performing a soft-gated reasoning. Furthermore, to discriminate between semantically proximal emotions, we design a Contrastive Discriminative Visual Pruning (CDVP), which isolates discriminative visual tokens to reason the final emotion category by computing the absolute discrepancy between the attention distributions of similar emotions. Performances on several benchmarks demonstrate that DAN significantly improves discrimination for affective nuances without consuming additional training resources, especially achieving +10.47% improvements with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on WebEmo25 dataset that contains 25 fine-grained emotion categories.

</details>


### [67] [Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36798)
*Yueran Ma,Ronghao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文揭示全模态大模型中普遍存在跨模态捷径：回答音频问题时模型同等甚至更多依赖图像，并提出诊断方法（Factorized Modality Diagnostic）与修复方案DMC-Repair。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全模态大模型被期望根据问题明确指涉的模态来作答，但现有训练范式很少验证模型是否真正遵循该模态。原因在于同一样本的多模态输入常为同一答案提供冗余证据，掩盖了模型对问题所指模态的真实依赖，从而形成跨模态捷径。

Method: 提出Factorized Modality Diagnostic诊断方法，通过在样本间独立交换音频与图像来隔离各模态的因果贡献；基于诊断发现提出DMC-Repair，即在同类跨模态交换样本上训练模型，并依据问题所指模态分配监督信号，从而阻止模型利用同一片段内模态间的虚假对应关系。

Result: 在两个模型家族、不同设置下，跨模态捷径均贯穿监督微调与强化学习后训练，且基于评判的强化学习可能进一步放大对无关视觉信息的依赖。DMC-Repair使图像诱发的答案效应占比降低59.9%，且不损害音频问答性能；该效果在两个模型家族间泛化，并零样本泛化到未见数据集与未见基准，且在后继后训练中持续保持。

Conclusion: 全模态大模型存在普遍的跨模态捷径，模型在音频问题上过度依赖图像。通过交换样本并按问题模态施加监督的DMC-Repair能有效抑制该捷径，同时保持任务性能，且具有跨模型、跨数据与跨基准的泛化性与稳定性。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer a question using the modality it explicitly refers to. However, existing training paradigms rarely verify whether models actually follow this modality, because multimodal inputs from the same sample often provide redundant evidence for the same answer. In this work, we uncover a pervasive cross-modal shortcut in omni-modal LLMs: when asked an audio-related question, models rely on the image as much as on the audio, and sometimes even more. To systematically diagnose this behavior, we introduce the Factorized Modality Diagnostic, which independently swaps audio and images between samples to isolate each modality's causal contribution. Across two model families in different settings, we find that this shortcut persists throughout supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning post-training, while judge-based RL may further amplify such reliance on irrelevant visual information. Based on this finding, we propose DMC-Repair, which trains models on the same kind of cross-modal swapped samples while assigning supervision according to the modality specified by the question. This prevents models from exploiting the spurious correspondence between modalities within the same clip. Experiments demonstrate that DMC-Repair reduces the image-induced share of the answer effect by 59.9%, effectively suppressing the cross-modal shortcut without compromising audio-question answering performance. The reduction in shortcut reliance generalizes across two model families and zero-shot to an unseen dataset and an unseen benchmark, and persists through subsequent post-training. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DMC-Repair.

</details>


### [68] [Scene Retargeting: Learning Object Placement with Analogical Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36801)
*Minkwan Kim,Junho Kim,Seungmin Lee,Changwoon Choi,Young Min Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将"场景重定向"形式化为在布局间稳定迁移语义连贯的空间组织，提出基于簇的迁移与优化框架，在3D-FRONT上优于现有布局生成方法，并支持real-to-sim迁移等下游应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式仿真（具身AI、空间计算）需要支持日常活动的真实3D场景，但稀疏、不规则的布局结构带来场景特定的物理约束，难以定义可泛化的功能场景生成框架；已有方法依赖文本描述或成对关系，难以保持语义连贯的空间组织。

Method: 将Scene Retargeting形式化为跨布局稳定迁移语义连贯的空间组织；采用簇级（cluster-wise）迁移以灵活处理不匹配的物体实例并适应不同户型；通过优化保持各簇的丰富语义上下文，尊重基础特征的空间分布；再施加物理约束细化墙面接触、成对对齐、通道与开口的通畅性。

Result: 在3D-FRONT数据集上的布局生成任务中优于当前最先进方法，并展示了下游应用：real-to-sim迁移、类比轨迹迁移和多参考组合。

Conclusion: 簇级空间组织迁移为可泛化的功能场景生成提供了有效范式，兼顾语义上下文保持与物理合理性，并具备良好的下游扩展能力。

Abstract: Interactive simulations of embodied AI or spatial computing applications build on realistic 3D scenes that support daily activities. However, sparse, irregular layout structures impose scene-specific physical constraints, making it hard to define a generalizable framework for generating similar functional context. We formalize Scene Retargeting as stably transferring the semantically coherent spatial organization across layouts, rather than relying on textual descriptions or pairwise relationships. Our cluster-wise transfer flexibly handles mismatched object instances and adapts to distinctive floor plans. We optimize to preserve the rich semantic context of individual clusters by respecting the spatial distribution of foundation features. We can then impose physical constraints to refine wall contacts, pairwise alignment, or clear passageways and openings. Our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods on layout generation on the 3D-FRONT dataset, and demonstrates downstream applications including real-to-sim transfer, analogical trajectory transfer, and multi-reference composition.

</details>


### [69] [EGSD: Event-Grounded Self-Distillation for Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36803)
*Yuwei Miao,Xuesheng Zhang,Wenhao Zou,Jixia Zhang,Jianwei Lv,Bo Yuan,Junfeng Wang,Shiao Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD)，将流式视频记忆建模为可验证Event（关键视觉实体、动作、细节）的增量更新，解决on-policy自蒸馏在流式场景下的偏好错位与有效实体记忆坍塌问题。实验在StreamingBench达79.8%、OVO-Bench Real-Time达73.4%，有效实体召回提升17.4%，内存仅增6.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时视频理解需增量维护流式内容的记忆，而这依赖密集的过程信号。On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)可提供token级信号，但直接用于流式视频存在两点问题：(1) 学生无法端到端优化——记忆在问题到来前即已写入，而教师却借助问题与GT特权对其打分，导致师生偏好错位；(2) 有效实体记忆坍塌——问题与GT特权使教师只偏好与问题相关的实体，且对记忆做token均值平均使信号对记忆覆盖的实体数量不敏感，两者都使记忆背离流式所需的多样性。

Method: 提出Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD)，将流式记忆刻画为对可验证Event（关键视觉实体、动作、细节）的增量更新。针对问题(1)，将OPSD信号改造为与结果奖励结合的乘法权重；针对问题(2)，以Event作为特权信息对教师重加权，以抵消其问题相关性偏差，并加入实体覆盖奖励，补足token均值教师所缺失的覆盖偏好。

Result: 在主流在线与离线基准上取得强性能：StreamingBench达79.8%，OVO-Bench Real-Time赛道达73.4%；记忆分析显示有效实体召回提升17.4%，而内存长度仅增加6.8%。

Conclusion: EGSD通过将流式记忆锚定在可验证Event上，并针对性修正自蒸馏的偏好错位与覆盖坍塌，在保证记忆紧凑的同时显著提升实时视频理解的有效实体覆盖与整体性能。

Abstract: Real-time video understanding requires incrementally maintaining a memory of streaming content, and optimizing this requires dense process signals. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which lets one model serve as both teacher and student with the teacher receiving additional privileged information such as the question and ground-truth (GT) answer, can supply such token-level signals. However, applying it directly to streaming video raises two problems. (1) The student cannot be optimized end-to-end, where memory is written before the question arrives, yet the teacher scores it with the question-and-GT privilege, misaligning their preferences. (2) Effective-entity memory collapses, where the question-and-GT privilege makes the teacher favor only question-relevant entities, and token-mean averaging over a memory renders its signal invariant to how many entities that memory covers, both driving memory against the streaming need for diversity. To address these issues, we propose Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD), which characterizes streaming memory as an incremental update over verifiable Events (key visual entities, actions, and details) and targets the two problems on this basis. For problem (1), we adapt the OPSD signal into a multiplicative weight combined with the outcome reward; for problem (2), we re-weight the teacher with Events as privileged information to counter its question-relevance bias, and add an entity-coverage reward to supply the coverage preference the token-mean teacher lacks. Extensive experiments on mainstream online and offline benchmarks show EGSD achieves strong performance, reaching 79.8% on StreamingBench and 73.4% on the OVO-Bench Real-Time track, while memory analysis shows effective-entity recall rises 17.4% at only 6.8% more memory length.

</details>


### [70] [MeteoVerse: Unified Weather-Controllable Video World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36810)
*Renlong Wu,Guanqiao Wang,Xuan Shang,Yin Hanming,Xiaoxiao Sheng,Tianyu Huang,Hui Li,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 MeteoVerse，一个统一的可控天气视频世界模型，可从单张晴/恶劣天气图像出发，依据无天气场景描述、目标天气指令和相机轨迹生成未来视频，并通过显式建模"观测天气→目标天气"的转移实现天气保持、引入与去除的统一控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实场景演化不仅受视角和物体动态影响，还受天气等环境条件影响；天气变化依赖观测天气与期望天气的联合关系（保持/引入/去除）。现有视频世界模型将天气转移隐式交给生成主干与场景动态、相机运动一同推断，导致天气控制不精确。

Method: MeteoVerse 以单帧图像为输入，条件为无天气场景描述、目标天气指令与相机轨迹。核心是显式估计观测天气状态与目标天气状态，并表征所需天气转移；再用转移感知的天气专家混合（transition-aware mixture of weather experts）将转移转化为类别特定的残差天气特征，统一天气保持、引入与去除，并支持对引入天气强度的细粒度控制。此外构建 MeteoVerse 数据集，含 5 万余真实天气视频片段、生成的晴天对应视频、解耦的场景与天气描述、天气强度标注及相机轨迹。

Result: 大量实验表明，MeteoVerse 在显著提升天气可控性的同时，保持了具有竞争力的场景一致性与相机控制性能。

Conclusion: 显式建模天气状态转移并采用专家混合残差特征，是解决视频世界模型中天气演化难以精确控制的有效途径，且可统一处理天气保持、引入与去除。

Abstract: Video world models aim to predict future content from an observed scene while following prescribed camera motion. Real-world scene evolution is determined not only by changes in viewpoint and object dynamics, but also by environmental conditions such as weather, which can substantially alter scene appearance and visibility. Modeling such realistic weather evolution is challenging because the required weather modification depends jointly on the observed and desired weather states. Depending on their relation, the model may need to preserve, introduce, or remove a weather effect. Existing video world models typically leave this weather transition implicit, forcing the generation backbone to infer weather evolution together with scene dynamics and camera motion, which leads to imprecise weather control. To address this limitation, we propose MeteoVerse, a unified weather-controllable video world model that generates future videos from a single sunny or adverse-weather image, conditioned on a weather-free scene description, a target-weather instruction, and a camera trajectory. Rather than conditioning only on the desired weather, MeteoVerse explicitly estimates the observed and target weather states and represents the required weather transition. A transition-aware mixture of weather experts then translates this transition into category-specific residual weather features, unifying weather preservation, introduction, and removal while enabling fine-grained control over introduced weather intensity. We further construct the MeteoVerse dataset with over 50K real-world weather video clips, generated sunny counterparts, disentangled scene and weather descriptions, weather-intensity annotations, and camera trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantially improved weather controllability while retaining competitive scene consistency and camera-control performance.

</details>


### [71] [CurvSpec: Adaptive Multi-Curvature Learning for Partial Relevant Video Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36815)
*Zhen Liu,Letian Li,Jinpeng Wang,Shuzhao Xie,Yuzhi Huang,Jingyan Jiang,Zhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CurvSpec 框架，通过内容自适应曲率学习与语义质心表示解决部分相关视频检索中的信号稀释与曲率刚性问题，在三个数据集上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分相关视频检索（PRVR）中，文本查询对应的相关片段可能仅持续数秒，而视频长达数分钟，导致信噪比极低，比标准全视频检索更具挑战。该任务面临两个交织的难题：（1）信号稀释——粗粒度的全局表示会将短暂的 relevant signal 淹没在占主导的无关内容中；（2）曲率刚性——将所有视频嵌入同一固定几何空间，会扭曲从扁平原子事件到深层组合层次等结构差异巨大的视频表示。现有 PRVR 方法虽在片段选择与跨模态匹配上有所改进，但仍将全部视频编码于单一固定曲率的检索空间，难以建模多样的视频结构。

Method: 提出 CurvSpec 框架，为视频检索表示学习内容自适应的曲率，而非施加固定的几何先验。具体地：将特征并行通过欧几里得注意力层与双曲注意力层，其中双曲层分配独立学习的曲率；采用内容感知融合机制将每个输入路由至最合适的几何体制。为抑制信号稀释，使用语义质心表示每个视频，质心数量由视频内容复杂度决定；将质心投影到所学流形上，并通过测地距离将查询与最近质心匹配。

Result: 在 ActivityNet Captions、TVR 和 Charades-STA 三个数据集上的实验表明，CurvSpec 取得了当前最优的检索性能（state-of-the-art）。

Conclusion: CurvSpec 通过内容自适应曲率学习与内容复杂度驱动的语义质心表示，同时缓解了信号稀释与曲率刚性两大问题，验证了为视频-文本检索表示学习自适应几何结构的有效性。

Abstract: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) seeks to retrieve untrim-med videos containing a moment that matches a text query, without temporal annotations. The relevant moment may last only seconds within a video spanning several minutes, creating an extremely low signal-to-noise ratio that makes PRVR more challenging than standard full-video retrieval. This task presents two intertwined challenges: (1) signal dilution, where coarse global representations blur the brief relevant signal into the dominant irrelevant surroundings;(2) curvature rigidity, where embedding all videos in the same fixed-geometry space distorts representations for videos that range from flat atomic events to deep compositional hierarchies. Existing PRVR methods have improved moment selection and cross-modal matching, but they still typically encode all videos in a single fixed-curvature retrieval space, limiting their ability to model diverse video structures. To address both challenges, we propose CurvSpec, a framework that learns content-adaptive curvature for video retrieval representations rather than imposing a fixed geometric prior. CurvSpec processes features through parallel Euclidean and hyperbolic attention layers, with independently learned curvatures assigned to the hyperbolic layers, and a content-aware fusion mechanism routes each input to its most suitable geometric regime. To further suppress signal dilution, CurvSpec represents each video with semantic centroids whose number is determined by the video's content complexity, projects them onto the learned manifold, and matches each query against its nearest centroid by geodesic distance. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions, TVR, and Charades-STA demonstrate state-of-the-art retrieval performance.

</details>


### [72] [RED: Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36822)
*Wenpeng Mu,Junshan Jin,Tanfeng Sun,Xinghao Jiang,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RED框架，利用多尺度VQ-VAE重建过程中token可预测性的尺度间变化来聚合取证线索，实现可泛化的AI生成图像检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像生成器快速演进，现有检测器依赖静态图像表征或端点重建差异，忽视了中间重建阶段的演化信息；作者观察到真实图像与生成图像的相对token可预测性会在不同重建尺度上发生反转，提示中间阶段蕴含被端点比较忽略的取证证据。

Method: RED将冻结的多尺度VQ-VAE产生的重建轨迹映射到冻结CLIP编码器的共享特征空间；利用冻结VAR模型提供的逐尺度token负对数似然，学习图像自适应的阶段权重；再通过跨阶段证据聚合模块联合建模原图表征与加权重建特征，沿重建轨迹捕捉互补取证线索。

Result: 在六个多样化基准上，RED取得所评估方法中最高平均准确率92.5%与平均精度97.5%；进一步评估显示其对常见图像退化具有较强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: RED是首个以尺度级token可预测性引导中间重建状态取证证据聚合的框架，验证了重建演化对可泛化AI生成图像检测的价值；代码将在论文接收后公开。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of image generators calls for forensic cues that generalize beyond known generation mechanisms. Existing detectors often rely on static image representations or endpoint reconstruction discrepancies, leaving the evolution of intermediate reconstruction stages underexplored. We observe that the relative token predictability of real and generated images can reverse across reconstruction scales, suggesting that intermediate stages may expose forensic evidence overlooked by endpoint comparisons. Motivated by this observation, we propose RED (Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics), a framework that captures transferable forensic cues from coarse-to-fine reconstruction evolution. To our knowledge, RED is the first framework to use scale-wise token predictability to guide forensic evidence aggregation across intermediate reconstruction states. It represents the reconstruction trajectory produced by a frozen multiscale VQ-VAE in the shared feature space of a frozen CLIP encoder. To connect the observed predictability variations with visual evidence, RED learns image-adaptive stage weights from scale-wise token negative log-likelihoods provided by a frozen VAR model. A cross-stage evidence aggregation module then jointly models the original-image representation and the weighted reconstruction features, capturing complementary forensic cues through interactions along the reconstruction trajectory. Experiments on six diverse benchmarks demonstrate that RED achieves the highest average accuracy of 92.5\% and average precision of 97.5\% among the evaluated methods. Further evaluations show strong robustness to common image degradations, supporting the value of reconstruction evolution for generalizable AI-generated image detection. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance of this paper.

</details>


### [73] [Learning via Self-Consistency for Diffusion-based Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36826)
*Zhenghao Ni,Weimin Qiu,Meng Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究能否将大语言模型中的自洽性（self-consistency）思想迁移到基于扩散的视频推理，提出无需训练的测试时扩展方法与拒绝微调（RFT）蒸馏策略，在迷宫求解、视觉搜索和指代分割三项任务上显著提升性能且推理延迟不增。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式视频生成具有随机性，而多数下游视觉任务是确定性的；受大语言模型思维链自洽性有效性的启发，作者希望利用多次采样的相互一致性来提升视频推理的可靠性与准确性。

Method: 1) 免训练测试时扩展：对同一输入采样多条视频生成轨迹，从每条 rollout 中提取路径、位置或掩码并聚合成共识预测；2) 早期读出：在去噪轨迹的早期阶段读取预测，在保持共识质量的同时将去噪步数减少一半以上；3) 拒绝微调（RFT）：将共识预测蒸馏回视频生成模型，使其在推理时仅需单次生成即可内化多样本共识收益。

Result: 在迷宫求解、视觉搜索、指代分割三个任务上，自洽推理与共识蒸馏均大幅提升视频感知与推理能力，且无需真值视频或任务专用验证器。视觉搜索准确率由单次生成的48.4%提升至99.0%；4×4迷宫求解的严格成功率由72.0%提升至84.0%，且推理延迟相同。

Conclusion: 自洽性可有效迁移至扩散式视频推理，多采样共识与共识蒸馏能在不增加推理开销（蒸馏后单次生成）的前提下显著提升确定性的下游视觉任务表现，为视频生成模型作为视觉推理器提供了新的测试时扩展与训练范式。

Abstract: Video generation models have demonstrated emerging zero-shot capabilities for visual reasoning, perception, and other vision tasks. However, diffusion-based video generation is inherently stochastic, while many downstream vision tasks are deterministic. Motivated by the effectiveness of self-consistency in chain-of-thought reasoning for large language models, we investigate whether self-consistency can similarly improve diffusion-based video reasoning. We first introduce a training-free test-time scaling method that samples multiple video generations and aggregates their predictions through self-consistency. Specifically, we aggregate extracted paths, locations, or masks from multiple rollouts into a consensus prediction. To reduce the inference overhead of multi-rollout generation, we read out predictions early in the denoising trajectory, which preserves consensus quality while reducing denoising steps by more than half. We further propose Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) to distill consensus predictions into the video generation model. The resulting model internalizes the benefit of multi-sample consensus and requires only a single generation at inference time, while substantially outperforming the original model. Experiments on three tasks, including maze solving, visual search, and referring segmentation, show that both our self-consistency inference and consensus distillation dramatically improve video-based perception and reasoning, without requiring ground-truth videos or task-specific verification. For visual search, self-consistency raises task accuracy from 48.4% for a single generation to 99.0%. The distilled model retains much of the consensus benefit with a single rollout. For 4-by-4 maze solving, consensus-based training improves the single-generation strict success rate from 72.0% to 84.0% with the same inference latency.

</details>


### [74] [Motion Concept Unlearning in Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36832)
*Ping Liu,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了视频扩散Transformer中的"运动概念擦除"，通过因果干预发现文本条件注意力携带概念特定运动信息，据此提出免训练方法MUTE，在20个运动概念上优于现有基线并可跨架构迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文生视频（T2V）扩散模型能生成踢打、刺击等动作的真实画面，带来安全隐忧，需要针对性擦除运动概念。然而已有概念擦除研究多集中于T2I与T2V中的静态概念，运动概念擦除仍基本空白。

Method: 通过因果干预定位机制：文本条件注意力携带概念特定运动信息且支持选择性干预，而扰时域位置编码会同时抑制目标与非目标动态。发现将ESD（权重级图像擦除方法）直接迁移到视频DiT效果有限且不均衡，因为降低擦除损失并不能移除条件与无条件预测差中的概念信号，而CFG会在每步去噪放大该信号。据此提出三项要求（概念特异性、空间选择性、时域自然性），并设计MUTE：每步去噪时经由token中性化提取概念方向，由该方向的内在结构导出空间门控，在CFG应用前从速度输出中减去校正量。MUTE免训练、无需修改权重。

Result: 在20个运动概念上的实验表明，MUTE在Wan2.1-T2V上优于代表性的提示级、权重级与推理时基线，且同一形式可迁移至CogVideoX，证明其适用于不同T2V注意力架构。

Conclusion: 运动概念擦除需要同时满足概念特异性、空间选择性与时域自然性；在CFG前进行干预的免训练方案能在不修改权重的前提下实现更优、更可迁移的运动概念擦除。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can generate realistic depictions of actions such as kicking, stabbing, and shooting, raising safety concerns that motivate targeted concept erasure. Although concept erasure has been extensively studied for static concepts in text-to-image and T2V models, erasing motion concepts remains largely unexplored. We present a systematic study of motion concept erasure in video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). Through causal interventions, we show that text-conditioning attention carries concept-specific motion information and supports selective intervention, whereas perturbing temporal positional encoding suppresses both target and non-target dynamics. We further find that directly adapting ESD, a representative weight-level image erasure method, to a video DiT yields modest and uneven motion suppression: reducing its erasure training loss does not by itself remove the concept signal from the difference between the conditional and unconditional predictions, which classifier-free guidance (CFG) then scales at every denoising step. From these findings, we derive three requirements for motion concept erasure: concept specificity, spatial selectivity, and temporal naturalness. Each determines one component of MUTE (Motion concept Unlearning in Text-to-video gEneration): at each denoising step, MUTE extracts a concept direction through token neutralization, derives a spatial gate from the direction's intrinsic structure, and subtracts the resulting correction from the velocity output before CFG is applied. MUTE is training-free and requires no weight modification. Experiments on 20 motion concepts show that MUTE outperforms representative prompt-level, weight-level, and inference-time baselines on Wan2.1-T2V, and the same formulation transfers to CogVideoX, supporting its applicability across distinct T2V attention architectures.

</details>


### [75] [You Cannot Recover What Was Never Measured: Quantifying the Information Ceiling of Ultra-Low-Field MRI Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36837)
*Prathamesh Pradeep Khole,Shreya Handa,Utkarsh Gupta,Razvan Marinescu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究测量了真实64 mT低场MRI中实际包含的个体特异性信息上限（约3–4 mm半间距），发现合成退化配对高估了信息约1 mm，且现有生成超分辨模型在真实配对上会虚构细节，PSNR/SSIM无法区分重建与虚构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式超分辨被用于将便携64 mT MRI"提升"为类3T图像，但该领域普遍在合成退化配对（由高场图像人工降质生成）上评测，且已知模型存在幻觉、问题本身病态，却没有任何研究量化真实低场扫描究竟携带多少个体受试者信息。作者希望填补这一空白，检验真实可恢复性而非合成基准的假象。

Method: 使用三个公开数据集中同一受试者的配对64 mT与3T扫描，并采用一种在"答案已知"的测试上验证过的测量协议；先在整脑尺度上测定真实64 mT扫描中个体特异性结构的信息极限（面内约3–4 mm半间距，面外更粗），并与标准合成退化所保留的信息作对比；随后在真实配对采集上测试训练过的扩散模型及一个公开外部模型，覆盖5种架构（GAN、扩散、Transformer族）共24次训练运行，评估输出细节与受试者自身3T扫描及他人3T扫描的相关性，以及样本方差不确定性是否可区分虚构结构与重建困难。

Result: 真实64 mT扫描的个体特异性信息仅保留到面内约3–4 mm半间距，面外更粗；标准合成退化比该上限多保留约1 mm信息。在所有可测量忠实度的受试者上，模型输出的精细细节与受试者自身3T扫描的相关性并不高于与陌生人3T扫描的相关性；样本方差不确定性无法区分虚构结构与重建困难。

Conclusion: 由于PSNR和SSIM衡量的是与参考图像的相似度而非细节是否属于该受试者，以此评分的基准无法区分"恢复"与"虚构"；在合成配对上训练和评测的模型实际上是在真实扫描仪从未记录的信息上被评估。作者将公开测量协议代码，以便对更新模型的可恢复性声明进行检验。

Abstract: Generative super-resolution models can turn portable 64 mT MRI into images that look like 3T scans, and the field evaluates them with PSNR, SSIM, and pixelwise uncertainty, most often on pairs built by synthetically degrading high-field images. Prior work acknowledges that these models hallucinate and that the problem is ill posed, but to our knowledge no study measures how much information about the individual subject the real low-field scan actually contains. We measure it. Using paired 64 mT and 3T scans of the same subjects from three public datasets, and a measurement protocol validated on tests whose correct answer is known in advance, we find that, judged over the whole brain, real 64 mT scans carry structure specific to the individual only down to approximately 3 to 4 mm half-pitch in plane, and coarser still through plane. Standard synthetic degradations preserve subject information roughly 1 mm beyond this ceiling, so models trained and benchmarked on synthetic pairs are evaluated on information that real scanners never record. We then test trained diffusion models and a publicly released external model on real paired acquisitions; 24 trained runs of five architectures (GAN, diffusion, and transformer families) give the coverage of the audit. On every subject where faithfulness can be measured, fine output detail is no more correlated with the subject's own 3T scan than with a stranger's, while sample-variance uncertainty does not distinguish fabricated structure from reconstruction difficulty. Because PSNR and SSIM score resemblance to a reference rather than whether detail belongs to the subject, a benchmark scored by them cannot tell recovery from fabrication. Code for the measurement protocol will be released so that recoverability claims can be tested for newer models.

</details>


### [76] [On-Policy Visual Evidence Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36838)
*Shaohang Wei,Feifan Song,Guangyue Peng,Wenhao Yu,Wei Li,Wen Luo,Yang Xu,Yufan Shen,Luke Mao,Yang Du,Asher Qin,Houfeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ReVuE，一种面向视觉智能体的on-policy蒸馏方法，通过对比多条学生轨迹、诊断Acquire/Read/Ground三阶段的首个失败点并将反思作为教师上下文，按反思对教师预测的影响对token级蒸馏损失分组重加权，实现轨迹级证据诊断到token级监督的转化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉智能体通过推理与图像操作交替求解问题，on-policy蒸馏（OPD）可在学生自生成轨迹上提供强教师指导。但图像操作会改变后续推理所依赖的证据，Acquire（证据获取）、Read（证据读取）、Ground（答案落地）阶段的局部错误会沿轨迹传播导致错误答案。现有多模态OPD方法主要构造或对比原图辅助视图以加强监督，未显式建模学生动作、观测结果与后续推理之间的关联，难以针对不同失败阶段提供定制化纠正。

Method: 提出Reflection on Visual Evidence（ReVuE）。对同一查询的多条学生轨迹进行对比，总结观测到的视觉证据，并诊断Acquire、Read、Ground三阶段中出现的首个失败。所得反思作为训练时的教师上下文。根据反思对教师预测的影响强度，对token级蒸馏损失进行分组与重加权，从而将轨迹级证据诊断转化为有针对性的token级监督，引导学生改进视觉证据获取与推理。

Result: 在覆盖Qwen2.5-VL与InternVL3.5模型家族的11个基准上，ReVuE在感知、数学推理与通用任务的加权平均得分上优于所有评测的OPD基线；同时减少推理与工具调用冗余，提升工具调用准确率与任务准确率。

Conclusion: 显式建模学生动作—观测—后续推理之间的联系并对失败阶段进行诊断，能够为多模态on-policy蒸馏提供更精准的监督；ReVuE通过轨迹级反思驱动的token级损失重加权，有效提升视觉智能体的证据获取与推理能力，并改善推理与工具调用效率。

Abstract: Visual agents solve problems by interleaving reasoning with image operations, and on-policy distillation (OPD) provides guidance from a strong teacher on student-generated interaction trajectories. However, image operations change the evidence available for subsequent reasoning, so local errors in evidence acquisition (Acquire), reading (Read), or answer grounding (Ground) can propagate through the trajectory and lead to incorrect answers. Existing multimodal OPD methods primarily construct or contrast auxiliary views of the original image to strengthen supervision, without explicitly modeling the connections between student actions, resulting observations, and subsequent reasoning. This limits their ability to provide corrections tailored to different failure stages. We introduce Reflection on Visual Evidence (ReVuE), an on-policy distillation method for visual agents. ReVuE compares multiple student-generated trajectories for the same query, summarizes the observed visual evidence, and diagnoses the first failure across the Acquire, Read, and Ground stages. The resulting reflections provide training-time context for the teacher. We group and reweight token-level distillation losses according to how strongly these reflections affect the teacher's predictions. This design translates trajectory-level evidence diagnosis into targeted token-level supervision, guiding students to improve their visual evidence acquisition and reasoning. Across 11 benchmarks spanning the Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 model families, ReVuE outperforms all evaluated OPD baselines in weighted-average scores for perception, mathematical reasoning, and general tasks. ReVuE also reduces redundancy in reasoning and tool calls while improving tool-call accuracy and task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/ReVuE

</details>


### [77] [Does the VGGT Family Need All Its Layers?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36842)
*Fengyi Zhang,Holger Caesar,Xiangyu Sun,Zheng Zhang,Zi Huang,Yadan Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了VGGT、π³和VGGT-Ω三类前馈几何模型中的层冗余，通过3,018种剪枝配置在四个数据集上评估七项相机位姿与稠密几何指标，发现可移除层聚集于早期主冗余区与晚期次冗余区，并据此提出将剪枝搜索从O(L⁴)降至O(L²)的可加性规律、基于CKA的廉价代理指标以及无需端到端重训的闭式线性校准方法，最终在聚合器参数减少至多44%的同时保持与原模型相当的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈几何模型（如VGGT系列）在相机位姿估计与稠密3D重建上表现优异，但聚合器层数深、参数多，推理成本高。现有文献普遍报告冗余集中在中间到后期层，然而该结论是否适用于同时输出相机位姿与稠密结构的几何模型尚不明确；同时，逐层剪枝搜索代价随深度呈O(L⁴)增长，且剪枝后精度恢复通常依赖昂贵的端到端重训练。因此，作者希望明确哪些层对同时保持相机位姿与稠密3D结构是必要的，并给出高效、低成本的剪枝与恢复方案。

Method: 作者以VGGT、π³和VGGT-Ω为研究对象，构建了3,018种剪枝配置，在四个室内外数据集的七项相机位姿与稠密几何指标上进行评测。通过分析单区间与双区间删除的联合退化行为，验证退化近似可加性；使用CKA（Centered Kernel Alignment）作为区间退化的表征级代理指标；并采用闭式线性校准（最小二乘）在剪枝后恢复精度，且区分special token与patch token的映射，仅用100个校准场景拟合恢复映射，再在留出场景与未见数据集上验证泛化性。

Result: 实验得到四项主要发现：(i) 可移除层聚集成两个冗余区——占主导的早期冗余区和较窄的晚期冗余区，跨中间层的删除破坏性始终更大，该模式跨模型、数据集与指标一致，且与文献常报的“中后期冗余”相反；(ii) 两个区间删除的联合退化约等于各自退化之和，使剪枝搜索的模型评估次数由O(L⁴)降至O(L²)（L为聚合器深度）；(iii) CKA可作为区间退化的更廉价代理，在剪枝质量与校准成本间提供实用折中；(iv) 闭式线性校准无需端到端重训即可恢复精度，最小二乘分析表明special token与patch token共享映射通常带来额外重建损失，故需token-aware恢复；仅用100个校准场景拟合的恢复映射可泛化到留出场景与未见数据集，最终模型在聚合器参数减少至多44%的同时精度与原模型相当。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了前馈几何模型中“早期主冗余+晚期次冗余”的层冗余结构，纠正了以往关于中后期冗余的普遍认知；提出退化近似可加性，将剪枝搜索复杂度从O(L⁴)降至O(L²)；引入CKA作为廉价表征代理，并给出无需重训的闭式线性校准与token-aware恢复方案。方法在保持相机位姿与稠密几何精度的同时减少聚合器参数至多44%，为几何基础模型的高效压缩提供了可复现、低成本的实用路径。代码与实验结果将在项目主页公开。

Abstract: Which layers of a feed-forward geometry model are needed to preserve both camera poses and dense 3D structure? We study layer redundancy in VGGT, $π^3$, and VGGT-$Ω$: 3,018 pruned configurations, scored on seven camera-pose and dense-geometry metrics across four indoor and outdoor datasets. Four findings follow: (i) Removable layers cluster in two redundancy regions: a dominant early region and a narrower late one, while deletions spanning the intervening layers are consistently more disruptive. This recurring pattern holds across models, datasets, and metrics, and contrasts with the middle-to-late redundancy commonly reported in the literature. (ii) Within these regions, we observe that the joint degradation from deleting two intervals is approximately the sum of their individual degradations, reducing the number of model evaluations for pruning search from $O(L^4)$ to $O(L^2)$, where $L$ is the aggregator depth. (iii) We find that CKA provides a cheaper representation-based proxy for interval degradation, offering a practical trade-off between pruning quality and calibration cost. (iv) Closed-form linear calibration recovers accuracy after pruning without end-to-end retraining. A least-squares analysis shows that using a shared map for special and patch tokens generally incurs excess reconstruction loss, motivating token-aware recovery. Recovery maps fitted on just 100 calibration scenes generalize to held-out scenes and unseen datasets. The resulting models reduce aggregator parameters by up to 44% while maintaining accuracy comparable to their intact counterparts. Code and experimental results will be available at our project page: https://xian-bei.github.io/vggt-family-layer-redundancy/

</details>


### [78] [GlassFormer: Learning Real-time Glass Segmentation using Radar-Depth Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36844)
*Suhani Grover,Astik Srivastava,Viswas Dinesh,Avinash Sharma,K. Madhava Krishna*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出融合毫米波雷达与RGB-D的多模态框架，通过跨模态注意力将雷达引导的空间先验注入轻量级Transformer分割网络GlassFormer，实现实时透明表面分割，在混合条件与低光场景下均显著优于纯视觉基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 透明表面（玻璃墙、门、镜面）是机器人感知的持续失败案例：RGB相机只能看到玻璃后方背景而非表面本身，LiDAR、ToF、RGB-D等深度传感器在透明区域常返回无效或背景测量，导致系统将玻璃误判为自由空间，危及导航安全。现有基于RGB的玻璃分割方法依赖反射、边界、语义上下文等视觉线索，在低光、强眩光、无纹理或部分遮挡条件下性能退化。因此需要一种在视觉与深度失效处仍可靠的感知手段。

Method: 提出融合毫米波雷达与RGB-D传感的多模态框架。利用雷达对玻璃表面的强反射特性提供几何线索，并挖掘跨模态不一致性以生成雷达引导的空间先验，通过跨模态注意力机制将其集成到轻量级Transformer分割网络GlassFormer中，实现实时透明表面分割。

Result: 在覆盖全部场景类型的混合条件测试集上，GlassFormer达到0.88 mIoU；在专为压制纯视觉方法而设计的低光测试集上达到0.59 mIoU。相较纯视觉基线取得显著鲁棒性提升，同时在资源受限平台上保持实时性能。

Conclusion: 雷达提供的几何线索可在视觉与深度感知失效处保持可靠，跨模态融合是提升透明表面分割鲁棒性的有效途径；该框架兼具精度与实时性，适用于资源受限的机器人平台。

Abstract: Transparent surfaces are ubiquitous in built environments, yet they remain a persistent failure case for robotic perception. RGB cameras perceive the background behind glass rather than the surface itself, while depth sensors such as LiDAR, time-of-flight, and RGB-D often return invalid or background measurements in transparent regions. As a result, systems that rely solely on optical sensing may misinterpret glass walls, doors, or mirrors as free space, compromising safe and reliable navigation. Existing glass segmentation approaches address this by learning visual cues such as reflections, boundaries, and semantic context from RGB images. While effective under favourable lighting and viewing conditions, these cues degrade in low-light environments, under glare, or when glass surfaces are featureless or partially occluded. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework that fuses millimetre-wave radar with RGB-D sensing for real-time transparent surface segmentation. Radar reflects strongly off glass surfaces, providing a geometric cue that remains reliable precisely where vision and depth fail. We exploit this cross-modal inconsistency to generate a radar-guided spatial prior, which is integrated into a lightweight transformer-based segmentation network, GlassFormer, via cross-modal attention. We report results on a mixed-condition test split covering all scene types and a dedicated low-light split designed to stress vision-only methods. GlassFormer achieves 0.88 mIoU on the mixed split, and 0.59 mIoU on the low light split, demonstrating substantial robustness gains over vision-only baselines while maintaining real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms.

</details>


### [79] [RoXDrive: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Action-Faithful Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36851)
*Hongbin Lin,Chaoda Zheng,Yiming Yang,Xiangyu Li,Shijia Chen,Jinhao Deng,Kangjie Chen,Dongbin Zhang,Jie Feng,Yu Zhang,Xianming Liu,Shuguang Cui,Boyang Wang,Zhen Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 RoXDrive，一个即插即用的闭环强化学习框架，通过识别"动作忠实"的世界模型 rollout 来实现可靠的自动驾驶策略优化，在 nuScenes 与内部数据集上显著降低安全违规率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶策略通常基于日志演示进行模仿学习，无法观测自身动作的后果，在闭环真实部署中会产生因果混淆。强化学习后训练虽有前景，但现有方法或依赖重建式模拟器（反事实交互能力有限），或采用合成模拟器（存在严重 sim-to-real 差距）。视频世界模型虽能生成真实的多步未来 rollout，却可能无法忠实反映动作条件，导致"动作-视觉不匹配"。

Method: RoXDrive 包含两个阶段：(1) 模型预训练：除基于模仿的策略预训练外，设计动作-视觉忠实度评估器（Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator），结合几何感知的辅助轨迹监督进行逆动力学估计，从而长时程评估视觉动态是否忠实反映条件化的自车动作；(2) 动作忠实的强化学习后训练：智能体迭代地与世界模型交互形成长时程场景 rollout，仅保留动作忠实的样本，用于密集安全感知评分与场景级闭环 RL 后训练。

Result: 在 nuScenes 及包含超过 13 万个训练场景的内部数据集上进行了大量实验。框架在多种规划器上取得一致增益：在 nuScenes 上配合 DiffusionDrive 将安全违规降低 27.6%，在内部数据上配合 Qwen3-VL 将安全违规降低 33.7%。

Conclusion: RoXDrive 作为一种即插即用的闭环 RL 框架，通过筛选动作忠实的世界模型 rollout，有效缓解了动作-视觉不匹配问题，为端到端自动驾驶策略提供了可靠、可泛化的优化途径，并验证了其跨规划器和跨数据集的稳定性。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving policies are commonly trained via imitation learning on logged demonstrations without observing the consequences of their own actions, leading to causal confusion in closed-loop real-world deployment. To address this issue, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training offers a promising alternative by leveraging world models as interactive training environments to enable future scene generation for policy improvement. Nevertheless, existing approaches either rely on reconstruction-based simulators, offering limited counterfactual interaction, or adopt synthetic simulators to enable long-horizon closed-loop interaction at the cost of a substantial sim-to-real gap. Recently, video world models have exhibited the ability to generate realistic multi-step future rollouts but may not faithfully reflect action conditions, resulting in action-vision mismatch. In this paper, we introduce RoXDrive, a plug-and-play closed-loop RL framework that enables reliable policy optimization by identifying action-faithful world-model rollouts, consisting of two stages: 1) Model pre-training: In addition to imitation-based policy pre-training, we devise an Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator for inverse dynamics estimation with our geometry-aware auxiliary trajectory supervision, enabling long-horizon assessment of whether visual dynamics faithfully reflect the conditioning ego actions. 2) Action-faithful RL post-training: Agents iteratively interact with world models to form long-horizon scene rollouts, retaining only action-faithful ones for dense safety-aware scoring and scene-level closed-loop RL post-training. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and an in-house dataset with over 130K training scenarios demonstrate consistent gains across planners, reducing safety violations by 27.6% with DiffusionDrive on nuScenes and 33.7% with Qwen3-VL on the internal data.

</details>


### [80] [Socialality Anchors: Towards Group-bounded Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36852)
*Ziqian Zou,Conghao Wong,Qinmu Peng,Xinge You*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出Socalality，一种受人类社交感知启发的轨迹预测框架，通过可解释的Socialality锚点和扩展分组窗口实现稳定、上下文自适应的分组推断，在标准基准上取得性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轨迹预测需建模社会交互，尤其群体交互，因为群体成员关系体现共享意图、协调运动与稳定相互适应，是有持久语义的社会先验。但现有群体建模方法多依赖固定阈值，仅从观测窗口内智能体相对位置推断群体，忽略了分组规则应因智能体而异、时间连贯且随个性、文化及交互情境自适应。

Method: 受人类社交感知（边界敏感情境下依赖人际距离，动态交互中依赖相对速度一致性）启发，提出Socialality框架：引入双标量控制的社交性分组核（Socalality），联合历史观测与短期未来轨迹预览学习智能体特定的分组规则；采用扩展分组窗口实现稳定、上下文感知的分组推断；并使用群体感知机制以直观可解释方式建模组内与组外交互。

Result: 在标准基准上进行大量实验，验证了Socialality的性能增益；并通过定性分析与锚点分布的统计研究，验证了所提Socialality锚点的可解释性与稳定性。

Conclusion: Socalality以人类社交感知为启发，通过可解释、智能体特定且上下文自适应的分组推断，提升了轨迹预测性能与解释性，为群体交互建模提供了新思路。

Abstract: Trajectory prediction is a key component for understanding human behavior patterns in dynamic scenes. Researchers have devoted substantial efforts to modeling social interactions, especially group-wise interactions, since group membership often reflects shared intention, coordinated motion, and stable mutual adaptation, thus providing a persistent and semantically meaningful social prior for forecasting. However, existing group modeling methods may rely on a fixed threshold and infer groups mainly from agents' relative positions within the observation window, overlooking the fact that grouping rules should be agent-specific, temporally coherent, and context-adaptive across diverse personalities, culturalities, and evolving interaction contexts. Inspired by human social perception that alternates between interpersonal distance in boundary-sensitive situations and relative speed consistency in dynamic interactions, we propose Socialality, a human-inspired trajectory prediction framework with interpretable Socialality anchors and an extended grouping window for stable, context-aware grouping inference. Concretely, Socialality introduces a duo-scalar-controlled grouping kernel Socialality that jointly leverages historical observations and short-term future trajectory previews to learn agent-specific grouping rules, and employs a group-wise perception mechanism to model in-group and out-of-group interactions in an intuitive and explainable manner. Furthermore, we conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmarks to demonstrate the performance gains of Socialality, and provide qualitative analyses and statistical studies of anchor distributions to verify the interpretability and stability of the proposed Socialality anchors.

</details>


### [81] [S2T-Unet: A Structure-to-Style Framework for Inter-Modality MRI Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36866)
*Yichao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV
