TL;DR: 提出S2T-Unet框架，通过显式解耦模态不变结构与模态特异外观，实现MRI跨模态图像翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MRI跨模态翻译方法多学习整体强度映射，未显式分离模态不变的结构信息与模态特异的表观信息，易导致结构丢失或图像细节不真实。

Method: 在U-Net低层瓶颈引入向量量化，借助可学习离散码本编码模态不变结构信息；在高层设置模态变换模块，以解码器特征为条件，将编码器表征变换至目标模态，从而恢复模态特异的强度与对比度。

Result: 在IXI多对比度MRI数据集上的四个翻译任务中，S2T-Unet性能与当前最优方法相当或更优。

Conclusion: 显式解耦结构信息与外观信息有助于在减少额外扫描的同时保持临床相关解剖结构，是一种有效的MRI跨模态翻译范式。

Abstract: Inter-modality MRI translation aims to synthesize missing MRI modalities from available acquisitions, reducing the need for additional scanning while preserving clinically relevant anatomical information. However, existing image translation methods often learn intensity mappings without explicitly separating modality-invariant structural information from modality-specific appearance, which may lead to structural information loss or unrealistic image details. In this work, we propose S2T-Unet, a structure-to-style framework that explicitly models these two aspects. Specifically, vector quantization is introduced at the lower-level bottleneck to encode modality-invariant structural information using a learned discrete codebook. At higher levels, a modality transformation module uses decoder features to condition and transform encoder representations toward the target modality, thereby recovering modality-specific intensity and contrast information. Experiments on the IXI multi-contrast MRI dataset across four translation tasks demonstrate that S2T-Unet is comparable or outperform with state-of-art method.

</details>


### [82] [S4VY: Segment Anything in Feed-Forward 4D Visual Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36875)
*Jingdong Zhang,Xin Li,Jan Kautz,Wenping Wang,Chris Choy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: S4VY 是一个基于前馈 4D 视觉几何的可提示实例分割模型，通过时空查询解码器将共享视觉-几何特征转化为类别无关的 4D 实例掩码，并配合智能体框架实现自然语言定位，在统一评测中取得最优的 4D 实例分割与语言引导定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态场景中的精确实例分割对机器人与自动驾驶等下游应用至关重要。现有 Segment Anything 类模型主要处理 2D 图像或视频掩码，依赖序列化记忆保持身份，而基于前馈视觉几何的可提示 4D 实例分割仍未被充分探索。

Method: 提出 S4VY，从一组 RGB 观测出发，将共享的视觉-几何特征经时空查询解码器转换为穷尽的类别无关 4D 实例掩码，每个持久目标查询在所有观测中绑定同一实体；支持无提示分割及点、框条件选择，无需种子掩码或时序顺序。另构建用于大观测空间自然语言定位的智能体机制：主动树搜索定位相关帧、双流定位器融合 VLM 细粒度先验与几何一致的实例特征、独立评判器从候选中选出最终 4D 实例掩码。

Result: 在覆盖静态与动态场景的统一评测中，取得当前最优的 4D 实例分割结果，并展现出强语言引导定位性能。

Conclusion: S4VY 将 Segment Anything 能力拓展到前馈 4D 视觉几何，统一了无提示与可提示分割及语言引导定位，为动态场景下的实例级理解提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Accurate instance segmentation in dynamic scenes is important for downstream applications such as robotics and autonomous driving. Existing Segment Anything models operate primarily on 2D image or video masks and preserve identity through sequential memory, while promptable 4D instance segmentation built upon feed-forward visual geometry remains underexplored. We introduce S4VY, a Segment Anything model built on feed-forward 4D visual geometry. From a set of RGB observations, S4VY transforms shared visual-geometric features into an exhaustive set of class-agnostic 4D instance masks through a space-time query decoder, with each persistent object query binding one entity across all observations. This representation supports prompt-independent segmentation as well as point- and box- conditioned selection, without requiring a seed mask or temporal ordering. We further develop an agentic harness for natural-language grounding in the large observation space of a 4D scene. Active tree search identifies relevant frames without scanning every fixed window; a dual-stream grounder combines fine-grained VLM visual priors with geometry-consistent instance features through complementary bounding-box prediction and object-query matching; and an independent critic selects the final 4D instance mask from their predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art 4D instance segmentation and strong language-guided grounding performance under a unified evaluation spanning static and dynamic scenes.

</details>


### [83] [Less Supervision, Better Generalization: Weakly Supervised Fake Region Localization in Diffusion-Edited Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36882)
*Junhee Lee,Donghyeon Jeon,Taeoh Kim,Beomyoung Kim,MyeongAh Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个弱监督扩散编辑伪造区域定位框架 ReGFLoW，仅用图像级真伪标签，借助扩散重建误差作为稠密空间引导并注入特征与分数空间，通过以伪影为中心的多示例学习实现定位，域外泛化优于全监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 定位 AI 编辑区域对可解释取证至关重要，但伪影细微且空间分布分散，与语义或目标边界不一致。现有方法依赖受控编辑流程的像素级监督，难以规模化，且引入误导信号：伪影常超出标注区域，而掩码外像素被当作真实，限制了模型捕捉可迁移证据及跨生成器、跨数据集泛化的能力。

Method: ReGFLoW（弱监督下的重建引导伪造定位框架）：仅需图像级真/假标签，利用扩散重建误差作为稠密空间引导，将其注入特征空间与分数空间；结合以伪影为中心的多示例学习（multiple instance learning），在不依赖语义亲和或边界伪掩码先验的前提下利用局部扩散证据进行定位。

Result: 大量实验表明，ReGFLoW 的域外泛化能力优于全监督学习基线。

Conclusion: ReGFLoW 是首个面向扩散编辑伪造区域定位的弱监督方法，证明图像级弱监督结合扩散重建引导可有效定位伪造区域，并带来更强的跨域泛化性能。

Abstract: Localizing AI-edited regions is essential for interpretable forensic analysis, but remains challenging due to subtle and spatially distributed artifacts that are misaligned with semantic or object boundaries. Existing approaches rely on pixel-level supervision from controlled editing pipelines, which is difficult to scale and can introduce misleading signals: artifacts frequently extend beyond annotated regions, while out-of-mask pixels are treated as authentic. This limits models' ability to capture transferable evidence and generalize across generators and datasets. To address these issues, we propose ReGFLoW, a Reconstruction-Guided Fake Localization framework under Weak supervision, which is the first weakly supervised approach for diffusion-edited fake region localization. ReGFLoW requires only real/fake labels at the image-level and uses diffusion reconstruction errors as dense spatial guidance to inject them into both feature and score spaces. Furthermore, by artifact-centric multiple instance learning, ReGFLoW utilizes localized diffusion evidence without relying on semantic-affinity or boundary-based pseudo-mask priors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReGFLoW achieves stronger out-of-domain generalization than fully supervised learning baselines.

</details>


### [84] [ProGuT: Label-Efficient Panoptic Segmentation for Forest Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36891)
*Pankaj Deoli,Karsten Berns*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProGuT提出一种无需逐图掩码的森林全景伪标签生成方法：仅用无标注图像与一次性聚类-类别映射，通过CLIP块特征聚类结合结构张量多尺度几何先验恢复树干实例；在Our-forest数据集上PQ达65.2（较初始伪标签提升2.6倍），Freiburg Forest上mIoU达65.9，优于PiCIE和STEGO等无监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 森林环境全景分割的瓶颈不在语义质量，而在实例分离：现有无监督全景方法能生成可用的stuff（背景类）图，但thing（实例类）质量近乎为零。基于深度或光流的方法依赖并非始终可得的传感器，因此需要一种低成本、仅用无标注图像的实例发现与伪标签生成方案。

Method: ProGuT（Prototype Guided Training）无需逐图训练掩码，仅需无标注图像与一次性的聚类到类别映射。方法先用CLIP patch特征聚类，再通过结构张量构造多尺度几何先验，用以证伪非树干结构，从而恢复树干实例。相比深度、光流或类别监督方法，该伪标签生成成本更低，生成的伪标签随后用于下游任务。

Result: 在Our-forest数据集上Panoptic Quality（PQ）达65.2，较初始伪标签质量提升2.6倍；在Freiburg Forest上mIoU达65.9，优于PiCIE（45.3 IoU）与STEGO（57.6 IoU）等无监督基线；并在类别无关的树干实例基准上优于现有无监督方法。

Conclusion: ProGuT证明，在森林全景分割中，仅依靠无标注图像与轻量几何先验即可显著提升实例（thing）质量，取得更优的PQ与mIoU，且伪标签生成成本低于依赖深度、光流或类别监督的现有方法，是一种高效的无监督全景伪标签生成框架。

Abstract: Panoptic segmentation in forest environments is bottlenecked not by semantic quality but by instance separation; existing unsupervised panoptic approaches produce usable stuff maps but near-zero thing quality. Depth or flow-based instance discovery methods needs sensors that are not always available. We present ProGuT (Prototype Guided Training), which produces panoptic pseudo-labels without per-image training masks, needing only unlabeled images and one-time cluster-to-class mapping. ProGuT clusters CLIP patch features, then recovers trunk instances through multiscale geometric prior that falsifies non-trunk structures via structure-tensor. This is cheap compared to depth, flow or class-supervision methods to create pseudo labels. These are then used for downstream tasks which we evaluate against other unsupervised baselines. ProGuT achieves a Panoptic Quality (PQ) of 65.2 on Our-forest dataset (2.6x improvement over the initial pseudo-label quality) and reaches 65.9 mIoU on Freiburg Forest, outperforming unsupervised baselines like PiCIE (45.3 IoU) and STEGO(57.6IoU). Additionally, ProGuT outperforms existing unsupervised methods for class-agnostic trunk instance benchmark.

</details>


### [85] [DiffReID: Discriminative Diffusion Model for Object Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36894)
*Yingquan Wang,Pingping Zhang,Dong Wang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DiffReID框架，利用判别式扩散模型结合CLIP，通过视觉引导噪声生成、轻量去噪和互增强约束，学习身份感知的特征分布并生成身份不变特征，在五个ReID基准上取得优于多数SOTA方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物体ReID方法因数据集规模与多样性有限而泛化性不足，且当前模型倾向于提取语义模式，而非学习身份感知的特征分布，导致特征的身份判别能力与鲁棒性受限。

Method: 基于CLIP模型通过提示微调获得身份感知文本特征；提出Vision-guided Noise Generator（VNG）初始化概率噪声并逐步破坏文本特征；以视觉特征为条件，提出Light Weight Denoiser（LWD）逐步去噪受损文本特征以学习身份感知分布；从随机采样的视觉引导噪声生成身份不变引导特征；最后提出Mutual Enhancement Constraint（MEC）促进视觉特征与引导特征互学习，提升表示鲁棒性与判别性。

Result: 在五个物体ReID基准上的大量实验表明，该方法的效果优于大多数最先进方法，源代码已开源于 https://github.com/AWangYQ/DiffReID。

Conclusion: DiffReID通过扩散式特征学习与CLIP身份感知文本引导，实现身份不变特征生成与分布学习，有效缓解泛化不足和语义偏向问题，验证了扩散模型在ReID中的有效性。

Abstract: As a fundamental image processing task, object Re-Identification (ReID) aims to retrieve objects across non-overlapping cameras. Recently, with the development of deep learning, significant advancements have been made in object ReID. However, most existing methods suffer from generalization due to the limited size and diversity of ReID datasets. Meanwhile, current models tend to focus on extracting semantic patterns rather than learning identity-aware feature distributions. To address these issues, we propose a novel feature learning framework named \textbf{DiffReID} for object ReID. It leverages a discriminative diffusion model to gradually learn identity-aware distributions and generate identity-invariant features. More specifically, with the Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model, we first obtain identity-aware text features by prompt tuning. Then, we propose a Vision-guided Noise Generator (VNG) to initialize probabilistic noises and gradually corrupt identity-aware text features. Afterwards, we take visual features as conditions and propose a Light Weight Denoiser (LWD) to denoise the corrupted text features step-by-step for identity-aware distribution learning. To obtain discriminative features, we further generate identity-invariant guided features from randomly sampling visual-guided noises. Finally, we propose a Mutual Enhancement Constraint (MEC) to facilitate mutual learning between visual features and guided features to enhance the representation robustness and discrimination. Extensive experiments on five object ReID benchmarks demonstrate that our method shows better results than most state-of-the-art methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/AWangYQ/DiffReID.

</details>


### [86] [SafeVantage: Vantage-Aware Memory for Reliable Embodied Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36906)
*Sean Hardesty Lewis,Zuyi Guo,Benwang Chen,Zirui Liu,Hongyi Lin,Heye Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SafeVantage：一种"视点感知"语义记忆与主动采集框架，为每条断言保留支撑视角、相机位姿和估计目标位置，利用可学习候选可观测性模型预测目标可见性，并以终端决策损失期望下降引导视角选择，最终经校准头输出 Yes/No/Abstain。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分可观测条件下的具身决策需要信息量充分的观测与证据支撑，但单纯的语义分数无法说明哪些视角支撑某项断言、以及应去何处补充证据；关键缺口在于缺少断言级的视角证据与主动采集机制的衔接。

Method: 1) 视点感知语义记忆：保留每条断言的支撑视角、相机位姿与估计目标位置，将正向支撑与搜索覆盖度分离；2) 基于断言锚定几何的可学习候选可观测性模型，预测可达视点处目标可见性；3) 以终端决策损失的期望下降为准则进行视角选择，并计入移动成本与几何上不同的佐证；4) 校准头融合支撑、空间一致性与覆盖度，输出 Yes/No/Abstain。

Result: 在覆盖 232 个未见 ProcTHOR 房屋、每方法与动作预算 7,424 对配对的类别存在性基准上：相比验证集选出的等预算基线，8 与 12 动作预算下 macro-F1 分别提升 24.7% 与 12.0%，两种预算下风险更低、回答率更高，8 动作时移动距离减少 31.7%；等输入 HM3D 实验显示固定观测下选择性风险更低；受控 ScanNet 干预表明恢复支撑视角可提升下游 VLM 回答质量；消融验证候选可观测性对决策质量与采集效率的贡献。

Conclusion: 结果表明，断言级视角证据对于连接语义记忆、主动采集与可靠决策具有重要价值，能在有限动作预算下提升决策可靠性并降低采集开销。

Abstract: Reliable embodied decisions under partial observability require informative observations and sufficient supporting evidence. However, semantic scores alone do not reveal which viewpoints justify a claim or where additional evidence should be acquired. We introduce SafeVantage, a vantage-aware semantic memory and active acquisition framework that retains each claim's supporting views, camera poses, and estimated target location, keeping positive support distinct from search coverage. A learned candidate-observability model uses claim-grounded geometry to predict target visibility at reachable viewpoints. These predictions guide view selection through expected reduction in terminal decision loss, accounting for travel cost and geometrically distinct corroboration. A calibrated head then combines support, spatial consistency, and coverage to produce Yes, No, or Abstain decisions. We evaluate SafeVantage on a category-presence benchmark spanning 232 unseen ProcTHOR houses and 7,424 paired episodes per method and action budget. Compared with validation-selected equal-budget baselines, SafeVantage achieves macro-F1 gains of 24.7% and 12.0% at eight and twelve actions, respectively, with lower risk and higher answer rates at both budgets and 31.7% less travel at eight actions. Equal-input HM3D experiments show lower selective risk under fixed observations, while controlled ScanNet interventions show that restoring supporting views improves downstream VLM answers. Ablations further support the contribution of candidate observability to decision quality and acquisition efficiency. Results demonstrate the value of claim-level viewpoint evidence for connecting semantic memory, active acquisition, and reliable decision-making. Code is available at https://safevantage.github.io

</details>


### [87] [Representation Dynamics Reveal Semantic Saliency and Similarity for Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36916)
*Weixuan Li,Zikun Zhou,Xinyi Zhuang,Xinyan Guo,Rui Tian,Chuyao Zhang,Lin Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文分析多模态大模型视觉token的表征动态，发现更新幅度与前景显著性的关系随深度变化，且更新方向相似度更能区分同类/异类token，据此提出免训练剪枝方法MSDG-Prune。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM因长视觉token序列导致高推理延迟；现有剪枝方法多用注意力图或输出特征估计token重要性，虽有工作利用表征变化，但"这些变化何时、如何反映前景显著性与语义一致性"尚不清晰。

Method: 深入分析视觉token沿编码器深度的表征动态，得到两点发现：(1) token更新幅度与前景显著性的关系是层依赖的，大更新集中在两个深度区间的额前景区域，中间若干层被sink主导；(2) token更新方向之间的相似度比编码器输出特征相似度更能区分同类与异类token。据此提出免训练方法MSDG-Prune：按更新方向相似度对token分组，并用选定深度窗口内由更新幅度导出的query加权显著性进行组级token剪枝。

Result: 在四种MLLM上实验验证了有效性与泛化性。在LLaVA-NeXT上，仅用5.6%的视觉token即可平均保留91.9%的未压缩性能，预填充加速7.8倍。

Conclusion: 视觉token的更新幅度与方向动态为识别显著性和语义一致性提供了优于注意力/输出特征的新信号；基于此的MSDG-Prune以极低token保留率实现近无损性能并显著加速，具备良好通用性。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur high inference latency from long visual token sequences. Existing pruning methods commonly use attention maps or output features to estimate token importance or redundancy. Several recent approaches also exploit representation changes, but when and how these changes reflect foreground saliency and semantic consistency remain insufficiently understood. We analyze visual token representation dynamics across encoder depth and uncover two findings. First, the relationship between token update magnitudes and foreground saliency is layer-dependent: large token updates concentrate on foreground regions in two depth intervals, separated by several sink-dominated layers at intermediate depths. Second, similarities between token update directions better distinguish same-class from different-class tokens than those between encoder output features. Building on these findings, we propose MSDG-Prune, a training-free method that uses update magnitudes and directions to preserve salient and diverse visual information. Specifically, we group tokens by update-direction similarity and use query-weighted saliency derived from update magnitudes across a chosen depth window for group-wise token pruning. Extensive experiments across four MLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of MSDG-Prune. On LLaVA-NeXT, it retains 91.9% of uncompressed performance on average with only 5.6% of visual tokens, while achieving a 7.8x prefilling speedup. Code is available at https://github.com/liweixuan-hitsz/MSDG-Prune.

</details>


### [88] [Seg3DParts: Segmentation-Grounded Controllable Part-Level 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36918)
*Jiantao Lin,Meixi Chen,Yingjie Xu,Chenbo Fu,Leyi Wu,Hao Chen,Yinchuan Li,Ying-Cong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Seg3DParts：以分割为显式锚定信号，结合跨部件结构化交互，从单图可控生成部件级3D资产，并发布PartObjectNet数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部件级3D资产对编辑、重组与交互至关重要，但从单张图像恢复此类结构面临遮挡、边界模糊和多部件一致性推理等难题。现有方法难以兼顾可控的部件级生成与连贯的多部件结构，因为部件身份与空间分配通常是隐式推断的。

Method: 提出Seg3DParts框架，将分割作为显式锚定信号，在生成过程中定义部件身份，使每个组件锚定到对应图像区域；引入结构化跨部件交互，让各部件在整个生成过程中交换全局上下文；从而直接在共享规范空间中生成对齐良好的部件网格，无需后处理对齐，并支持灵活可控的分解。同时构建PartObjectNet大规模数据集（超20万物体、100万标注部件）。

Result: 实验表明，Seg3DParts在几何质量、跨部件一致性和部件级可控性方面优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 以分割作为显式锚定并配合跨部件结构化交互，可实现无需后处理对齐的可控部件级3D生成，并借助大规模部件标注数据集验证其有效性。

Abstract: Part-level 3D assets are essential for editing, reassembly, and interaction, yet recovering such structure from a single image remains challenging due to occlusion, ambiguous boundaries, and the need for coherent multi-part reasoning. Existing approaches struggle to achieve both controllable part-level generation and coherent multi-part structure, as part identity and spatial allocation are typically inferred implicitly. We present Seg3DParts, a segmentation-grounded framework for controllable part-level 3D generation from a single image. By treating segmentation as an explicit grounding signal, our method defines part identity during generation, enabling each component to be anchored to a corresponding image region. To ensure coherent assemblies, we introduce structured cross-part interaction that allows components to exchange global context throughout the generative process. As a result, Seg3DParts directly generates well-aligned part meshes in a shared canonical space without post-hoc alignment, supporting flexible and controllable decomposition. We further introduce PartObjectNet, a large-scale dataset with over 200K objects and 1M annotated parts. Experiments demonstrate that Seg3DParts achieves superior geometry quality, cross-part coherence, and part-level controllability over existing methods.

</details>


### [89] [SFE-VGGT: Source-Free VGGT Distillation for Event-Based Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36929)
*Thai Duy Nguyen,Addison Lin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SFE-VGGT，一种无源框架，无需配对 RGB 图像即可将 VGGT 的几何先验蒸馏到事件域，用于事件相机深度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件深度估计方法依赖跨模态蒸馏，但训练时需要同步的 RGB-事件对或深度标注，严重限制了实际部署。

Method: 从目标事件流重建代理帧作为冻结的几何教师，消除对真实源 RGB 的需求；引入可靠性感知蒸馏策略，包括密度感知特征蒸馏、置信度加权深度蒸馏，以及跨帧关系一致性损失以利用可靠帧间对应关系保证时序几何稳定性。

Result: 在标准条件下精度接近依赖 RGB 的基线，在夜间场景显著超越；MVSEC 夜间序列上平均 10 m 深度误差较 EventVGGT 降低 15.3%；在真实数据集上具有稳健的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 证明可仅用严格无源监督将高效几何先验迁移到事件相机。

Abstract: Recent event-based depth estimation methods successfully transfer geometric priors from vision foundation models via cross-modal distillation. However, their reliance on synchronized RGB-event pairs or depth annotations during training severely restricts practical deployment. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose SFE-VGGT, a novel source-free framework that distills the geometric priors of VGGT to the event domain without any paired RGB observations. Our core idea is to reconstruct surrogate frames directly from the target event stream to act as a frozen geometric teacher, entirely eliminating the need for genuine source RGB data. Crucially, as these surrogate frames inherently yield imperfect and spatially varying supervision, directly distilling from them propagates artifacts. To resolve this, we introduce a novel reliability-aware distillation strategy. This includes Density-Aware Feature Distillation to emphasize informative event regions, and Confidence-Weighted Depth Distillation to dynamically regulate supervision based on relative teacher-student prediction confidence. Meanwhile, we propose a Cross-Frame Relational Consistency loss that enforces temporal geometric stability using reliable inter-frame correspondences, bypassing the need for temporally consistent teacher's depth. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, despite source-free, our SFE-VGGT closely matches the accuracy of RGB-dependent baselines under standard conditions and significantly surpasses them in challenging nighttime scenarios. Across MVSEC nighttime sequences, SFE-VGGT reduces the average 10 m depth error by 15.3% compared with EventVGGT. Moreover, our method exhibits robust zero-shot generalization across real-world datasets, proving that highly effective geometric priors can be transferred to event cameras using strictly source-free supervision.

</details>


### [90] [WeLike2Party! In-Context Motion Transfer for Multi-Human Image Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36937)
*Sangeyl Lee,Seunghyun Shin,Seungho Park,Wooseok Jeon,Hae-Gon Jeon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 WeLike2Party 多人物图像动画框架，基于直接上下文视频条件生成，无需显式姿态或网格，配合两项条件/监督设计及 MotionTwin 数据集与基准，在多人物遮挡场景下优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多人交互场景下的高保真图像动画仍具挑战。现有方法多依赖2D骨架或参数化人体网格等显式运动表示，在人际遮挡下难以保持身份与运动的绑定关系。

Method: 提出 WeLike2Party 框架，基于直接 in-context 视频条件建模，推理时不做显式姿态或网格提取；引入 Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning 保留细粒度外观细节，以及 Identity Binding Supervision 关联参考身份与目标运动轨迹。并构建 MotionTwin 合成数据集（14.4K 跨身份视频对，共84.3小时）及 MotionTwin-Bench 基准。

Result: 在 MotionTwin-Bench 与真实视频上的大量实验表明，WeLike2Party 在主体级视觉保真度、身份-运动绑定和整体感知质量上优于近期最先进方法，尤其在存在显著遮挡的多人物交互场景中。

Conclusion: 通过免显式运动的上下文条件建模与身份绑定监督，可有效提升多人物遮挡场景下的动画保真度与身份-运动一致性；配套数据与基准为该方向提供了评测支撑。

Abstract: Human image animation aims to transfer motion from a driving video to subjects in a reference image. Despite remarkable progress in video generation, achieving high-fidelity animation of multiple interacting subjects remains a challenge. Many existing approaches rely on explicit motion representations such as 2D skeletons or parametric body meshes and struggle to preserve identity-motion binding under inter-person occlusion. To address this limitation, we propose WeLike2Party, a multi-human animation framework built on direct in-context video conditioning without explicit pose or mesh extraction at inference. We further introduce Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning to preserve fine-grained appearance details, and Identity Binding Supervision to associate each reference identity with its intended motion trajectory. To support cross-identity training, we construct MotionTwin, a large-scale synthetic dataset comprising 14.4K cross-identity video pairs with shared subject and camera motions, totaling 84.3 hours of photorealistic video. We additionally present MotionTwin-Bench, a cross-identity benchmark specifically designed to evaluate subject-level visual fidelity and identity-motion binding. Extensive experiments on MotionTwin-Bench and real-world videos demonstrate that WeLike2Party outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods in subject-level visual fidelity, identity-motion binding, and overall perceptual quality, particularly in multi-person interactions with substantial occlusion.

</details>


### [91] [DispFlow-GS: Displacement Flow Supervision with Motion Disentangling for Monocular Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36940)
*Thai Duy Nguyen,Haitian Zhang,Addison Lin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出基于高斯流的光流对齐监督存在域差问题，提出以"位移流"（将逐高斯3D位移splat到图像平面）为核心的监督框架，并通过中间视角渲染解耦场景运动与相机运动；同时揭示运动保真度与图像指标的不一致，提出运动感知指标DRC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态场景重建对机器人感知至关重要，需要时间一致的表示。现有可变形3DGS方法通过将渲染的高斯流与光流对齐来引入运动监督，但作者发现这种监督对运动建模的提升有限，根源在于"渲染高斯流"与"光流"之间存在域差（domain gap），导致优化信号不可靠。

Method: 1）提出基于"位移流"（Displacement Flow）的运动监督框架：将逐高斯的3D位移直接splat到图像平面，提供直接且稳定的优化信号，规避高斯流与光流的域差；2）通过中间视角渲染（intermediate-view rendering）解耦场景运动与相机运动，获得更可靠的运​​动先验，并对形变与几何施加针对性约束；3）提出形变-渲染一致性指标DRC（Deformation-Rendering Consistency），衡量预测形变与渲染改善之间的对齐程度。

Result: 在动态场景基准上，运动定位精度与运动-渲染一致性分别最高提升约39%和6%，而图像类指标仅变化约0.1%，验证了运动保真度与图像评价之间的错配现象。

Conclusion: 基于高斯流的监督受域差制约，改用位移流监督并结合中间视角解耦可显著提升运动建模；同时表明图像指标不足以反映运动质量，DRC对运动感知评价具有重要意义。

Abstract: Accurate dynamic scene reconstruction is important for robotic perception, where temporally consistent representations of dynamic environments are essential. Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models dynamic scenes through deformation fields, and recent methods incorporate motion supervision by aligning rendered Gaussian flow with optical flow. However, we find that such Gaussian-flow-based supervision provides only limited improvements in motion modeling. We identify a fundamental limitation of this supervision paradigm, namely a domain gap between rendered Gaussian flow and optical flow. To address this limitation, we propose a motion supervision framework built on Displacement Flow, which splats per-Gaussian 3D displacements onto the image plane to provide direct and stable optimization signals. We further disentangle scene motion from camera motion via intermediate-view rendering, enabling more reliable motion priors and targeted constraints on deformation and geometry. We also observe a discrepancy between motion fidelity and image-based evaluation, where improved motion awareness does not necessarily translate into better rendered image quality or higher image-based metric scores. Motivated by this mismatch, we introduce Deformation-Rendering Consistency (DRC), a motion-aware metric that measures the alignment between predicted deformation and rendering improvement. Experiments on dynamic scene benchmarks show substantial improvements in motion localization and motion--rendering consistency, reaching up to 39% and 6%, respectively, while image-based metrics change by only about 0.1%. These results confirm the observed mismatch between motion fidelity and image-based evaluation, demonstrating the significance of DRC for motion-aware evaluation.

</details>


### [92] [Beyond Readability: Evaluating Task Information Recoverability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36957)
*Yiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文区分"直接视觉可读性"与"任务信息可恢复性"，提出一种明确观测、查询、目标与可用知识的评估视角，度量不同恢复路径成功集合的重叠，并以书封面实验验证实体关联路径可恢复超出直接视觉边界的信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接视觉可读性与任务信息可恢复性是两种不同的量。目标无法从固定观测中直接解码，并不意味着无法通过其他恢复路径获取该目标。因此需要一种显式化观测、查询、目标与可用知识的评估框架，来刻画不同恢复路径之间的关系，而不是仅以直接可读性评判视觉退化。

Method: 提出评估视角，明确观测、查询、目标与可用知识，并测量不同路径成功集合的重叠。区分两类恢复路径：（1）直接光学恢复，在合适成像条件下从图像直接读取目标，可选经过复原处理；（2）实体关联恢复，利用残余视觉证据识别所描绘实体，再通过指定知识资源中的实体—属性关系访问目标，该访问可依托存储知识或外部来源。用受控书封面研究实例化外部访问，采用固定的标题—作者目录，在分辨率退化条件下比较光学作者恢复与"视觉标题解析+确定性查找"。

Result: 实体关联路径的成功在所测试的多个视觉—语言模型上持续存在，揭示出超出所测直接视觉边界的信息可访问性，尽管各模型绝对性能差异显著；同时仍存在一个较大的仅光学可恢复区域。两类结果互补。

Conclusion: 视觉退化应通过"沿指定路径与知识资源可访问的任务信息"并结合直接可读性来评估，而非仅看直接可读性。直接可读性与任务信息可恢复性应被分别考量。

Abstract: Direct visual readability and task-information recoverability are different quantities. Failure to decode a target from a fixed observation need not eliminate access to that target through another recovery route. We develop an evaluation perspective that makes the observation, query, target, and available knowledge explicit and measures the overlap between routes' success sets. For information available on the original visible surface under suitable imaging conditions, direct optical recovery reads the target from the image, optionally after restoration; entity-linked recovery uses residual visual evidence to identify the depicted entity and accesses its target through an entity--attribute relation in a specified knowledge resource. Such access can draw on stored knowledge or an external source. A controlled book-cover study instantiates external access with a fixed title--author catalog, comparing optical author recovery with visual title resolution and deterministic lookup under resolution degradation. Entity-linked successes persist across the tested vision--language models, revealing information access beyond the tested direct visual frontier despite substantial differences in absolute performance. A substantial optical-only region remains. These complementary outcomes show why visual degradation should be evaluated through the task information accessible along specified routes and knowledge resources, alongside direct readability.

</details>


### [93] [Prior-Driven Enhancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting: Normals and Depths Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36969)
*Gyeonggwan Lee,Seunghwan Hong,Junghun Suh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对3DGS因依赖SfM稀疏点与视角相关属性导致的几何不准与视觉伪影问题，本文引入表面法线与稠密深度先验进行正则化优化，提升复杂场景的几何精度与渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS渲染高效且视觉质量高，但其优化依赖SfM初始稀疏点云与视角相关属性，在复杂场景中易产生几何不准确与视觉伪影，需要引入额外几何约束以提升重建鲁棒性。

Method: 提出改进的3DGS优化框架，在优化过程中融合几何先验：1）表面法线正则化，使高斯协方差与局部表面结构对齐以增强几何一致性；2）稠密深度先验结合SfM初始点，改善逐像素深度估计，提高精度并减少歧义。

Result: 在街景场景与高反射环境等挑战性数据集上，跨多个SfM管线进行评测，结果显示方法兼容性强，能减少视觉失真并提升几何精度与视觉质量。

Conclusion: 融合表面法线与稠密深度正则化的3DGS可有效处理多样复杂真实场景，为复杂环境下的实时3D场景渲染提供可靠方案。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a state-of-the-art technique for 3D scene rendering, offering high efficiency and excellent visual quality. However, because 3DGS relies on an initial sparse point set from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and view-dependent properties, it can suffer from geometric inaccuracies and visual artifacts, particularly in complex scenes. To address these challenges, we propose an improved 3DGS approach that regularizes the optimization process by integrating geometric priors, including surface normals and dense depth information. Surface normal regularization improves geometric consistency by aligning Gaussian covariance with local surface structures, while dense depth priors combined with an initial points from SfM enhance per-pixel depth estimation, increasing accuracy and reducing ambiguities. These enhancements enable robust handling of diverse and complex real-world scenarios, minimizing visual distortions and improving reconstruction quality across various environments. To validate our method, we evaluate it on challenging datasets, including street-view scenes and highly reflective environments, while testing it across multiple SfM pipelines. Our results demonstrate compatibility across diverse environments and highlight the robustness of our approach. Experimental findings further show that our method enhances geometric accuracy and visual quality, establishing a reliable solution for real-time 3D scene rendering in complex environments.

</details>


### [94] [Structured Visual Target Learning For Cross-Subject eeg-to-image retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36971)
*Salini Yadav,Taveena Lotey,Mickaël Coustaty,Pravendra Singh,Partha Pratim Roy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文从视觉目标表示角度解决跨被试EEG到图像检索问题，提出保留空间信息的学习式视觉视图聚合目标，并引入免训练的表征细化，在THINGS-EEG2上取得领先结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨被试EEG-to-image检索要求源被试上训练的神经表征对未见被试仍与视觉嵌入空间对齐。现有方法主要从EEG端入手，本文转而从视觉目标端解决该问题。

Method: 保留Perception Encoder的空间信息，将其patch网格转换为紧凑的学习式视觉视图集合，并用块结构、内容依赖的路由器为每张图像聚合视图；目标端与EEG编码器通过对比学习联合训练，并施加源被试间的MMD正则。部署阶段提出免训练的表征细化，在不更新任何编码器的情况下对齐冻结嵌入。

Result: 在THINGS-EEG2上采用留一被试评估，结构化目标达到35.3%/65.6%的Top-1/Top-5准确率，为对比方法中最优；表征细化将其提升至48.1%/77.1%，相比最强对比方法Top-1提升18.5%，并在全部十个留出被试上均有改善。

Conclusion: 从视觉目标端构建结构化、内容依赖的视图聚合表示，结合对比学习与MMD正则，并辅以免训练表征细化，可有效提升跨被试EEG-to-image检索的泛化性能。

Abstract: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval requires a neural represen- tation trained on source subjects to remain aligned with a visual embedding space for an unseen subject. Whereas existing methods primarily focus on the EEG side, we address this problem from the perspective of the visual target. Our approach preserves the spatial information of the Perception Encoder, converts its patch grid into a compact set of learned visual views, and aggregates them for each image with a block-structured, content-dependent router. The target is learned jointly with the EEG encoder through contrastive learning with MMD regularization across source subjects. For deployment, we propose a training-free representation refinement that aligns frozen embeddings without updating either encoder. Under leave- one-subject-out evaluation on THINGS-EEG2, the structured target achieves 35.3%/65.6% Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, the best among com- pared methods. Refinement raises this to 48.1%/77.1%, an 18.5% Top-1 gain over the strongest compared method, improving all ten held-out subjects.

</details>


### [95] [A Dual-Track Curation-and-Classification Framework for Resolving Ground-Truth Label Noise in Operational Sentinel-2 Wheat Area Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36975)
*Kasimali Agharia,Ujjwal Kumar Gupta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究针对行政记录与遥感分类产品之间的小麦种植面积不一致问题，利用2022年Rabi季Punjab省Patiala区的13期Sentinel-2 NDVI时序，构建849个样本的参考数据集，比较了1D-CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM与XGBoost四种分类器，XGBoost测试精度最高（78.82%），全量部署精度达86.31%、召回率71.05%，预测面积与官方统计仅偏差+2.99%，而政府空间参考掩膜偏差达+25.11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业务化小麦种植面积估算长期受制于行政记录与遥感分类产品之间的不一致（administrative reference discordance），即统计表格面积与空间参考掩膜对同一目标区域的表述存在系统性偏差。作者旨在解决标签噪声情境下的作物面积核对问题，并检验常用作验证依据的政府空间产品本身是否可靠。

Method: 研究区为印度Punjab省Patiala区2022年Rabi季，使用13个时相的Sentinel-2 NDVI时序。通过迭代式规则引导自举（rule-based bootstrapping）构建849个样本的参考数据集。特征敏感性分别以Cohen's d和梯度提升信息增益独立评估。在固定的679/170训练-测试划分下，对比1D-CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM混合模型与XGBoost；随后在全区36.25百万有效像元上部署业务分类器。

Result: 特征敏感性两种独立方法一致指向2月至3月的灌浆期（grain-fill window）判别力最强。XGBoost整体精度最高（78.82%），优于深度学习基线（64–66%），符合树集成在低样本条件下参数-样本比更优的特性。全量部署精度86.31%、召回率71.05%；预测小麦面积相对官方表格目标仅偏差+2.99%，而政府空间参考掩膜对同一目标呈+25.11%的正向面积偏差。

Conclusion: 该不对称性表明，基于人工审核式参考集训练的" curator-curated"分类器与官方表格面积的一致性，优于通常用于验证它的空间产品。作者将该"双轨治理-分类"（dual-track curation-and-classification）框架作为标签噪声环境下作物面积核对的方法学参考。

Abstract: Operational estimation of wheat-cultivated area is persistently constrained by discordance between administrative record-keeping and remotely sensed classification products. We address this administrative reference discordance for the 2022 Rabi season in Patiala district, Punjab, India, using a thirteen-timestep Sentinel-2 NDVI time series. A curated 849-sample reference dataset, developed through an iterative rule-based bootstrapping procedure, underpins both a feature sensitivity analysis and an operational classifier. Feature sensitivity independently assessed via Cohen's d and gradient-boosted information gain converges on the February-to-March grain-fill window as most discriminative. Four classifiers (1D-CNN, LSTM, hybrid CNN-LSTM, and XGBoost) were benchmarked on an identical 679/170 sample split. XGBoost achieved the highest overall accuracy (78.82%) against deep-learning baselines (64-66%), consistent with tree-based ensembles' favourable parameter-to-sample ratio in low-sample regimes. At full-population deployment across 36.25 million valid district pixels, the operational classifier attained 86.31% precision and 71.05% recall. The predicted wheat extent deviated by only +2.99% from the official tabular target, whereas the government's spatial reference mask exhibited a +25.11% positive area bias against the identical target. This asymmetry indicates that a classifier trained on an auditor-curated reference set reconciles more closely with the official tabular area than the spatial product conventionally used to validate it. We present this dual-track curation-and-classification framework as a methodological reference for crop-area reconciliation in label-noisy administrative settings.

</details>


### [96] [UltraMatch: Transport Path Routing for Ultra-Fast and Memory-Efficient Image Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36980)
*Jiajun Le,Yifan Lu,Zizhuo Li,Lei Cao,Junjun Jiang,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UltraMatch 提出"传输路径路由"机制，仅对少量候选路径进行 token 级匹配，绕过稠密匹配的二次复杂度，实现更省内存、更可扩展的半稠密匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有半稠密匹配器中，粗匹配阶段因稠密 token 级匹配而计算与内存开销巨大，成为精度与效率提升之外的瓶颈；且高分辨率下显存需求使其难以扩展。

Method: 核心为轻量级 Transport Path Router，在粗块表示上为每个源块对候选目标块排序并保留小规模子集，将后续 token 级匹配限制在所选路径上，避免构建完整 token 对匹配矩阵；并设计稀疏全局 Dual-Softmax，仅在路由后的块候选上匹配，同时保持稀疏匹配空间中的全局竞争。此外采用面向部署的结构重参数化特征提取与共享参数的微型精匹配头，降低推理成本与显存。

Result: 在保持半稠密匹配器竞争力精度的同时，比 SuperPoint+LightGlue 快 1.67 倍，峰值推理显存仅 0.44 GiB；单张 RTX 3090 上可推理至 6K 分辨率，而现有半稠密匹配器在 2K 前即显存溢出。该路由策略可迁移至 EDM 与 ELoFTR，实现约 2 倍端到端加速且无精度损失。代码已在 GitHub 开源。

Conclusion: 通过稀疏路径路由替代稠密 token 匹配，可在几乎不损精度的前提下显著降低计算与显存开销，并大幅提升高分辨率可扩展性，且方法具备跨模型迁移能力。

Abstract: Despite recent advances in accuracy and efficiency, coarse matching remains an indispensable yet costly stage in existing semi-dense matchers due to dense token-level matching. We present UltraMatch, an ultra-efficient and scalable semi-dense matching framework that bypasses the quadratic computation and memory cost of dense token-level matching by routing only a small fraction of candidate matching paths. At its core, a lightweight Transport Path Router operates on coarse block representations to rank candidate target blocks for each source block and retain only a small set, restricting subsequent token-level matching to the selected paths and avoiding the construction of the full token-to-token matching matrix. We further design a sparse global Dual-Softmax that performs matching only over the routed block candidates while retaining global competition across the sparse matching space. Beyond matching acceleration, UltraMatch employs deployment-oriented structural reparameterization for feature extraction and a tiny fine matching head with shared parameters, further reducing inference cost and memory consumption. UltraMatch achieves competitive accuracy among semi-dense matchers, while running 1.67$\times$ faster than SuperPoint+LightGlue with only 0.44 GiB peak inference memory. Its scalability enables inference at up to 6K resolution on a single RTX 3090, whereas existing semi-dense matchers run out of memory before reaching 2K. Our routing strategy is also transferable, delivering about 2$\times$ end-to-end speedup in EDM and ELoFTR without accuracy loss. The project repository is available at https://github.com/JiajunLe/UltraMatch.

</details>


### [97] [Salt++: Context-Aligned Post-Training for Few-Step Streaming Multimodal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36995)
*Xingtong Ge,Yutong Wang,Lunjie Zhu,Haitao Lin,Fangyu Lin,Yushi Huang,Xin Zhang,Yi Zhang,Yu Liu,Jun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Salt++ 是一个两阶段后训练框架（因果自流 CSF + 上下文对齐自回归 DMD），解决少步流式音视频生成中因果建模与步数蒸馏的上下文不匹配问题，在 480p 4 步因果设定下显著提升质量，并可扩展至 4 步 1664×960 生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步流式音视频生成需同时具备因果建模与步数蒸馏能力，但标准训练范式存在两个上下文相关的难题：一是 teacher forcing 将干净历史与含噪目标配对，仅通过速度预测间接监督预测性的上下文表征；二是将双向 score 模型直接复用于因果 DMD，会造成生成上下文与评分上下文之间的不匹配。

Method: 提出两阶段后训练框架 Salt++。第一阶段为因果自流（CSF）：利用上下文信息不对称性，固定含噪目标而改变历史，让噪声混合历史的学生模型与干净历史的 EMA 教师模型在中间表征上对齐，通过自监督信号促使学生提取语义信息并改善跨模态对齐。第二阶段为上下文对齐的自回归 DMD：在生成器采样、fake-score 训练与 real-score 评估中共享因果掩码与前缀，在块条件 KL 目标下匹配生成分布与参考分布；借助校准的教师引导，先做干净前缀少步蒸馏，再自适应到生成历史，无需切换目标或额外的 consistency distillation。

Result: 在 480p、相同 4 步因果设定下，Salt++ 在 JavisBench 上的视觉质量与运动质量分别较 OmniForcing 提升 57% 和 45%。另有 scale-wise 后训练阶段将 Salt++ 扩展至 4 步 1664×960 生成，在报告的七项指标中有六项优于双向 LTX-2。

Conclusion: 通过 CSF 与上下文对齐 AR DMD 的两阶段设计，Salt++ 有效缓解了因果流式生成中监督间接与上下文错配的问题，实现了高质量少步流式音视频生成并具备高分辨率扩展能力。

Abstract: Few-step streaming audio--video generation requires both causal modeling and step distillation, yet standard training recipes face two context-related challenges. Teacher forcing pairs clean history with a noisy target, but supervises predictive contextual representations only indirectly through velocity prediction. Meanwhile, directly reusing bidirectional score models in causal Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) creates a mismatch between generation and scoring contexts. We address these challenges with Salt++, a two-stage post-training framework comprising Causal Self-Flow (CSF) and context-aligned autoregressive DMD. CSF exploits contextual information asymmetry by varying the history while keeping the noisy target fixed: a noise-mixed-history student aligns its intermediate representations with those of a clean-history exponential-moving-average teacher. This self-supervised signal encourages the student to extract semantic information and improves cross-modal alignment. Context-aligned AR DMD shares the causal mask and prefix across generator sampling, fake-score training, and real-score evaluation to match generated and reference distributions under a block-conditional KL objective. With calibrated teacher guidance, it performs clean-prefix few-step distillation and then adapts to generated histories without switching objectives or requiring separate consistency distillation. At 480p, Salt++ improves visual and motion quality by 57% and 45% over OmniForcing on JavisBench under the same 4-step causal setting. A separate scale-wise post-training stage extends Salt++ to 4-step $1664\times960$ generation, outperforming bidirectional LTX-2 on six of seven reported metrics. Project page: https://xingtongge.github.io/Saltpp

</details>


### [98] [Parameterized Stripe Attention for Efficient Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37001)
*Xingyu Jia,Baole Ai,Ang Wang,Kang Zhao,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PSA（参数化条带注意力），通过刻画视频DiT注意力中沿时间与空间维度的周期性对角条带结构，将多种稀疏模式统一编码进单一高效的CUDA内核，并结合免训练离线搜索自动确定各注意力头的最优稀疏配置，在HunyuanVideo和Wan 2.1上分别实现1.57倍和1.37倍端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiT）虽能实现高质量视频生成，但推理延迟高，主要瓶颈在于计算开销巨大的全时空注意力。现有稀疏注意力方法面临"灵活性—效率"两难：预定义掩码缺乏灵活性、难以捕捉多样化注意力模式，而运行时动态确定的掩码则会引入额外开销并牺牲硬件效率。作者指出，这一困境的根源在于缺乏对DiT注意力结构的统一刻画。

Method: 1) 结构发现：识别出视频DiT注意力在时间和空间维度上均呈现"周期性对角条带结构"。2) 提出PSA（参数化条带注意力），将观测到的条带规律形式化编码，用统一表示涵盖多样化的注意力模式，从而支持高效掩码生成。3) 该统一表示使单个硬件高效的CUDA内核即可处理所有稀疏模式，达到FlashAttention-3级别的模型FLOPs利用率（MFU）。4) 提出免训练离线搜索算法，在给定误差容忍度下为每个注意力头自动最大化稀疏度，确定最优稀疏配置。

Result: 在HunyuanVideo和Wan 2.1上的实验表明，PSA相较于FlashAttention-3基线分别取得1.57倍和1.37倍的端到端加速，同时视觉质量下降处于可接受范围内。

Conclusion: 视频DiT注意力具有可被统一刻画的周期性对角条带结构；基于该结构设计的PSA将灵活性与硬件效率统一于单一高效内核，并通过免训练离线搜索确定各头最优稀疏配置，在保证可接受视觉质量的同时显著降低视频生成推理延迟。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) enable high-quality video generation but suffer from substantial inference latency, primarily attributable to the computationally expensive full spatio-temporal attention. While sparse attention methods offer potential solutions, existing approaches face an inherent flexibility--efficiency dilemma: predefined masks lack the flexibility to capture diverse attention patterns, while runtime-determined masks introduce overheads and sacrifice hardware efficiency. We identify the lack of a unified structural characterization of DiT attention as a key limitation of existing methods, and establish that video DiT attention exhibits \textbf{periodic diagonal stripe structures} along both temporal and spatial dimensions. To formally encode these structured patterns within a single efficient kernel, we present {\bf PSA}, a parameterized stripe attention that formalizes the observed stripe regularity, unifying diverse attention patterns for efficient mask generation. This unified representation enables a single hardware-efficient CUDA kernel to process all sparse patterns, achieving FlashAttention-3-level Model FLOPs Utilization. To determine optimal sparsity configurations, we propose a training-free offline search algorithm that automatically maximizes sparsity under a specified error tolerance for each attention head. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan~2.1 demonstrate that PSA achieves 1.57$\times$ and 1.37$\times$ end-to-end speedups over FlashAttention-3 baselines, with acceptable visual quality degradation.

</details>


### [99] [Visual Parallel Search: Learning to Search High-Resolution Images with Parallel Tile Inspection and Adaptive Zoom](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37002)
*Xijia Tao,Yihua Teng,Xinyu Fu,Cheng Gong,Ziru Liu,Xudong Xie,Rui Liu,Lingpeng Kong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VPS 是一种视觉并行搜索框架：主智能体先用 grid_search 并行检查图像分块，再自适应调用 zoom_in 获取局部细节，从而缓解高分辨率视觉问答中的证据获取难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率视觉问答常因多模态模型无法获取回答所需的小尺度、空间局部证据而失败；顺序缩放虽可恢复细节，但要求主模型在获得可靠全局概览之前就选定区域。

Method: VPS 框架：主智能体先调用 grid_search，与问题条件化的子智能体并行检查图像分块，再自适应调用 zoom_in；并提出带无提示验证的监督流程，以及用于学习控制器与分块阅读器角色的配对角色专属 GRPO 代理目标。

Result: 在 15 组同模型对比中，VPS 有 14 组优于纯缩放搜索，平均准确率提升最高达 8.0 个百分点，对小规模主模型增益尤为明显；ZoomBench 在测试的各规模上均保持约 3.2 个百分点增益。SFT 在全部五个基准划分上提升观测准确率，其中 HR-Bench 4K 提升 4.17 个百分点。角色专属 RL 重塑搜索行为：仅主模型 RL 将平均工具使用从 2.65 降至 2.11，内部四响应评测 pass@1 相近，但外部准确率变化不一。联合训练揭示局部证据阅读与全局搜索控制之间存在不对称性。

Conclusion: VPS 可作为有效的推理时脚手架，也可作为视觉证据获取中可训练的分解方案。

Abstract: High-resolution visual question answering often fails because a multimodal model does not acquire the small, spatially localized evidence needed to answer a question. Sequential zooming can recover detail, but it asks the main model to choose a region before obtaining a reliable overview. We introduce VPS, a visual parallel-search framework in which a main agent first invokes grid_search to inspect image tiles in parallel with question-conditioned sub-agents, and then adaptively invokes zoom_in PSisual Parallel Search improves mean accuracy over dedicated zoom-only search in 14 of 15 same-model comparisons, with gains up to 8.0 points and especially strong improvements for smaller main models. ZoomBench retains an approximately 3.2-point gain at every tested size. We further develop a supervision pipeline with hint-free verification and a paired role-specific GRPO surrogate for learning the controller and tile-reader roles. SFT improves observed accuracy on all five benchmark splits, including a 4.17-point gain on HR-Bench 4K. Role-specific RL further reshapes search behavior: main-only RL reduces mean tool use from 2.65 to 2.11 with similar pass@1 in an internal four-response evaluation, while external accuracy changes are mixed. Joint training reveals an asymmetry between local evidence reading and global search control. Together, these results support VPS as an effective inference-time scaffold and a trainable decomposition for visual evidence acquisition.

</details>


### [100] [VesselBench-800K: A Large-scale Perception Benchmark for Multimodal Vessel Detection, Counting, and Density Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37003)
*Danfeng Hong,Chenyu Li,Jocelyn Chanussot*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VesselBench-800K，目前全球规模最大的多模态遥感船舶感知基准数据集，含80万张512×512图像，覆盖检测、计数与密度估计任务，并评测多种SOTA模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集多聚焦光学遥感通用目标检测，单模态光学图像在复杂海上场景（云雨天气、昼夜覆盖、成像模态固有局限）下难以有效感知船舶，缺乏多模态船舶感知基准。

Method: 构建VesselBench-800K数据集：80万张512×512图像，光学与SAR多模态配对，来源于多平台、多传感器、多场景、多拍摄高度及合成来源，空间分辨率覆盖4.5m至0.1m；并在其上对大量SOTA检测、计数、密度估计模型进行定性与定量评测。

Result: 完成多模态船舶感知基准构建，并通过定性、定量对比揭示以往未被识别的线索，验证数据集对检测、计数、密度估计任务的支撑能力。

Conclusion: VesselBench-800K有望显著推进海上交通理解，数据集将公开以促进社区发展。

Abstract: Vessel perception from space is crucial for a wide range of maritime applications, from traffic monitoring to environmental protection. However, most existing datasets predominantly focus on general object detection tasks in optical remote sensing (RS) images. Relying solely on single-modality optical RS images proves inadequate for effectively perceiving vessel objects in complex maritime scenarios, where ever-changing weather conditions (e.g., clouds and rain), the need for day-and-night coverage, and the inherent limitations of a single imaging modality pose significant challenges. To fill this gap, we introduce VesselBench-800K, the largest-to-date benchmark dataset on a global scale for vessel perception in multimodal RS images. As its name suggests, VesselBench-800K comprises 800,000 images, each at a resolution of 512x512 pixels, specifically curated for vessel perception tasks such as detection, counting, and density estimation. These multimodal image pairs (i.e., optical, SAR) are collected from diverse platforms, sensors, scenes, shooting heights, and synthetic sources, spanning spatial resolutions from 4.5m to 0.1m. Furthermore, we evaluate numerous state-of-the-art detection, counting, and density estimation models on VesselBench-800K through both qualitative and quantitative comparisons. By revealing previously unrecognized cues, this dataset holds immense potential to significantly advance our understanding of marine traffic. Our VesselBench dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/danfenghong/IEEE_TGRS_VesselBench to support and contribute to community development.

</details>


### [101] [World2Motion: Turning Video World Models into 3D Human Motion Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37004)
*Tu Fangyuan,Xiangyue Zhang,Yiyi Cai,Yichen Peng,Kunhang Li,Bo Zheng,Zhixiang Wang,Kaipeng Zhang,Erwin Wu,Haoran Xie,Haiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: World2Motion 将视频世界模型 Cosmos 3 改造为单阶段场景感知 3D 人体运动生成器：通过构建合成与真实视频—运动配对数据集，并提出 shift-decoupled noise schedule 缓解模态间去噪需求差异与运动抖动，实现文本—运动对齐和场景交互更优、推理速度比两阶段基线快约 3.3 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3D 运动生成器受限于运动数据集的场景覆盖范围，泛化能力不足；而 Cosmos 3 等视频世界模型虽具备更广的环境先验，却不面向全身运动生成，从其生成视频中恢复运动需昂贵的两阶段推理。

Method: 将 Cosmos 3 改造为单阶段 3D 运动生成器，应对配对视频—运动数据稀缺与生成运动时序不稳定两大挑战：（1）构建结合合成视频—运动对与"真实视频+估计 3D 运动"的训练数据集；（2）提出 shift-decoupled noise schedule，在共享去噪进度下为视频与运动分配不同噪声水平，以适配两种模态不同的去噪需求。

Result: 在多源交互基准上，World2Motion 的文本—运动对齐与场景交互表现优于所评估的 3D 运动生成器；交互成功率与两阶段基线相当，同时推理速度约提升 3.3 倍。

Conclusion: 通过将视频世界模型改造为单阶段 3D 运动生成器并结合数据构建与噪声调度设计，World2Motion 在保持交互质量的同时显著提升推理效率，为利用世界模型先验生成场景感知人体运动提供了可行路径。

Abstract: We present World2Motion, a framework that generates scene-aware 3D human motion and corresponding video from a single image and a text prompt. While existing 3D motion generators learn from motion datasets, their generalization is constrained by limited coverage of environments. In contrast, video world models such as Cosmos 3 offer broader environmental priors but are not designed for full-body motion generation; recovering motion from their generated videos requires costly two-stage inference. To address these, we turn Cosmos 3 into a single-stage 3D motion generator. This adaptation has two challenges: the scarcity of paired video--motion data and temporal instability in the generated motion. First, we construct a training dataset combining synthetic video--motion pairs with real videos paired with estimated 3D motion. Second, we propose a shift-decoupled noise schedule that assigns different noise levels to video and motion through shared denoising progress. This design accommodates the different denoising requirements of the two modalities, reducing motion jitter. Experiments on a multi-source interaction benchmark show that World2Motion has better motion--text alignment and scene interaction compared with the evaluated 3D motion generators. It also matches the interaction success rate of the two-stage baseline while achieving approximately 3.3$\times$ faster inference.

</details>


### [102] [Embedded Bi-Temporal Building Damage Assessment for On-Board Data Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37013)
*Thomas Goudemant,Benjamin Francesconi,Marjorie Bellizzi,Adrien Dorise*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于YOLOX孪生检测器的双时相建筑损毁评估流程，通过地面压缩参考影像上注、星上仅下传目标级产品来降低星地链路数据量，并引入隐空间偏移估计与校正模块提升配准鲁棒性，最后在VCK190与Jetson AGX Orin上完成部署评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾后建筑损毁快速评估对应急响应至关重要，但遥感卫星影像的利用受限于上下行链路容量与地面处理延迟，需在星地链路两端压缩信息。

Method: 基于YOLOX构建孪生检测器；地面将灾前参考影像编码为紧凑隐空间（最高64倍压缩）并上注；星上将其与灾后新采集影像比对，仅下传边界框与损毁类别的目标级产品；引入隐空间偏移估计与校正模块，在粗特征层回归全局偏移并重新对齐灾后特征后再融合；最后移植到Xilinx Versal VCK190与NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin。

Result: 在xBD上强压缩参考仍保留大部分检测性能；偏移校正模块显著提升对去配准的鲁棒性，尤其在仅融合变体失效的大偏移下，同时提升标称精度并与最强压缩兼容；核心检测器与压缩可干净移植到两平台，但长程鲁棒性所需算子仅在Jetson GPU上可行，Versal DPU不支持。

Conclusion: 该管线通过双向信息压缩与隐空间配准校正，实现了高效且鲁棒的星上建筑损毁评估，但长程配准鲁棒性对嵌入式硬件算子支持存在依赖。

Abstract: Rapid assessment of building damage after natural disasters is essential to support emergency response. Earth Observation satellites can acquire relevant imagery shortly after an event, but exploitation is limited by uplink and downlink capacity and by ground-processing latency. We address this with a bi-temporal building damage assessment pipeline built on a siamese detector derived from YOLOX, designed to compress information at both ends of the ground/space link. On the ground, pre-disaster reference images are encoded into a compact latent space -- compressed by up to a factor of 64 -- and uplinked to the satellite. On board, this reference is compared with a fresh post-disaster acquisition so that the downlink carries only actionable object-level products, bounding boxes and damage classes, instead of full scenes. This cuts the data exchanged in both directions, while on xBD the strongly compressed reference still preserves most of the detection performance.
  Because on-board acquisitions suffer from residual pre/post co-registration errors, we introduce a latent-space shift estimation and correction module that regresses the global offset from the coarse feature level and realigns the post-disaster features before fusion. It substantially improves robustness to de-registration -- especially under large shifts, where fusion-only variants collapse -- while also raising nominal accuracy and remaining compatible with the strongest compression. We finally port the pipeline to two embedded targets, a Xilinx Versal VCK190 and an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, and report hardware performance (latency, throughput, power efficiency). The core detector and its compression port cleanly to both, but the operators needed for long-range robustness survive only on the Jetson GPU, whereas the Versal DPU does not.

</details>


### [103] [RBF-GNN: Rational Basis Functions for Pseudo-Coordinate based Graph Convolutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37015)
*Paweł Batorski,Abtin Pourhadi,Paul Swoboda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RBF-GNN，一种基于伪坐标的图神经网络架构，利用欧氏、球面或角坐标引入空间归纳偏置；用有理Padé基函数替代SplineCNN中随维度指数增长的稀疏B样条，并配合样条子空间初始化与保方差权重重缩放，在关键点匹配、形状匹配、事件相机视觉任务上取得改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SplineCNN中基于稀疏激活的B样条基函数数量随维度指数增长，效率低下，限制了其在高维坐标场景下的可扩展性。

Method: RBF-GNN在架构上类似SplineCNN，将B样条替换为有理Padé基函数，从而避免基函数数量随维度指数增长；引入样条子空间初始化与保方差权重重缩放以支持有效训练；输入为伪坐标形式的欧氏、球面或角坐标，用以诱导空间归纳偏置。

Result: 在多个使用SplineCNN的流行网络架构上，仅将SplineCNN替换为RBF-GNN即获得改进结果，包括语义关键点匹配、形状匹配和基于事件相机的视觉任务。

Conclusion: RBF-GNN以有理Padé基函数替代稀疏B样条，在保持SplineCNN空间归纳偏置优势的同时提升效率与精度，可作为其通用替代模块；代码将在论文录用后公开。

Abstract: We propose RBF-GNN, a new pseudo-coordinate based graph neural network architecture that takes into account Euclidean, spherical or angular coordinates and uses them to induce a powerful spatial inductive bias. Similar in architecture to SplineCNN, we improve upon the latter by replacing the less efficient sparse-activation based B-splines whose number grows exponentially with dimension by rational Padé basis functions. For effective training we propose a spline-subspace initialization and a variance-preserving weight rescaling. Experimentally, we evaluate on a number of popular neural network architectures that use SplineCNNs. We replace only the SplineCNNs with RBF-GNN. We achieve improved results, including on semantic keypoint matching, shape matching, event based camera computer vision tasks. We will make our implementation publicly available upon acceptance of the paper.

</details>


### [104] [Back2Struct: Making Structured Images Editable Again](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37016)
*Pengyu Yan,Yixin Wu,Yunjie Tian,David Doermann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Back2Struct 直接从结构化图像（图表、流程图等）中恢复对象级 SVG/XML 矢量代码，而非像素级矢量化，并通过监督微调与复合奖励强化学习优化，使输出具备可编译、简洁且视觉忠实等特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化图像本质上是符号化的、可紧凑表示为可编辑格式，但实际中常以位图形式存在，导致无法图形化编辑，用户难以在不手动重建的前提下复用并修改已有图形内容。

Method: 提出 Back2Struct，对输入结构化图像预测语义对象级 SVG/XML 代码，显式编码文本、形状、拓扑与布局。在真值 SVG token 序列上进行监督微调，并进一步引入基于奖励的学习，设计复合奖励联合促进 SVG/XML 可编译性、与参考代码的长度一致性、生成图与真值图的结构或语义相似度。

Result: 实验表明 Back2Struct 在准确率、可编辑性、有效性与用户对齐度上均优于基线。数据集与代码已公开。

Conclusion: 对象级矢量代码恢复结合复合奖励优化可有效将结构化图像转化为实用可编辑的 SVG，满足部署时的有效性、简洁性与视觉保真需求，为图形内容复用提供可行方案。

Abstract: Structured images, such as diagrams, charts, and flowcharts, are inherently symbolic and can be compactly represented in an editable format, yet in practice, they are often rendered as images, and therefore not graphically editable. This mismatch presents a significant challenge for researchers, engineers, and designers who wish to incorporate modified versions of existing graphic content into new materials without manually reconstructing it. In this study, we presentBack2Struct, which "makes structured images editable again" by directly recovering vector graphics code (SVG / XML) from image representations. Given an image of a structured graphic, Back2Struct predicts semantically object-level SVG / XML code that explicitly encodes text, shapes, topology, and layout, rather than performing low-level pixel vectorization. The generated code can be seamlessly imported into tools such as PowerPoint, allowing users to edit, refine, restyle, and reuse graphic content while preserving structural fidelity. Beyond supervised fine-tuning on ground-truth SVG token sequences, we further optimize Back2Struct with reward-based learning to better match deployment-time requirements: the output should be syntactically valid, properly concise, and visually faithful to the input diagram. Specifically, we design a composite reward that jointly encourages SVG / XML compilability, length consistency with the reference code, and structural or semantic similarity between the generated and ground-truth graphics. These complementary signals guide the model to produce SVGs that are not only closer to the training distribution, but also more complete, editable, and renderable in practice. Experiments show that Back2Struct improves accuracy, editability, validity, and user alignment over baselines. Dataset and code are available at: pengyu965.github.io/Back2Struct.github.io

</details>


### [105] [MotionInsight: Diagnosing Object Motion Deficiencies in Generated Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37030)
*Jiahao Zhan,Yongrui Ma,Qunliang Xing,Xuanyu Zhang,Jingqi Tong,Junlin Li,Li zhang,Shijie Zhao,Tianfan Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对视频生成模型普遍存在的物体运动缺陷，提出以物体为中心的运动保真度评估，构建诊断数据集VidMotion并提出诊断评估器MotionInsight，实现三维度评分与可解释诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽进展迅速，但仍存在明显的运动缺陷，常表现为物体运动不正确。然而现有视频质量评估多聚焦美学质量或文本-视频对齐，缺乏对物体运动保真度的针对性评估，该空白亟待填补。

Method: 首先构建VidMotion诊断数据集，包含6,879个带指定运动物体的视频，并提供细粒度标注（分维度得分与失败原因）。进而提出MotionInsight诊断评估器，将评估从隐式RGB帧观察转向显式运动空间诊断：通过构建运动感知表示使细微运动缺陷更易观测，并在GRPO中引入运动特定奖励，将观测到的运动转化为诊断性评估。

Result: 实验表明MotionInsight为诊断物体运动缺陷提供了有效基础，能够在物体一致性、运动连续性、物理合理性三个维度上产生与人类对齐的评分，并给出有依据的解释。

Conclusion: 以物体为中心的运动保真度评估可有效诊断视频生成中的运动缺陷，VidMotion与MotionInsight为运动质量评估提供了数据集与可解释评估方法，弥补了现有评估体系在运动维度上的不足。

Abstract: Despite rapid progress in video generation models, they still exhibit obvious motion deficiencies, often manifested as incorrect object motion. However, most existing video quality evaluations focus on aesthetic quality or text-video alignment. To address this gap, we study object-centric motion fidelity assessment, evaluating target objects along object consistency, motion continuity, and physical plausibility. To achieve this, we first introduce VidMotion, a diagnostic dataset of 6,879 videos with designated moving objects and fine-grained annotations including dimension-wise scores and failure causes. We further propose MotionInsight, a diagnostic evaluator that shifts assessment from implicit RGB-frame observation to explicit motion-space diagnosis. By constructing motion-aware representations, MotionInsight makes subtle motion deficiencies more observable. We also introduce motion-specific rewards during GRPO to transform observed motion into a diagnostic assessment. Experiments demonstrate that MotionInsight provides an effective basis for diagnosing object motion deficiencies, producing human-aligned scores along three dimensions and grounded explanations.

</details>


### [106] [UniBuild: Unified Building Mapping From Multi-Source Optical Remote Sensing Imagery With Detail Decoding and Geometry Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37031)
*Wei Huang,Chenying Liu,Yilei Shi,Xiao Xiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出UniBuild统一建筑物提取框架，通过多数据集联合训练、细节保持解码器与几何感知正则化，提升跨域泛化、边界锐度和相邻建筑分离能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有光学遥感建筑物提取方法多为数据集专用，跨域泛化差；同时细节恢复不足、几何约束弱，导致边界模糊、形状不规则、相邻建筑粘连，实用性受限。

Method: 1）构建异构RGB光学数据集上的统一多数据集训练方案，学习跨传感器、跨分辨率的可迁移建筑物表征；2）设计细节保持的HR-DPT解码器，融合高层语义特征与高分辨率空间特征；3）引入几何感知正则化：基于结构张量的方向感知损失保证边界方向一致性，以及鞍点感知损失抑制低分辨率下狭窄建筑间隙中的伪激活。

Result: 在10个公开高分辨率数据集和2个自采低分辨率数据集上训练与评估，UniBuild在建筑物区域精度、边界锐度和相邻建筑分离度上均有稳定提升，并对未见域具有良好泛化能力，可支持最高10 m分辨率的RGB光学遥感建筑物提取；预测掩膜经简单多边形化可转换为GIS兼容的建筑轮廓。

Conclusion: UniBuild为多源RGB光学遥感影像提供了统一的建筑物提取方案，兼顾跨域泛化与几何质量，并具备向GIS应用转化的实用性；模型与推理代码已开源。

Abstract: Building extraction from optical remote sensing (RS) imagery is fundamental to urban mapping, yet existing methods are often dataset-specific and generalize poorly to unseen domains. Their practical use is also limited by insufficient detail recovery and weak geometric regularization, leading to blurred boundaries, irregular shapes, and merged adjacent buildings. To address these issues, we propose UniBuild, a unified building extraction framework for multi-source RGB optical RS imagery. First, a unified multi-dataset training scheme is constructed over heterogeneous RGB optical datasets to learn transferable building representations across sensors and resolutions. Second, a novel detail-preserving HR-DPT decoder is designed to integrate high-level semantic features with high-resolution spatial features, enhancing building detail recovery. Third, geometry-aware regularization is introduced through a structure-tensor-based direction-aware loss for boundary direction consistency and a saddle-aware loss for suppressing false activations in narrow inter-building gaps under low-resolution conditions. We train and evaluate UniBuild on multi-source RGB optical datasets, including 10 public high-resolution datasets and two self-collected low-resolution datasets. Experiments show that UniBuild consistently improves building-region accuracy, boundary sharpness, and adjacent-building separation across diverse datasets. It also generalizes well to unseen domains and supports practical building extraction from RGB optical RS imagery up to 10\,m resolution. The predicted masks can be further converted into GIS-compatible building footprints through simple polygonization. The trained model and inference code are released at https://github.com/zhu-xlab/UniBuild.

</details>


### [107] [GleanVID: Complementary Token Selection for Efficient Video Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37042)
*Shuo Yang,Changbai Li,Rui Tang,Xinyu Zhao,Linlin Yang,Baochang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GleanVID：一种免训练的视频大语言模型推理加速框架，将视觉token选择视为渐进式证据累积过程，在有限预算下选取兼具个体信息量与跨帧互补性的视觉证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VideoLLM虽具备强大的视频理解能力，但因视觉token数量庞大而带来高昂推理开销。现有token压缩方法多依赖与选择无关的独立打分，忽视了跨帧互补性，导致跨帧保留冗余证据。因此需要一种能在有限token预算下保留信息丰富且互补性强的视觉证据的选择方法。

Method: GleanVID为免训练的推理加速框架。首先依据时间新颖性（temporal novelty）将全局token预算跨帧分配；随后在选择token时联合考虑局部代表性（local representativeness）与子空间互补性（subspace complementarity），从而保留更丰富且冗余更少的视觉证据。

Result: 在多种VideoLLM和基准上实验表明GleanVID持续取得最优性能。仅用25%视觉token时，保留Qwen3-VL原性能的98.6%，并将prefill延迟降低44.7%；在LLaVA-OV-7B上，25%保留率甚至略优于原模型。

Conclusion: 将视频token选择建模为渐进式证据累积过程，并联合跨帧预算分配与代表性的选择策略，能在显著降低推理开销的同时保持甚至超越原模型性能，为VideoLLM的免训练加速提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have achieved strong video understanding capabilities but incur substantial inference overhead due to the large number of visual tokens. Existing VideoLLM token compression methods largely rely on selection-independent scoring, overlooking cross-frame complementarity and consequently retaining redundant evidence across frames. Instead, we view video token selection as a progressive evidence accumulation process. It aims to retain visual evidence that is individually informative and collectively complementary under a limited token budget. Building on this insight, we introduce GleanVID, a training-free inference acceleration framework for VideoLLMs. Specifically, GleanVID first allocates the global token budget across frames according to temporal novelty and then selects tokens by jointly considering local representativeness and subspace complementarity, thereby preserving richer and less redundant visual evidence. Extensive experiments across diverse VideoLLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that GleanVID consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, with only 25% of visual tokens, GleanVID preserves 98.6% of Qwen3-VL's original performance while reducing its prefill latency by 44.7%. On LLaVA-OV-7B, GleanVID at a 25% retention ratio even slightly surpasses the original model.

</details>


### [108] [Speed in the Blind Spot: An Interpretability Analysis of Dynamic Perception in VLMs for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37046)
*Katharina Winter,Stefan Englmeier,Fabian B. Flohr*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文以速度理解为诊断任务，系统评估VLM从视觉输入中恢复动态物理状态的能力，发现潜表征常可解码但语言输出不可靠，驾驶特化仅部分改善运动表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型日益用于自动驾驶系统，但其从视觉输入中恢复动态物理状态的能力尚未被充分刻画，尤其是速度理解这一基础能力，因此需要一个可控诊断来揭示其编码与读出机制。

Method: 在nuScenes上围绕三类任务（周围智能体速度、当前自车速度、短时未来自车速度建议）评估开放权重通用VLM、PhysicalAI VLM及驾驶导向的Alpamayo-1.5 VLA模型，采用多种输入输出形式，并结合语言评估、时间扰动、反事实自车速度提示与隐层线性探针。

Result: 三类任务呈现不同失效模式：周围智能体速度仅以智能体特化形式弱编码；当前自车速度内部可及但语言化差（连续探针MAE 4.7-5.8 km/h vs 语言输出10.2-16.8 km/h）；多帧对单帧无稳定语言增益，帧序几乎未被利用。非优化QLoRA下任务特化微调改善任务相关潜表征与语言读出，但连续周围智能体速度估计仍弱，未来速度增益多在帧打乱后仍存，表明时序接地有限。Alpamayo-1.5对周围智能体与未来自车速度潜表征更强，当前自车速度可解码性相当，探针-语言差距仍显著。

Conclusion: 驾驶特化可增强运动表征，但不保证对场景与自车状态均有更强编码或可靠读出；合理的规划输出并不意味着能可靠恢复或时序接地底层动态状态。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models are increasingly used in autonomous-driving systems, yet their ability to recover dynamic physical state from visual input remains insufficiently characterized. We study velocity understanding as a controlled diagnostic across three tasks: surrounding-agent speed, current ego speed, and short-horizon future ego-speed proposal. On nuScenes, we evaluate open-weight general-purpose and PhysicalAI VLMs, together with the driving-oriented Alpamayo-1.5 Vision-Language-Action model, using multiple input and output formulations. We combine verbal evaluation with temporal perturbations, counterfactual ego-speed hints and linear probes of hidden representations. The tasks exhibit distinct failure modes. Surrounding-agent speed is weakly encoded in an agent-specific form, whereas current ego speed is often internally accessible but poorly verbalized: continuous probes achieve 4.7-5.8 km/h MAE compared with 10.2-16.8 km/h MAE for verbal outputs. Multiple frames provide inconsistent verbal gains to single frame inputs, and frame order is rarely exploited. Under non-optimized QLoRA, task-specific adaptation improves both task-relevant latent speed representations and verbal readout, but continuous surrounding-agent speed estimation remains weak, while most future-speed gains survive frame shuffling, indicating limited temporal grounding. Driving specialized Alpamayo-1.5 shows stronger latent representations for surrounding-agent and future ego speed, while current ego-speed decodability is comparable and substantial probe-verbal gaps remain. Thus, driving specialization can strengthen motion representations but does not guarantee stronger encoding across both scene and ego states or reliable readout. The results show that plausible planning outputs do not necessarily imply reliable recovery or temporal grounding of the underlying dynamic state.

</details>


### [109] [NHO: A Neural Hamiltonian Operator for Anchor-based Region Localization and Dense Correspondance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37048)
*Jing Li,Yawei Luo,Xiangze Meng,Ying Li,Tieru Wu,Rui Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出NHO（神经Hamiltonian算子），用稀疏锚点结合部分形状的内蕴几何学习神经Hamiltonian算子，其局部化特征空间可同时编码区域支撑与内蕴坐标，实现非刚性部分到全局形状对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非刚性部分到全局（partial-to-full）形状对应需先在全表面上定位对应区域，再恢复部分形状与该区域间的稠密对应。稀疏锚点信息不足，会留下空间歧义，难以同时完成定位与稠密匹配。

Method: 将Hamiltonian势参数化为内蕴神经场，利用锚点证据并结合谱约束与几何约束进行优化；引入算子估计与对应恢复之间的相互精化（reciprocal refinement）迭代：每轮中当前特征空间提供谱坐标并把匹配限制在其诱导支撑内，几何可靠的对应反过来为势函数更新提供额外证据；精化后聚合特征函数能量得到最终定位，再用恢复的映射初始化稠密对应精化。

Result: 在区域定位与稠密对应两项任务上均取得有竞争力的精度，并对均匀缩放与旋转具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 以神经Hamiltonian算子为核心、结合稀疏锚点与相互精化机制，可有效解决部分到全局对应的空间歧义问题，兼顾定位与稠密匹配，并具备尺度与旋转不变性。

Abstract: Non-rigid partial-to-full shape correspondence from sparse anchors requires identifying the corresponding region on the full surface and recovering dense correspondences between the partial shape and that region. We present NHO, which combines sparse anchors with the intrinsic geometry of the partial shape to learn a neural Hamiltonian operator whose localized eigenspace encodes both the region support and intrinsic coordinates for dense correspondence. NHO parameterizes the Hamiltonian potential as an intrinsic neural field and optimizes it using anchor evidence together with spectral and geometric constraints. To resolve the spatial ambiguity left by sparse anchors, we introduce reciprocal refinement between operator estimation and correspondence recovery. At each round, the current eigenspace provides spectral coordinates and restricts matching to its induced support, while geometrically reliable correspondences provide additional evidence for updating the potential. After refinement, aggregated eigenfunction energy yields the final localization, and the recovered map initializes dense correspondence refinement. Experiments demonstrate competitive accuracy on both tasks and robustness to uniform scaling and rotation.

</details>


### [110] [OmniRoute: Mapping Temporal Semantic Evidence to Audio-Visual Token Budgets for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37052)
*Yuchen Deng,Zidang Cai,Feidiao Yang,Yufei Wang,Jie Wang,Hai-Tao Zheng,Yuxing Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniRoute——一个免训练、两阶段的音视频token压缩框架，通过时间证据引导预算分配与预算约束语义压缩，在降低长音视频序列预填充成本的同时提升推理效率与性能的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Omni-LLM将音视频流编码为时间交错token序列，长序列的预填充代价高昂。已有压缩方法虽有进展，但常忽视音视频语义相关性的时间变化特性。

Method: 提出免训练两阶段框架OmniRoute。第一阶段TEGB（时间证据引导预算分配）依据语义相关性与局部内容变化，推导分块模态偏好与初始主导模态预算；第二阶段BCSC（预算约束语义压缩）先压缩主导模态，再根据实际保留比例校准跟随模态的保留目标。视频侧结合时空分组与查询引导选择；音频侧基于编码器注意力与查询相关性选择token，并在视觉引导下将残差token合并为上下文锚点。

Result: 在四个代表性基准上实验，相较于竞争性基线，实现了更优的推理效率与性能权衡。

Conclusion: OmniRoute以免训练方式有效压缩长音视频token序列，兼顾效率与性能，代码与接口将开源以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) encode audio and visual streams into temporally interleaved token sequences for multimodal reasoning. However, processing long audio-visual token sequences incurs substantial prefill costs. Existing compression methods have made progress, but often overlook temporal changes in audio-visual semantic relevance. Motivated by temporal variation and local continuity, we propose OmniRoute, a training-free, two-stage compression framework. First, Temporal Evidence-Guided Budgeting (TEGB) derives chunk-wise modality preferences and initial leading-modality budgets from semantic relevance and local content variation. Second, Budget-Constrained Semantic Compression (BCSC) compresses the leading modality and then calibrates the follower's retention target using the actual retained fraction. For video, it combines spatiotemporal grouping with query-guided selection; for audio, it selects tokens based on encoder attention and query relevance, then merges residual tokens into context anchors under visual guidance. Experiments on four representative benchmarks demonstrate a better trade-off between inference efficiency and performance than competitive baselines. The code and interface will be released to facilitate further research.

</details>


### [111] [Spatial-OPSD: Self-Improving Spatial Reasoning via Label-Free Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37055)
*Zhenyu Liu,Zhangquan Chen,Keyi Chen,Mingze Sun,Xiang An,Haodong Jing,Ruqi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Spatial-OPSD，一种无需标签的自改进框架，利用感知与重建工具提供的空间先验进行token级蒸馏，通过轮次递归训练实现VLM空间推理的持续自我提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型日益应用于具身与空间场景，需准确理解深度、视角和三维关系。但现有空间推理改进方法依赖真值答案、答案奖励或其他任务特定监督，成本高且受限。

Method: 采用特权教师-学生蒸馏：教师接收自动可得的空间先验（深度、重建3D关系、相机几何），学生仅见原始视觉语言输入；在学生自采样轨迹上教师提供密集token级监督。进一步采用轮次递归训练：每轮内教师冻结以提供稳定目标，改进后的学生初始化下一轮的教师与学生，重建教师-学生信息不对称性。

Result: 在四个VLM家族上，单轮Spatial-OPSD即稳定提升五基准平均；三轮训练将强空间专用模型推至开源前沿，取得开源模型最高平均分，并在五个空间推理基准中的三个上取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: Spatial-OPSD证明无需真值标签，仅借助自动空间先验即可实现VLM空间推理的重复自改进，且轮次递归设计兼顾稳定教师与持续提升，达到开源领先水平。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly operate in embodied and spatially grounded settings, where accurate understanding of depth, viewpoint, and three-dimensional relations is essential. However, improving spatial reasoning typically relies on ground-truth answers, answer-derived rewards, or other forms of task-specific supervision. We introduce Spatial-OPSD, a label-free self-improvement framework that instead exploits spatial structure naturally available from perception and reconstruction tools. During training, a privileged teacher receives automatically obtainable spatial priors, such as depth, reconstructed 3D relations, and camera geometry, while the student observes only the original visual-language input. On trajectories sampled by the student itself, the teacher provides dense token-level supervision, allowing the student to internalize spatial knowledge without ground-truth answer labels or privileged information at inference time.
  To extend this supervision beyond a single round, we adopt a round-wise recursive training scheme: the teacher remains frozen within each round to provide a stable learning target, and the improved student initializes both teacher and student in the next round, where privileged spatial priors re-establish an informative teacher--student asymmetry. This enables repeated self-improvement while avoiding a rapidly moving teacher during optimization. Across four VLM families, a single round of Spatial-OPSD consistently improves the five-benchmark average, while three rounds further push a strong spatially specialized model to the open-source frontier, achieving the highest average among the open models and the best results on three of five spatial reasoning benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/vermouth599/Spatial-OPSD.

</details>


### [112] [Context without Commitment: Robust Dense Correspondence under Non-Rigid Deformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37071)
*Yuzhen He,Sara Homscheid*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 CoCo-Reg，用区域块（patch）信息丰富稠密点特征，但不用块预测限制最终的点级搜索，在非刚性点云配准上显著降低对应误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非刚性点云配准中，点级匹配虽保留完整目标点云，但在局部几何相似的区域对应关系会变得模糊；区域或由粗到细方法虽提供更大的空间上下文，但一旦区域匹配错误，就会在稠密匹配前排除正确对应。因此需要在利用区域上下文的同时，避免块级预测对最终搜索施加硬性限制。

Method: CoCo-Reg 构建最远点采样（FPS）的区域块，在源与目标内部及之间交换几何信息，使用经身份校正的点重叠度监督块相似性，并将所得区域信息投影回稠密点特征。最终配准阶段仍对完整目标点云打分，再进行全局点级候选选择。

Result: 在 726 个留出的 ModelNet10 对象、九个形变等级上，两个既有学习型基线平均对应误差为 0.1993 和 0.1921，而 CoCo-Reg 为 0.0547，相对其点级基线降低 72.6%；在 92.3% 的配对测试对象上对应误差更低，误差大于 0.1 的点比例均值从 47.3% 降至 17.3%。Chamfer 距离与 HD95 同向下降，且在所有测试形变等级上 CoCo-Reg 均更低。

Conclusion: 结果表明可借助区域上下文实现稠密非刚性对应，而无需对最终搜索施加硬性块级限制。由于评估中每种方法仅使用一个检查点，所报告增益刻画的是完整系统表现，而非单个组件的独立因果贡献。代码将公开。

Abstract: Non-rigid point-cloud registration aims to find the corresponding target point for each point on a deforming source surface. Point-level matching keeps the full target cloud available, but correspondence becomes ambiguous when different regions have similar local geometry. Regional or coarse-to-fine methods provide broader spatial context, but an incorrect regional match can exclude the correct correspondence before dense matching. We propose CoCo-Reg, which uses regional patches to enrich dense point features without allowing patch predictions to restrict the final point-level search. CoCo-Reg constructs farthest-point-sampled patches, exchanges geometric information within and between source and target, supervises patch similarity using identity-corrected point overlap, and projects the resulting regional information back to dense point features. The final registration stage still scores the full target cloud before global point-level candidate selection. On 726 held-out ModelNet10 objects across nine deformation levels, two established learning-based baselines obtain mean correspondence errors of 0.1993 and 0.1921, whereas CoCo-Reg obtains 0.0547. Relative to its point-level baseline, this is a 72.6\% reduction. CoCo-Reg achieves lower correspondence error on 92.3\% of paired test objects and reduces the mean fraction of points with error above 0.1 from 47.3\% to 17.3\%. Chamfer distance and HD95 decrease in the same direction, and CoCo-Reg remains lower across all tested deformation levels. These results support using regional context for dense non-rigid correspondence without imposing a hard patch-level restriction on the final search. Because evaluation uses one checkpoint per method, the reported gains characterize the complete systems rather than the isolated causal contribution of an individual component. Code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [113] [LDM-is-AE: Latent Diffusion Model is an Auto-Encoder for End-to-End Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37080)
*Zhengqiang Zhang,Lingchen Sun,Rongyuan Wu,Qiaosi Yi,Xiangtao Kong,Chaodong Xiao,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示LDM本身即为AE，提出端到端单阶段训练框架LDM-is-AE，消除独立tokenizer，实现扩散原生潜空间，256/512分辨率FID分别达1.80和1.90。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LDM采用两阶段流程（先训练AE定义潜空间，再训练扩散模型），导致表示不匹配：潜空间为重建优化，而非适应去噪动态。

Method: 观察LDM骨干在每步去噪中执行潜空间-特征-潜空间变换，可视作内部解码-编码过程。将DiT骨干拆分为互逆的DiT-E与DiT-D，在所有时间步对中间特征施加图像空间监督，建立显式潜空间-图像-潜空间路径；零噪声时执行图像-潜-图像映射，对应自编码过程，端到端联合学习潜在表示与去噪动态。

Result: 生成性能极具竞争力，256x256与512x512类别条件图像生成FID分别为1.80和1.90。

Conclusion: LDM-is-AE通过端到端联合学习，获得面向生成过程的扩散原生潜空间，无需独立tokenizer，验证了LDM即AE的观点。

Abstract: Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) typically adopt a two-stage pipeline: an auto-encoder (AE) is first pre-trained to define a latent space, then a diffusion model is trained to perform denoising within it. Such a two-stage design introduces a representation mismatch, as the latent space is optimized for reconstruction rather than adapting the denoising dynamics. We reveal that the LDM itself is an AE, and consequently present LDM-is-AE, an end-to-end one-stage LDM training framework that eliminates the need for a separately trained tokenizer. Our key observation is that the LDM backbone actually performs a latent-to-feature-to-latent transformation at each denoising step, which can be interpreted as an internal decoding--encoding process. Leveraging this structure, we split the DiT backbone into two reciprocal components, DiT-E (i.e., DiT Encoding) and DiT-D (i.e., DiT Decoding), and impose image-space supervision on the intermediate features across all timesteps. Our model encourages the internal representation to align with the image domain throughout denoising, thereby establishing an explicit latent-to-image-to-latent path. At the zero-noise timestep, our model further performs an image-to-latent-to-image mapping, corresponding to an auto-encoding process. As a result, LDM-is-AE jointly learns latent representations and denoising dynamics in an end-to-end manner, yielding a diffusion-native latent space tailored to the generation process. Experiments demonstrate that LDM-is-AE exhibits highly competitive generation performance, achieving an FID of 1.80 and 1.90 on 256x256 and 512x512 class-conditional image generation, respectively.

</details>


### [114] [Real2Gym: Building Gyms from Videos, Bringing Skills to Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37089)
*Kerui Ren,Yingxiang Xu,Kaiwen Song,Linning Xu,Bo Dai,Mulin Yu,Tao Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Real2Gym，一个 Real2Sim2Real 智能体框架，将人类和机器人演示视频转化为可交互仿真环境，并在仿真中学习可复用操作技能后迁移至真实机器人，无需更新模型权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实视频蕴含丰富的操作演示，但要将其转化为可复用的机器人技能，需要视觉对齐的环境、可执行的物理交互以及从经验中学习的机制。

Method: Real2Sim 模块重建可编辑场景，对齐物体与相机，通过原生物理执行验证演示或重定向动作，并生成带动作可行性检查的任务条件变体；智能体在其中生成操作阶段的可执行代码、观测结果，并将成功与失败蒸馏为可复用任务流程、物体相对运动与恢复策略；通过共享感知控制接口，这些技能在仿真和真实机器人上指导执行，动作随当前观测自适应，且不更新底层模型权重。
