Abstract: Visual reward models are essential for evaluating and improving visual generation models, yet existing approaches typically map task conditions and candidate outputs directly to scalar rewards, leaving implicit what should be evaluated for each individual case. We introduce Think Before You Score, a paradigm that explicitly determines what matters for each case before judging how well the candidate performs. Following this principle, we propose the Thinking Reward Model (TRM), which formulates case-adaptive rubrics, performs rubric-guided assessment, and produces fine-grained pointwise rewards. We further observe that conventional pairwise preference optimization can induce score polarization, and introduce Pairwise Dual-Group Relative Policy Optimization (PD-GRPO), which leverages pairwise supervision to improve reward discrimination while preserving fine-grained pointwise scoring. Extensive experiments on image generation and editing reward-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that TRM achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source reward models while remaining highly competitive with proprietary alternatives. Moreover, using TRM as a reward for reinforcement learning consistently improves diverse visual generation models, demonstrating that its fine-grained, case-adaptive rewards translate into effective optimization signals for visual generation.

</details>


### [150] [MG-Thinker: Bi-Axial Self-Reflection for Multi-Image Reasoning Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37374)
*Heyu Huang,Chi Chen,Zonghao Guo,Yuhua Li,Maosong Sun,Ruixuan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MG-Thinker后训练RL框架，构建25K任务自适应CoT的MRG数据集，并提出Bi-Axial DAPO以缓解任务-样本难度异质性问题，在多图像推理定位上取得SOTA并提升泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习虽在多模态推理上取得进展，但面向真实多图像上下文、需像素级定位的多图像推理定位（MRG）任务中，现有RL方法忽视了该范式的两个内在特性：由粗到细的层级推理模式，以及任务与样本难度的非均匀分布。

Method: 提出MG-Thinker——一种后训练RL框架，支持具备层级推理特性的新MRG范式，并配套构建含25K样本、带任务自适应思维链（CoT）标注的数据集，引导模型在给出结论前采集多视角证据；针对难度异质性，提出Bi-Axial DAPO（BiA-DAPO），通过两个互补机制在组内信号轴与组间能力轴上分解rollout优势，二者均基于所定义的候选池以获取稳定的组级统计量。

Result: 大量实验表明，MG-Thinker在多图像推理定位任务上达到state-of-the-art水平，同时在多图像理解及多样化多模态基准上持续提升泛化性能。

Conclusion: MG-Thinker通过结合层级推理导向的数据集与改进的RL优势估计方法，有效应对MRG中的层级推理与难度异质两大挑战，验证了该范式在定位精度与跨任务泛化上的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently delivered substantial gains in multimodal reasoning, opening a promising route for fine-grained visual perception. Yet for multi-image reasoning grounding (MRG), reasoning over real-world multi-image contexts toward pixel-precise localization, existing RL-based approaches overlook two characteristics intrinsic to this paradigm: a coarse-to-fine hierarchical reasoning pattern, and heterogeneously distributed task--sample difficulties. In this work, we present MG-Thinker, a post-training RL framework that advances a new MRG paradigm featuring such hierarchical reasoning, supported by a curated 25K MRG dataset with task-adaptive Chain-of-Thought (CoT) annotations that elicit multi-perspective evidence before conclusion. To remedy the heterogeneous task--sample difficulties, we further propose Bi-Axial DAPO (BiA-DAPO), which decomposes rollout advantages along an intra-group signal axis and an inter-group competence axis through two complementary mechanisms, both grounded on our defined candidate pool for stable group-level statistics. Extensive experiments show that MG-Thinker achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-image reasoning grounding while consistently improving generalization across multi-image understanding and diverse multimodal benchmarks.

</details>


### [151] [Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37378)
*Hossein Resani,Javen Qinfeng Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Do-JEPA，通过对同一模拟器状态执行动作 a 与参考动作 a∅ 并回归潜在未来之差 Δz=z^a−z^a∅，在目标函数层面显式分离“因果效应”与“共现”，无需依赖模型可见性的干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在世界模型仅以预测下一时刻为训练目标，其目标函数无法区分动作导致的后果与仅仅共同出现的相关性；已有的对象掩码类方法（如 C-JEPA）干预的是预测器能“看到”什么，而非世界物理上真实发生什么，因此并未真正对齐因果结构。

Method: 从同一保存的模拟器状态出发，分别执行动作 a 与参考动作 a∅，训练模型预测两个潜在未来之间的差值 Δz=z^a−z^a∅。目标由四部分构成：effect loss（效应预测）、support loss（动作进入的位置）、propagation loss（效应传播路径）、invariance losses（不应改变的部分）。

Result: 在对象对齐变量的合成系统中，support 监督在 99.95% 测试用例中定位到被直接干预对象（稀疏动作掩码则全部误投到干扰槽）；响应起始监督恢复出环形传播图，边 AUROC 0.975（对比 0.624）。从像素输入看，effect loss 优于同数据训练的对照：端到端 LeWM 上潜在效应误差降低 28.4%，自然动作序列下物理效应误差降低 13.5%；三个独立生成的 CausalWorld 基准上，物理偏移下响应效应误差降低约 20%，预测效应的潜在上下文敏感度降低 66%。从头训练会损害事实准确性，而对已有模型微调可消除该代价。

Conclusion: 对“世界”本身进行干预而非对模型输入进行干预，能帮助潜在世界模型更准确地预测其动作所产生的因果后果；Do-JEPA 提供了一种目标层面的因果分离机制，并可通过微调无代价地集成到现有模型中。

Abstract: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). In a synthetic system with object-aligned variables, support supervision finds the directly intervened object in 99.95% of test cases, where a sparse action mask sends the action to a nuisance slot in every case, and response-onset supervision recovers the ring-shaped propagation graph (edge AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). From pixels, the effect loss beats a control trained on exactly the same data: it lowers latent effect error by 28.4% on an end-to-end LeWM model and physical effect error by 13.5% when trained and tested on natural action sequences, and on three independently generated CausalWorld benchmarks it lowers responsive effect error by about 20% under physics shifts and the latent context sensitivity of predicted effects by 66%. Trained from scratch it costs factual accuracy; fine-tuning an existing model with it removes this cost. Together, these results show that intervening on the world, rather than on what the model sees, helps latent world models predict what their actions cause.

</details>


### [152] [Anatomy-Aware Prediction of Bronchoscopic Accessibility from 3D CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37386)
*Linkai Peng,Cuiling Sun,Bin Wang,Jamie Rowell,Catherine Gao,Oyku Ikizgul,Eminenur Sentasci,Andrea Bejar,Halil Ertugrul Aktas,Gorkem Durak,Momen Wahidi,Christopher Kapp,Ulas Bagci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将支气管镜可及性预测形式化为新的监督学习任务，提出首个端到端框架——解剖感知混合专家（MoE）模型，并构建首个438例临床数据集，AUROC达0.8052，优于SOTA基线与人类专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术前支气管镜检查规划对肺部病灶诊断至关重要。当前的可及性评估依赖对CT扫描的主观人工判读，耗时且存在观察者间差异，缺乏客观、自动化的量化手段。

Method: 将支气管镜可及性预测形式化为监督学习任务，提出解剖感知混合专家（Anatomy-Aware MoE）模型，集成三类专家模块：CT Expert 提取局部形态特征，Lobe Expert 引入解剖先验，Path Geometry Expert 编码支气管树的序列约束。同时构建首个包含438例术前CT与手术结局记录的临床数据集。

Result: 模型AUROC达0.8052，显著优于现有SOTA基线方法与经验丰富的人类专家。

Conclusion: 该工作为肺部医学的计算机辅助介入规划建立了新基准，数据与代码将公开于 https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/。

Abstract: Pre-operative planning for bronchoscopy is critical for the diagnosis of lung lesions. Current accessibility assessment relies on subjective manual inspection of CT scans, which is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. In this paper, we formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as a novel supervised learning task and present the first end-to-end framework to address it. We propose an Anatomy-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that integrates specialized modules: a CT Expert for local morphological features, a Lobe Expert for anatomical priors, and a Path Geometry Expert that encodes the sequential constraints of the bronchial tree. To support this task, we curated the first clinical dataset of 438 cases with pre-operative CT scans and documented procedural outcomes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.8052, significantly outperforming both state-of-the-art baselines and experienced human experts. This work establishes a new benchmark for computer-aided interventional planning in pulmonary medicine. Our data and code will be publicly available at https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/.

</details>


### [153] [Multi-task learning for the automatic grading of enlarged perivascular space burden using MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37387)
*Jesse Phitidis,William N. Whiteley,Joanna M. Wardlaw,Miguel O. Bernabeu,Yajun Cheng,Xiaodi Liu,Junfang Zhang,Una Clancy,Stephen Makin,Roberto Duarte Coello,Susana Muñoz Maniega,Mark E. Bastin,Simon R. Cox,Maria del C. Valdés Hernández*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出并比较了三种机器学习方法，利用不完美的“银标准”PVS分割掩膜与放射学评分，自动评估基底节和半卵圆中心的血管周围间隙（PVS）负担，其中多任务CNN效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩大的血管周围间隙（PVS）在脑MRI中可见，日益被认为与不良脑健康相关。PVS是直径小于3 mm的细长结构且数量可能众多，放射科医生需依据临床分级量表（Potters/Wardlaw量表）目视评估其负担，这一过程亟需自动化以加速分析并克服观察者间差异的影响。

Method: 研究的创新点在于训练中使用了半自动生成的不完美“银标准”PVS分割掩膜，并结合PVS放射学评分。作者对比评估了三种方法：（1）条件卷积神经网络（CNN），将PVS掩膜作为额外输入通道；（2）多任务CNN，同时执行PVS分割与评分；（3）逻辑回归模型，利用从PVS掩膜中提取的特征预测PVS评分。

Result: 多任务学习最为有效，平均精度均值达64.08%，高于条件CNN的60.22%、仅预测PVS评分的基线CNN的52.11%以及逻辑回归模型的49.32%。多任务模型展现出其他CNN所不具备的定位单个PVS的能力，并具有概率上合理的表现，对本质上更难的类别预测置信度更低。年龄、性别、高血压状态、白质高信号体积及缺血性卒中病灶状态与多任务模型的PVS评分预测及真实标签的关联方式相似。

Conclusion: 多任务CNN在PVS评分任务中优于条件CNN、基线CNN和逻辑回归模型，能够定位单个PVS并表现出概率合理性，其预测结果与已知临床相关因素（年龄、性别、高血压、白质高信号、缺血性卒中病灶）的关联与真实标签一致，表明该方法在自动化PVS负担评估方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Enlarged perivascular spaces (PVS) visible in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are increasingly thought to be linked to poor brain health. PVS are elongated structures of less than 3 mm in diameter and can be numerous. To reflect the incidence of PVS, radiologists visually score their burden following a clinical grading scale - a task that would benefit from automation to accelerate analyses and overcome the influence of inter-observer differences. We developed and evaluated methods for training machine learning models to score PVS incidence in the basal ganglia (BG) and centrum semiovale (CSO) leveraging the Potters/Wardlaw scale. The novelty in our work lies in the use of imperfect, semi-automatically generated "silver-standard" PVS segmentation masks during training, in addition to PVS radiological scores. We comparatively evaluated a conditional convolutional neural network (CNN) which accepts PVS masks as an extra input channel, a multi-task CNN which performs both PVS segmentation and scoring, and a logistic regression model which utilises features derived from PVS masks to predict PVS scores. Multi-task learning was the most effective method, achieving a mean average precision of 64.08% compared to 60.22% for the conditional CNN, 52.11% for a baseline CNN trained only to predict PVS scores, and 49.32% for the logistic regression model. The multi-task model showed an ability to localise individual PVS not shown by the other CNNs, and behaved in a probabilistically sensible way, predicting with lower confidence on inherently harder classes. Age, sex, hypertension status, white matter hyperintensity volume, and ischaemic stroke lesion status were shown to be associated with the multi-task model's PVS score predictions and the ground truth in a similar way.

</details>


### [154] [BeatDance: Generating Beat-Consistent 3D Dance with Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37400)
*Xiaojian Shen,Dahu Shi,Jianrong Zhang,Hai Li,Hongwei Zhao,Dawei Zhang,Yunzhi Zhuge,Zhiliang Wu,Guanghui Yue,Wei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BeatDance，一种基于扩散的音乐生成3D舞蹈框架，通过分层解耦注意力与循环一致性学习提升音乐-舞蹈对齐精度，在两个基准数据集上超越现有竞争方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从音乐生成逼真3D舞蹈需同时满足与音乐节奏的精确同步以及人体运动的空间复杂性，但现有方法虽能生成物理合理的舞蹈动作，却难以实现与音乐（如节拍）的精准对齐。

Method: 提出扩散框架BeatDance，包含两部分：(1) 分层解耦注意力（HDA）模块，先解耦人体姿态与时间动态的学习，再用分层结构捕获短时与长时依赖，增强时空建模；(2) 采用循环一致性学习，引入辅助的舞蹈到音乐（dance-to-music）模块，训练时重构音乐与原始音乐的差异产生更强损失信号，促进音乐与舞蹈运动的一致性。

Result: 在两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法优于近期竞争方法。

Conclusion: BeatDance通过解耦时空建模与循环一致性约束有效改善音乐-舞蹈对齐，验证了该框架在音乐驱动3D舞蹈生成任务上的有效性。

Abstract: Generating realistic 3D dance from music is a challenging task that requires accurate synchronization with musical rhythms while capturing the spatial complexity of human motion. Although existing methods can generate physically plausible dance motions, they often struggle to achieve precise alignment with music, such as the beat. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework, BeatDance, with two components: 1) We present a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) module, which first disentangles the learning of human pose and temporal dynamics. A hierarchical structure is then employed to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies, thereby enhancing spatial-temporal modeling. 2) We adopt cycle-consistent learning by introducing an auxiliary dance-to-music module. During training, discrepancies between the reconstructed and original music induce a stronger loss signal, effectively encouraging the consistency property between the music and dance motion. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets.

</details>


### [155] [Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting for Consistent Long-Form Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37407)
*Xianghan Wei,Xiaoda Yang,Zhi Wang,An Pan,Daoan Zhang,Huayi Zhang,Yan Zhang,Wei Xu,Zishun Liao,Jianwen Lou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出互补检索增强提示（CRAP）框架，通过显式建模目标镜头的视觉元素需求并检索互补的历史参考，实现长视频生成中的跨镜头一致性，无需重训练生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频生成的核心瓶颈在于对独立生成的镜头进行条件控制，以保持角色、场景和物体在故事中的一致性。现有免训练方法依赖检索到的历史视觉参考，但存在严重的信息不匹配：要么引入无关的上下文冗余，要么无法提供目标镜头所需的完整元素组合。因此需要一种能够提供完整且有针对性的条件控制的方法。

Method: 1）将叙事脚本解析为文本落地的视觉元素登记表，追踪角色、物体、场景及其镜头级状态；2）构建VLM标注的关键帧库，将元素映射到过去的视觉观测；3）智能体根据所需元素检索互补参考，最大化目标元素覆盖率同时最小化历史噪声；4）将检索到的参考、结构化元素状态和接地指令组装为统一提示，输入冻结的视频生成器。整个过程无需重训练或修改底层生成器，且完全可解释。

Result: 在多镜头故事生成任务上的定量和定性评估表明，该方法在跨镜头一致性和文本可控性方面持续优于最新帧检索、基于记忆和实体级检索的基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过元素感知的互补检索增强提示框架，能够为长视频生成提供全面且有针对性的条件控制，在无需重训练的前提下显著提升跨镜头一致性和文本可控性，同时保持完全可解释性。

Abstract: While recent video foundation models excel at generating high-quality short videos, long-form video generation remains a critical challenge, where a major bottleneck lies in conditioning independently generated shots to preserve consistent characters, scenes, and objects throughout a story. Existing training-free approaches typically condition target shots using retrieved historical visuals. However, these references often suffer from severe informational mismatch, either introducing irrelevant contextual redundancy or failing to provide the full combination of required elements for the target shot. To resolve this, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, an agentic framework that strategically aggregates a compact set of mutually supportive historical references to achieve complete and targeted conditioning for long-form video generation without retraining or modifying the underlying generator. Specifically, our framework explicitly models the visual elements required by each target shot by parsing the narrative script into a text-grounded visual element registry that tracks characters, objects, scenes, and their shot-level states. A VLM-annotated keyframe library further maps these elements to past visual observations. Guided by the required elements, our agent retrieves complementary references that maximize target-element coverage while minimizing historical noise. Finally, the retrieved references, structured element states, and grounding instructions are assembled into a unified prompt for the frozen video generator. This element-aware process provides comprehensive conditioning while remaining fully interpretable. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on multi-shot story generation demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms recent-frame, memory-based, and entity-level retrieval baselines in cross-shot consistency and text-controllability.

</details>


### [156] [LazySloth: Bounded LLM-based Lazy Tree Search for Fast Long Video Comprehension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37426)
*Arka Mukherjee,Kaleen Shrestha,Larissa Zhu,Maja Matarić*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LazySloth 提出基于树的惰性搜索方法，通过对 VLM 判定为无关的视频片段进行有界字幕生成，在长视频理解与检索任务上实现 2.9–8.3 倍加速，同时保持与专用视频 VLM 及 RAG 方法相当或更优的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长视频理解方法多依赖对抽取帧进行粗粒度字幕生成，计算效率低且需要大上下文窗口；基于多模态 RAG 的高效方法则使用有损嵌入，丢失时序上下文与细粒度细节；且鲜有工作研究如何优化基于 VLM 的查询相关信息检索。

Method: LazySloth 采用基于树的搜索机制，先由 VLM 判断视频中哪些部分与查询无关，仅对这些无关片段做有界（受限）字幕生成，从而避免对整段视频做完整字幕；树结构以惰性（lazy）方式构建，据称能以远低于急切式构建的字幕成本达到相同效果。

Result: 相比现有 agentic 方法提速 2.9–8.3 倍；在两个开源基座 VLM（Gemma 4 31B、Qwen3.6 27B）与四个基准上，达到与当代专用视频理解 VLM 及 RAG 方法相近或更好的任务准确率，并缩小了与闭源模型 GPT-4o 的差距；消融实验显示，用 CLIP 检索替代 VLM 场景理解会损失 8.8–19.9% 准确率。

Conclusion: LazySloth 证明可在不显著损失性能的前提下实现更快的长视频理解，为高效视频检索与理解提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising results in long-video understanding due to the rich semantic information they can capture. However, most methods focus on coarse captioning of extracted image frames that are computationally inefficient and require models with large context windows. While past work has explored efficient methods through multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), they rely on lossy embeddings that lose temporal context and fine-grained detail. Few works to date have investigated how VLM-based query-relevant information retrieval can be optimized. We introduce LazySloth, an efficient tree-based search method that speeds up video comprehension and retrieval tasks 2.9-8.3x (compared to existing agentic methods) through bounded captioning of portions of the video considered irrelevant by a VLM of the video. Compared to contemporary specialized video-understanding VLMs and RAG-based methods, LazySloth achieved similar or better final task accuracy across two recent open-source base VLMs--Gemma 4 31B and Qwen3.6 27B--across four benchmarks. LazySloth reduced the gap between the base open-source model and a closed-source model, GPT-4o. Ablations showed that replacing VLM scene understanding with CLIP-based retrieval cost 8.8-19.9% in accuracy, while lazy tree construction matches eager construction at a fraction of the captioning cost. With LazySloth, we demonstrate the possibility of faster long-video comprehension without substantial loss in performance.

</details>


### [157] [Event-Only Wingbeat Counting under Camera Motion: A Controlled MuJoCo Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37465)
*Zhang Nengbo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个基于MuJoCo的受控基准，将运动训练与仅事件的图像平移补偿分离，用于从事件流中精确计数完整振翅周期；在中等相机运动下配对运动训练大幅降低计数误差，但简单补偿反而变差，Fourier基线在近距离下最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整振翅计数需识别单个周期（含频率变化与停顿），仅估计主频不足；且相机运动会将目标与背景亮度变化混合进事件观测，导致计数困难，因此需要一个可控基准来分离训练与补偿的影响。

Method: 构建MuJoCo受控基准：324条事件流、24个独立场景、3种扑翼几何、2个距离（1.5和3.0 m）、静态/中等运动/较强运动视角；15场景拟合、3验证、6留出测试。使用固定因果时间卷积网络，做匹配的2×2消融、3个初始化种子，并与ridge、Fourier、自相关及改编EEPPR基线对比。

Result: 中等运动下，配对运动训练将计数MAE从31.130降至3.185周期（1.5 m）、从42.019降至5.444（3.0 m）；加入所测试的补偿后误差升至4.630和10.185。Fourier基线在1.5 m中等运动下达0.944周期，说明神经模型并非普遍最优。报告精确计数准确率与时间匹配周期F1。

Conclusion: 结果支持在该小型合成基准中采用运动感知训练，同时暴露简单事件-背景稳定化的局限；不能据此推断真实传感器性能、气动飞行能力或对未见飞行器类型的泛化性。

Abstract: Counting completed wingbeats requires identifying individual cycles, including during frequency changes and pauses; estimating a dominant frequency alone is insufficient. Camera motion further mixes target and background brightness changes in event observations. We present a controlled MuJoCo benchmark that separates motion training from event-only image translation compensation. The acquisition contains 324 streams from 24 independent scenes, three flapping geometries, two distances (1.5 and 3.0 m), and static, moderate-motion and stronger-motion views. Fifteen scenes are used for fitting, three for validation and six for held-out testing. A fixed causal temporal convolutional network is evaluated in a matched 2 x 2 ablation with three initialization seeds and compared with ridge, Fourier, autocorrelation and an adapted EEPPR baseline. Under moderate motion, paired motion training reduces count mean absolute error from 31.130 to 3.185 cycles at 1.5 m and from 42.019 to 5.444 at 3.0 m. Adding the tested compensation increases these errors to 4.630 and 10.185, respectively. A Fourier baseline achieves 0.944 cycles at 1.5 m under moderate motion, showing that the neural model is not uniformly best. We report exact-count accuracy and temporally matched cycle F1 alongside count error. These findings support motion-aware training in this small synthetic benchmark, while exposing limits of simple event-background stabilization. They do not establish real-sensor performance, aerodynamic flight, or generalization to unseen vehicle types.

</details>


### [158] [Label Less, Learn More: Resource-Efficient Active Semi-Supervised Learning for Onboard Satellite Image Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37481)
*Ahmed Abdelnaby,Mohamed Elmahallawy,Marius Bernahrndt,Tobias Hecking*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SatLabel，一种资源感知的半监督学习框架，将有限卫星标签转化为逐步精化的星上模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率卫星遥感的大规模普适感知受限于标注成本高，以及星上计算、内存、能量和通信资源有限；现有方法依赖数据饥饿的监督学习或大型视觉-语言基础模型，难以在约束下高效适配与部署。

Method: 构建模型不确定性、类别不平衡与伪标签质量之间的闭环，自适应地选择性获取信息量大的样本，同时利用大量无标注影像，实现紧凑学生模型的半监督域适配；可选引入基于图特征精化的混合专家（MoE）学生，在保持轻量化的同时增强表征能力。

Result: 在覆盖核心、扩展和未见域的 11 个遥感数据集上，与 RemoteCLIP 零样本推理对比，多数核心与扩展数据集 Macro-F1 提升，并保持较强的跨数据集迁移能力；Balanced 学生模型仅 11.2M 参数、约 42.8MB，而 RemoteCLIP 为 151.3M 参数、577MB；计算量为 3.65 对 5.89 GFLOPs；四项效率基准上 GPU 前向吞吐约提升 2 倍，并降低单图能耗。

Conclusion: SatLabel 通过自适应样本获取与半监督适配，在显著降低标注、参数与算力开销的同时保持甚至提升遥感感知性能，为资源受限的星上视觉部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Large-scale pervasive sensing increasingly relies on high-resolution satellite imagery, yet task-specific onboard vision is constrained by costly annotation and limited computation, memory, energy, and communication resources. Existing approaches largely rely on either data-hungry supervised learning or large vision-language foundation models, limiting efficient adaptation and deployment under these constraints. We present SatLabel, a resource-aware learning framework that transforms limited satellite labels into progressively refined onboard models through adaptive sample acquisition and semi-supervised model adaptation. Rather than repeatedly training on uniformly sampled labels, SatLabel closes the loop between model uncertainty, class imbalance, and pseudo-label quality to selectively acquire informative samples while exploiting abundant unlabeled imagery. This enables a compact student to adapt to target sensing domains with reduced annotation and inference costs. We further introduce an optional Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) student with graph-based feature refinement to enhance representation capacity while retaining a lightweight footprint. We evaluate SatLabel on 11 remote-sensing datasets spanning core, extended, and unseen domains against RemoteCLIP zero-shot inference. SatLabel improves Macro-F1 on most core and extended datasets while maintaining strong cross-dataset transfer to unseen domains. More importantly, the Balanced student contains only 11.2 M parameters and occupies approximately 42.8 MB, compared with 151.3M parameters and 577 MB for RemoteCLIP, while requiring 3.65 versus 5.89 GFLOPs. Across four efficiency benchmarks, it achieves approximately 2x higher GPU-forward throughput and reduces energy per image on datasets.

</details>


### [159] [PoE-Fuse: Precision-Weighted Expert Fusion for Bi-Temporal Change Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37485)
*Haruki Watase,Shunya Nagashima,Takayuki Nishimura*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PoE-Fuse 参数高效框架，冻结几何、定位与语言基础专家，将其特征重采样到共享空间网格并只训练轻量融合主干，以乘积专家（PoE）方式融合，单主干同时完成变化检测、建筑定位与损伤评估三类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双时相变化理解（变化检测、建筑定位、损伤评估）对灾害响应和环境监测至关重要。强视觉语言模型虽能处理这些任务，但适配通常需要全量微调或强化学习，成本高且不稳定，因此需要参数高效且稳定的方案。

Method: PoE-Fuse 组合冻结的几何、定位与语言基础专家，将其特征重采样到共享空间网格，仅训练轻量融合主干。将对齐特征视为潜在场景状态的高斯观测，按学习的逐单元精度进行融合；该乘积专家估计器严格推广了均匀求和与标量门控，并通过组合两个时间戳的精度扩展到变化场。单一共享主干同时求解三类任务。

Result: 平均 F1 达 59.2%，而指令微调的时序视觉语言助手为 40.7%，并超过在相同协议与训练预算下重训练的专用变化检测模型。

Conclusion: 以冻结专家组合与轻量精度加权融合的方式，可在低成本、稳定性好且参数高效的前提下统一处理双时相变化理解任务，性能优于全量适配的视觉语言助手与专用重训练模型。

Abstract: Bi-temporal change understanding, which localizes and characterizes what changed between two satellite images, is central to disaster response and environmental monitoring, spanning change detection, building localization, and damage assessment. Strong vision-language models address these tasks, but adapting them typically requires full fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, which is costly and unstable. We propose PoE-Fuse, a parameter-efficient framework that instead composes frozen foundation experts for geometry, grounding, and language, resampling their features onto a shared spatial grid and training only a lightweight fusion trunk. PoE-Fuse treats the aligned features as Gaussian observations of a latent scene state and fuses them by learned per-cell precision. This product-of-experts estimator strictly generalizes uniform summation and scalar gating, and extends to change fields by composing the precisions of the two timestamps. A single shared trunk solves the three tasks at once, reaching a mean F1 of 59.2%, compared with 40.7% for an instruction-tuned temporal vision-language assistant, and surpassing dedicated change-detection models retrained under the same protocol and training budget.

</details>


### [160] [Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching for Precipitation Nowcasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37487)
*Shunya Nagashima,Takumi Bannai,Makoto Misaizu,Keisuke Maeda,Takahiro Ogawa,Miki Haseyama*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出物理引导流映射匹配(PG-FMM)，一种条件流映射模型，将可预测的平流与不确定的小尺度细节解耦，在四个雷达基准上于24项指标中18项超越SOTA，强降雨阈值下CSI提升最高达58.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降水临近预报对洪水预警与灾害响应至关重要，同时是时空生成建模的严苛基准，具有混沌动力学、重尾强度和稀有高强度结构等特性。确定性模型最小化像素损失并被推向条件均值，会模糊这些关键结构；而在确定性骨干上叠加随机残差的生成模型会继承同样的模糊问题。

Method: 提出的PG-FMM为条件流映射模型：采用冻结的拉格朗日平流先验对雷达场进行输运并提供显式运动预报；流映射生成头以过去帧和先验推演为条件（而非叠加于其上），在四步采样中生成清晰的随机细节。先验仅起引导作用，因此生成头是替换而非继承模糊结构。

Result: 在四个雷达基准的广泛实验中，PG-FMM在24项指标中的18项上优于已有最先进方法，在强降雨阈值处增益最大，关键成功指数（CSI）最高提升58.9%。

Conclusion: 通过将可预测平流与不确定小尺度细节解耦，并以流映射生成头条件化替换模糊结构，PG-FMM有效提升降水临近预报的精度，尤其在强降雨等关键场景中表现突出。

Abstract: Precipitation nowcasting, generating future radar fields from past observations, is critical for flood warning and disaster response. It is also a demanding benchmark for spatiotemporal generative modeling, with chaotic dynamics, heavy-tailed intensities, and rare high-intensity structures that matter most. Deterministic models minimize a pixel loss and are driven toward the conditional mean, which blurs exactly those structures, while generative models that add a stochastic residual on top of a deterministic backbone inherit the same blur. We propose Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching (PG-FMM), a conditional flow-map model that decouples predictable advection from uncertain small-scale detail. A frozen Lagrangian advection prior transports the radar field and supplies an explicit motion forecast, and a flow-map generative head, conditioned on the past frames and the prior rollout rather than summed onto it, produces sharp stochastic detail in four sampling steps. The prior serves only as guidance, so the head replaces blurred structure instead of inheriting it. Extensive experiments on four radar benchmarks show that PG-FMM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on 18 of 24 metrics, with the largest gains at heavy-rain thresholds, where the critical success index improves by up to 58.9%. The project page can be found at https://neurogica.github.io/PG-FMM.

</details>


### [161] [FORUM: Frozen Outputs Reconciled Using Model Agreement for Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37488)
*Taiyo Sato,Takamasa Sanda,Keisuke Maeda,Takahiro Ogawa,Miki Haseyama,Shunya Nagashima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FORUM是一种免训练的多模态大模型测试时融合方法，通过一致性选择与中心点定位两条几何规则，在对抗性指代表达理解任务上超越397B参数模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结的多模态大模型（MLLM）在标准指代表达理解任务上表现良好，但在含同类别干扰项和否定的对抗性基准上，即使最大模型也会自信地出错，且重采样会重复错误。不同数据与架构训练的模型极少被同一混淆因素欺骗，因此模型间的一致性可作为无需标签的正确目标信号。

Method: FORUM，一种免训练的测试时融合方法，融合多个冻结MLLM，由两条固定几何规则引导：一致性选择保留被最多不同模型支持的区域；中心点（medoid）定位返回真实的成员框而非坐标平均值，从而避免单个松散预测带偏结果。

Result: 融合三个开源MLLM后，在对抗性Ref-Adv-s基准上，FORUM的平均准确率相对397B参数已发表参考模型提升5%，相对朴素平均集成提升15%；该增益可迁移至标准RefCOCO+；在无主导成员的均衡阵容下，仍相对397B模型提升5%。

Conclusion: 基于几何规则的多模型测试时融合能有效提升指代表达理解的鲁棒性与准确率，且无需额外训练，性能增益在对抗性和标准基准上均可泛化。

Abstract: Frozen multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now solve standard referring expression comprehension with a single prompted call, yet on adversarial benchmarks with same-category distractors and negation, even the largest models are confidently wrong, and resampling repeats the error. Models built from different data and architectures rarely fall for the same confounder, so their agreement is a strong label-free signal of the correct target. We present FORUM, a training-free test-time fusion of frozen MLLMs guided by two fixed geometric rules: agreement-based selection keeps the region supported by the most distinct models, and medoid localization returns an actual member box instead of a coordinate average, so one loose prediction cannot shift the answer. Fusing three open MLLMs, FORUM surpasses the 397B-parameter published reference by a relative 5% in mean accuracy on the adversarial Ref-Adv-s benchmark, and a plain averaging ensemble by 15%. The gains transfer to standard RefCOCO+, and a balanced lineup with no dominant member still surpasses the 397B model by 5%.

</details>


### [162] [Attention-Scoped Guidance: Training-Free Spatial Control for Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37492)
*Zeyan Li,Wei Zhou,Hadi Amirpour,Minghao Zou,Panqi Yang,Jianfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Attention-Scoped Guidance（ASG），一种免训练的采样器包装，将双 CFG 中的全局引导权重空间化：利用指令注意力生成软支撑图，低支撑处弱化文本引导、高支撑处强化图像锚定，从而在保持背景的同时准确完成指令编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令引导图像编辑要求"改指令所指、留其余不动"，但现有双 classifier-free guidance（CFG）在每个去噪步都用全局权重组合"编辑方向"与"回拉源图"方向，导致编辑强度与保持力度在空间上均匀分配，无法区分编辑区域与非编辑区域，造成背景漂移或编辑不足。

Method: ASG 作为采样器包装：从编辑器已计算的指令注意力中读取软支撑图（soft support map），据此对引导权重进行空间调制——支撑度低处削弱文本引导，支撑度高处置强化图像锚定。无需训练、无需外部掩码、无需额外网络前向评估。

Result: 在 MagicBrush 与 PIE-Bench++ 完整划分上，ASG 在面向保持的指标上取得提升，在 MagicBrush 四项指标中领先三项，并提升 PIE-Bench++ 的背景 PSNR。剂量匹配对照（去除空间分配）在 PIE-Bench++ 上最高损失 0.73 CLIP，证明增益来自空间分配本身。

Conclusion: 引导权重的空间化是提升指令编辑"编辑—保持"权衡的有效且低成本途径；增益由空间分配而非引导强度总量决定，ASG 可即插即用、无需训练与额外开销。

Abstract: Instruction-guided image editing should change what the instruction names and leave the rest of the image untouched. In dual classifier-free guidance (CFG), an editor combines two directions at every denoising step, one that pushes toward the instructed edit and one that pulls back toward the source image, using global weights. We introduce Attention-Scoped Guidance (ASG), a sampler wrapper that makes these weights spatial. It reads a soft support map from the instruction attention that the editor already computes, then weakens text guidance where support is low and strengthens image anchoring where support is high. The wrapper requires no training, no external mask, and no additional network evaluation. On the full MagicBrush and PIE-Bench++ splits, ASG improves preservation-oriented metrics, leading three of four MagicBrush metrics and PIE-Bench++ background PSNR. A dose-matched control that removes the spatial placement loses up to 0.73 CLIP on PIE-Bench++, confirming that the spatial allocation itself carries the gain.

</details>


### [163] [MotionMaestro: Masked Tokenization for Unified Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37495)
*Yun Chen,Munchurl Kim,Jeonghyeok Do*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MotionMaestro，一个统一的人体动作生成框架，通过掩码动作分词学习完整动作与异构部分观测的共享表示，并用观测图和观测损失保留给定条件，在多项动作生成任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作生成方法多针对单一任务（文本生成动作、姿态条件生成、轨迹控制等），任务间条件类型不同、系统割裂，缺乏统一框架。作者观察到各类动作条件都可自然地表述为动作序列上不同的观测模式，即对应特定的掩码策略，因此有望用统一表示处理。

Method: 提出MotionMaestro统一框架，通过掩码动作分词（masked motion tokenization）学习完整动作与异构部分观测的共享表示。采用三阶段训练：先学习掩码动作分词器，再在干净动作上精炼重建能力，最后在学到的隐空间中训练条件流匹配（conditional flow-matching）生成器。同时引入观测图（observation map）和观测损失（observation loss），在生成过程中显式保留已提供的动作条件。

Result: 在RoMo和MotionMillion两个大规模数据集上实验，在文本引导与无条件合成、姿态条件生成与部分补全、时间插值、轨迹控制和动作续接等多种任务上均取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: 将多样化动作生成条件统一建模为掩码观测模式是可行且有效的；MotionMaestro以共享表示与统一条件机制，端到端支持多类动作生成任务，验证了统一框架相较于任务专用方法的优势。

Abstract: Human motion generation plays an important role in applications such as character animation, virtual environments, and embodied interaction. While existing approaches have achieved remarkable progress, many of them are developed for individual tasks, including text-to-motion, pose-conditioned generation, and trajectory control. Although these tasks involve different types of conditions, a unified framework capable of handling them within a common representation would greatly simplify motion generation systems. We observe that diverse motion conditions can be naturally formulated as different observation patterns over motion sequences, where each task corresponds to a specific masking strategy. Based on this insight, we introduce MotionMaestro, a unified motion generation framework that learns a shared representation for complete motions and heterogeneous partial observations through masked motion tokenization. MotionMaestro employs a three-stage training strategy that first learns a masked motion tokenizer, then refines its reconstruction ability on clean motions, and finally trains a conditional flow-matching generator in the learned latent space. Furthermore, we introduce an observation map and an observation loss to explicitly preserve provided motion conditions during generation. With this unified representation and conditioning mechanism, MotionMaestro supports text-guided and unconditional synthesis, pose conditioning and partial completion, temporal interpolation, trajectory control, and motion continuation. Experiments on the large-scale RoMo and MotionMillion datasets show state-of-the-art performance across diverse motion generation tasks.

</details>


### [164] [GeoSET: Generalist Foundation Model for SAR-to-EO Image Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37496)
*Jeonghyeok Do,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoSET是首个SAR-to-EO图像翻译（SET）通用模型，基于超300万SAR-EO配对数据预训练，通过LoRA仅更新0.6%参数即可高效适配下游数据集，在六个基准上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SET方法通常只在单一、规模有限的数据集上训练，导致模型仅适应特定的传感条件，缺乏跨传感器、跨分辨率、跨区域的泛化能力。而配对的SAR与光学（EO）影像数据日益丰富，为构建通用模型提供了条件。

Method: 提出GeoSET，首个SET通用模型：1）构建统一协议下的单一预训练父模型，适配下游任务；2）从超1000万SAR观测中筛选出300万以上高质量SAR-EO配对，覆盖多种传感器、空间分辨率和地面采样距离；3）设计抗散斑（speckle-robust）SAR编码器以弥合SAR与预训练图像生成器之间的模态差异，并在异构语料上预训练条件生成器；4）通过低秩适配（LoRA）进行高效下游适配。

Result: GeoSET在六个下游基准上，无论采用全量微调还是LoRA，均在FID和DISTS指标上达到最先进水平；LoRA仅更新0.60%的生成器参数，每个数据集约需1小时完成适配，实现了跨异构SAR-EO域的有效迁移。

Conclusion: GeoSET验证了构建SET通用模型的可行性，表明大规模异构数据预训练结合参数高效微调能够实现跨多样传感条件的有效泛化，为SAR-to-EO翻译提供统一且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Paired synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and electro-optical (EO) imagery is increasingly available across sensors, resolutions, and geographic regions. Yet existing SAR-to-EO image translation (SET) methods are typically trained on a single, limited-scale dataset, producing models specialized to particular sensing conditions. We introduce GeoSET, the first generalist model for SET, built around a single pretrained parent that is adapted to downstream datasets under a common protocol. We curate over 3 million high-quality SAR--EO pairs from a collection of more than 10 million SAR observations, spanning diverse sensors, spatial resolutions, and ground sampling distances. To bridge the modality gap between SAR observations and a pretrained image generator, we develop a speckle-robust SAR encoder and pretrain the conditional generator on this heterogeneous corpus. The resulting parent supports efficient adaptation across downstream datasets through low-rank adaptation (LoRA), updating only 0.60% of the generator parameters and requiring approximately one hour per dataset. Across six downstream benchmarks, GeoSET achieves state-of-the-art results in FID and DISTS with full fine-tuning or LoRA, demonstrating effective transfer across heterogeneous SAR-EO domains.

</details>


### [165] [Principled MAP estimation for inverse problems: bridging the gap between convergence and performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37529)
*Alexandre Lagier,Valentine Tosel,Anne Gagneux,Mathurin Massias,Ségolène Martin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合递减噪声水平去噪器与收敛调度方案的算法，首次在贝叶斯框架下证明其收敛到MAP估计，实验表明其超越收敛类方法并与当前最优经验性方法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练去噪器可为复原算法引入图像先验。Plug-and-Play与RED虽有收敛保证，但在严重病态逆问题上重建质量有限；基于流/扩散生成模型、沿递减噪声序列评估的方法经验表现优异，但缺乏收敛理论。论文旨在弥合这一理论空白。

Method: 设计一种算法，将不同递减噪声水平下的去噪器与专门设计的调度方案相结合，以确保收敛性；并从贝叶斯视角给出收敛性分析。

Result: 在适当假设下，证明该方法收敛到最大后验（MAP）估计；在多种病态逆问题上的实验显示其优于具收敛保证的方法，并与当前最优经验性方法竞争。

Conclusion: 该工作从理论上为递减噪声水平去噪器的收敛性提供了保证，并在实践中取得有竞争力的复原性能，弥合了经验方法与收敛理论之间的差距。

Abstract: Pretrained denoisers provide a powerful way to incorporate image priors into restoration algorithms. Plug-and-Play and RED approaches exploit fixed-noise-level denoisers within first-order optimization schemes, with convergence guarantees, but often struggle to achieve high-quality reconstruction on severely ill-posed inverse problems. In contrast, recent state-of-the-art approaches leverage denoisers derived from flow- or diffusion-based generative models and evaluate them along a sequence of decreasing noise levels. While these methods achieve strong empirical performance, their convergence theory remains limited. In this paper, we bridge this gap by specifically designing an algorithm that combines denoisers at decreasing noise levels with a schedule tailored to ensure convergence. From a Bayesian perspective, we prove that our method converges to a $\textit{Maximum a Posteriori}$ (MAP) estimate, under suitable assumptions. Subsequently, we apply our method to various ill-posed inverse problems and show that it surpasses convergent methods while competing with state-of-the-art empirical ones.

</details>


### [166] [Weeding Out Bad Seeds: Initial-Noise-Robust Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37537)
*Arian Komaei Koma,Seyed Amir Kasaei,Aida Aryafar,Matin Ghiasi,Ali Aghayari,Amirhossein Souri,Mohammad Mosayyebi,AmirMahdi Sadeghzadeh,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有T2I机器遗忘方法对初始噪声具有脆弱性，存在"概率性遗忘"现象，作者提出自适应、概念条件化的采样策略来增强遗忘鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘作为T2I模型的后处理安全手段，可无需高昂重训练即擦除敏感概念。但当前SOTA方法鲁棒性差：被抑制的概念在特定随机初始噪声下会重新出现（即"概率性遗忘"），在其他初始化下却看似已遗忘。作者将其归因于遗忘阶段标准高斯采样与遗忘目标之间的不匹配——目标概念仅出现在特定初始噪声区域，均匀随机采样产生稀疏、无信息量的梯度更新，无法实现稳健擦除。

Method: 提出一种自适应、概念条件化的采样策略，动态将梯度更新集中在目标概念显现的噪声区域，并对无信息区域降权。该框架与六种SOTA遗忘方法、四种扩散骨干网络集成。

Result: 在安全性、物体和艺术风格遗忘任务上，以及黑盒与白盒对抗攻击下评估：相较四个基线，随机初始化下的条件裸露复现率平均降低67.2%，并降低两类对抗评估的攻击成功率。跨概念域中，自适应噪声采样增强对抗鲁棒性与非目标保留，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量和目标擦除性能。

Conclusion: 自适应噪声采样通过将梯度更新聚焦于概念显现区域，有效缓解"概率性遗忘"，显著提升T2I机器遗忘在随机噪声初始化与对抗攻击下的鲁棒性，且不牺牲生成质量与擦除效果。

Abstract: Machine unlearning has emerged as a critical post-hoc safety measure to erase sensitive concepts from Text-to-Image (T2I) models without prohibitive retraining. However, we reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches are brittle due to a severe lack of robustness to noise initialization. We call this phenomenon ``probabilistic forgetting'': suppressed concepts re-emerge under specific random initial noise conditions, despite appearing unlearned on other initializations. We trace this failure to the misalignment between standard Gaussian sampling during unlearning and the unlearning objective. Since the target concept manifests only in specific initial noise regions throughout the unlearning phase, uniform random sampling yields sparse, uninformative gradient updates that fail to drive robust erasure. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive, concept-conditioned sampling strategy that dynamically concentrates gradient updates on regions where the target concept manifests, down-weighting uninformative areas. We integrate our framework with six distinct SOTA unlearning methods across four diffusion backbones and evaluate it across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning, as well as under black-box and white-box adversarial attacks. Our method reduces the conditional nudity re-emergence rate across random initializations by 67.2% on average over four baselines and lowers attack success rates across both adversarial evaluations. Across concept domains, Adaptive Noise Sampling strengthens adversarial robustness and non-target retention while preserving competitive generative quality and target-erasure performance.

</details>


### [167] [APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37559)
*Jianguo Huang,Jinming Liu,Qiyao Wang,Liang Xu,Jianhang Li,Zhimian Wen,Mingda Li,Shule Lu,Zhicheng Wang,Yuhan Guo,Xin Jin,Wenjun Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 APM-Bench 基准，将真实世界流式交互重构为多会话生活轨迹，系统评估持久记忆系统在效用、延迟与存储上的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频基准与方法多聚焦于单段连续视频或短片，忽视真实交互常是间歇性的、需要记忆跨中断持久保留。为填补这一空白，作者构建 APM-Bench。

Method: APM-Bench 包含 549 个会话、104 条轨迹、2,719 个候选，覆盖客观题与开放性问答。每个会话为带细粒度标注的视频，同一轨迹内会话围绕相关活动展开。模型需借助持久记忆回答历史会话问题并主动响应，同时保持实时交互。评估中系统性测试通用视频模型在不同记忆协议下及多种专用流式记忆系统的表现，并检验其能否识别证据不足。

Result: 实验揭示明显的效用—延迟—存储权衡：现有方法难以同时实现可靠的长程召回、低开销与跨会话有效主动辅助。

Conclusion: APM-Bench 为在真实流式条件下开发与比较持久记忆系统提供了综合测试平台，期望推动兼顾效用、延迟与存储的实用持久记忆研究。

Abstract: To serve as real-world personal assistants, streaming video models need persistent memory that retains past experiences for later use. Yet existing streaming benchmarks and methods often focus on individual continuous videos or short clips, overlooking that real-world interactions are often intermittent and require memory to persist across interruptions. To fill this gap, we introduce APM-Bench, which reformulates real-world streaming interaction as multi-session life trajectories. It contains 549 sessions, 104 trajectories, and 2,719 candidates, spanning both objective and open-ended questions. Each session is a video with fine-grained annotations, and sessions within a trajectory revolve around related activities. Models then use persistent memory to answer questions about past sessions and provide proactive responses while maintaining real-time interaction. This raises challenges: persistent memory must be storable, selectively retain information, be injected at the right time, and remain efficient. Moreover, finite storage may leave required evidence unavailable, so assistants should recognize missing evidence. Therefore, we systematically evaluate general video models under different memory protocols and diverse specialized streaming memory systems, and test whether models acknowledge insufficient evidence. Our evaluation reveals a clear utility--latency--storage trade-off: existing methods still struggle to simultaneously achieve reliable long-term recall, low overhead, and effective proactive assistance across sessions. APM-Bench provides a comprehensive testbed for developing and comparing persistent memory systems under realistic streaming conditions. We hope it encourages future work that jointly considers utility, latency, and storage toward more practical persistent memory for real-world streaming assistants.

</details>


### [168] [Decompose Radicals, Then Reward: Fine-Grained Inspection for Accurate Chinese Text Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37569)
*Yazhen Xie,Xingsong Ye,Zhineng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出IDSpect，利用表意文字描述序列（IDS）对中文场景文字生成进行细粒度、结构化的强化学习奖励，在不改动生成器、不增加推理成本的前提下提升中文文字的部件与空间结构忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像模型渲染准确中文文字仍具挑战。现有基于OCR的强化学习奖励将解码文本与目标字符串直接比较，忽视了中文的构字特性：汉字由可复用的部件按明确空间关系组合而成，而OCR将其视为原子字符处理。因此，视觉上不同的部件级错误可能得到同样粗糙的反馈，模型倾向于生成"形似"而非真正还原内部结构的字形。

Method: 引入表意文字描述序列（IDS）：由空间操作符与部件构成。训练一个专家IDS识别器，将渲染出的中文文字转写为IDS表示。基于该识别器构建IDSpect奖励：将目标文本确定性地分解为IDS token，并对裁剪级视觉IDS预测与目标序列进行对齐；采用全局唯一token归因，使比较不受检测文字区域顺序影响。再结合整字语义奖励，在不改变图像生成器、不增加推理时间成本的情况下，提供含部件与空间关系的细粒度信用分配。在Qwen-Image上以GRPO进行后训练验证。

Result: 在Qwen-Image的GRPO后训练实验中，IDSpect在LongText与GenTextEval上取得了领先的结构质量与语义对齐表现。

Conclusion: 以IDS为中间表示可将中文文字监督从整字级别细化到部件与空间关系级别，为文本到图像模型的中文文字渲染提供高效、即插即用的奖励信号，兼顾结构忠实度与语义一致性。

Abstract: Rendering accurate Chinese text remains challenging for text-to-image models. Existing OCR-based reinforcement-learning rewards compare decoded transcripts with target strings. Such rewards overlook the compositional nature of Chinese writing: an ideograph consists of reusable components arranged through explicit spatial relations, yet OCR evaluates it as an atomic character. Consequently, visually different radical-level errors may receive equally coarse feedback, encouraging glyphs that merely resemble the target instead of faithfully reproducing its internal structure. We employ Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS), which comprise spatial operators and character components, and train an expert IDS recognizer to transcribe rendered Chinese text into this representation. Building on this recognizer, we introduce IDSpect, which deterministically decomposes the target text into IDS tokens and aligns crop-level visual IDS predictions with the target sequence. Globally unique token credit makes this comparison robust to the order of detected text regions. Combined with a whole-character semantic reward, IDSpect supplies fine-grained credit with component and spatial-relation without changing the image generator or adding inference-time cost. Experiments with GRPO post-training of Qwen-Image demonstrate that IDSpect achieves leading structural quality and semantic alignment on LongText and GenTextEval.

</details>


### [169] [Evaluating the Evaluators: Diagnosing Large Multimodal Models for AI-Generated Image Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37576)
*Yu Zhao,Jiarui Wang,Huiyu Duan,Ye Zhao,Jutao Tang,Juntong Wang,Guangtao Zhai,Xiongkuo Min*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SQUARE-Bench，一个从语义、质量、真实性、责任四个维度系统评估 LMM 作为 AI 生成图像评估器的综合基准，包含 38 个子维度、近 1 万张 AI 生成图像（来自 22 个模型）及 3000 余张真实图像，并在 23 个 LMM 上进行实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着文生图（T2I）生成技术快速发展，稳健评估变得关键且困难：传统指标难以捕捉细粒度对齐与生成伪影。LMM 虽被广泛用作评估器，但现有基准通常孤立地研究语义理解、质量感知与真实性识别，普遍忽视责任（Responsibility）检测，缺乏统一、全面的验证。

Method: 构建 SQUARE-Bench 基准，按语义（Semantics）、质量（Quality）、真实性（Authenticity）、责任（Responsibility）四个方面系统评估 LMM 评估能力；建立包含 38 个子维度的细粒度分类体系；从 22 个从传统到最先进的生成模型采样近 1 万张 AI 生成图像，并补充 3000 余张真实图像，配以人工策划的问答对；在 23 个 LMM 上进行广泛实验；并开展 LMM 引导迭代编辑的概念验证研究。

Result: 顶尖专有模型（如 Gemini-3-Pro）已超越单个领域专家人类基线；但模型间性能差距仍显著，在细粒度推理和领域特定鲁棒性上存在明显差异。在概念验证的迭代编辑中，维度特定的 LMM 为固定图像编辑器提供诊断反馈，引导系统在语义、真实性和责任方面取得选择性提升，但伴随一致的视觉质量权衡。

Conclusion: SQUARE-Bench 既可作为刻画 LMM 评估器能力的诊断工具，也可用于研究其在 T2I 生成优化中的应用。基准与数据集将在论文发表后公开。

Abstract: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generation, robust evaluation becomes critical yet challenging, as traditional metrics fail to capture fine-grained alignment and generative artifacts. While large multimodal models (LMMs) are increasingly adopted as evaluators, existing benchmarks typically study semantic understanding, quality perception, and authenticity identification in isolation, while largely neglecting responsibility detection. This leaves a gap in unified and comprehensive validation. To bridge this gap, we introduce SQUARE-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates LMM capabilities as evaluators of AI-generated images across four aspects: Semantics, Quality, Authenticity, and Responsibility. SQUARE-Bench introduces a granular taxonomy of 38 sub-dimensions to evaluate nearly 10K AI-generated images sampled from 22 diverse models, ranging from legacy to state-of-the-art generators, complemented by over 3K real-world images. The images are annotated with curated question-answering pairs. Extensive experiments on 23 LMMs reveal that top proprietary models, such as Gemini-3-Pro, already outperform the individual human expert baseline. However, the performance gap between models remains significant, exhibiting notable disparities in fine-grained inference and domain-specific robustness. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct a proof-of-concept study of LMM-guided iterative editing, in which dimension-specific LMMs provide diagnostic feedback to fixed image editors. The resulting guided system yields selective improvements in semantics, authenticity, and responsibility, while exhibiting a consistent visual-quality trade-off. SQUARE-Bench can serve as both a diagnostic tool for characterizing LMM evaluator capabilities and studying their use in T2I generation refinement. The benchmark and dataset will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [170] [TReVS: Integrating Textual Relevance and Visual Saliency for Efficient Vision-Language Model Token Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37581)
*Jing Wang,Zhiping Wu,Dongdong Ren,Youfang Han,Wei Zhao,Wenbin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TReVS是一个免训练的两阶段视觉token剪枝框架，在第一阶段融合文本相关性与视觉编码器显著性，在第二阶段利用高方差注意力头移除任务无关token，可在剪除94.4%视觉token的同时保留92.8%的基线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型因大量视觉token导致推理成本高昂。现有两阶段剪枝方法的第一阶段仅依赖视觉编码器显著性，可能过早删除与查询相关的token，使后续文本引导阶段失去关键视觉证据。

Method: 通过实证分析发现：将查询引导引入第一阶段剪枝能更好保留任务相关证据；高方差注意力头对文本查询更敏感，可提供更具判别性的文本到视觉注意力信号。基于此提出TReVS：在LLM前阶段结合文本相关性与视觉编码器显著性进行剪枝，并在LLM浅层至中间层利用高方差注意力头移除任务无关token。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，TReVS在剪除94.4%视觉token的情况下保留了未剪枝基线92.8%的性能，优于先前最先进方法。

Conclusion: 将查询/文本引导纳入第一阶段的LLM前剪枝，并利用高方差注意力头进行LLM内部剪枝，可显著提升视觉token剪枝的效果，且无需额外训练。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual understanding and reasoning but often incur substantial inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent visual token pruning methods increasingly follow a two-stage paradigm: they first remove visually redundant tokens after the vision encoder and then discard tokens irrelevant to the textual query within the Large Language Model (LLM). However, since the first stage typically relies solely on vision-encoder saliency, it may prematurely eliminate query-relevant tokens, depriving the subsequent text-guided stage of critical visual evidence. Our empirical analysis shows that incorporating query guidance into first-stage pruning better preserves task-relevant evidence and consistently improves performance over vision-only saliency-based pruning. We further find that high-variance attention heads are more sensitive to the textual query and yield more discriminative text-to-vision attention signals for second-stage pruning. Motivated by these findings, we propose TReVS, a training-free framework that combines textual relevance with vision-encoder saliency for pre-LLM pruning and leverages high-variance attention heads to remove task-irrelevant tokens at shallow-to-intermediate layers of the LLM. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, TReVS retains 92.8% of the unpruned baseline performance while pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [171] [FedSocket: Recipient-Executable Knowledge Exchange for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37582)
*Xinyuan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FedSocket 框架，将“接收方可执行性”作为交换模型的设计要求，通过共享 Q 模块连接异构私有模型，实现跨模态、跨架构、跨任务的联邦知识可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦知识需能被不同模态、不同私有架构、不同任务的接收方使用，但现有方法交换的知识往往无法直接被接收方执行，导致知识迁移后不可用。

Method: 设计共享 Q：整合接收方可计算输入、任务自有输出与所有权感知聚合，形成统一预测接口。私有模型训练本地 Q 副本，仅交换 Q 参数与计数；返回的 Q 支持本地学习与 Joint 推理，从而连接异构私有模型。

Result: 在六个数据集上验证：MELD 与 UCF-51 上缺失模态接收方准确率较 Local 分别提升 14.44 与 15.51 个百分点；同推理容量下 Joint 在 UCF-51 准确率超独立集成 11.06 个百分点，Flickr30k 平均双向 R@1 超 4.87 个百分点；Joint 在四个异构端点均优于单独 Q。教师控制、共享路径干预与组件析因实验阐明了监督、共享与部署的作用。

Conclusion: FedSocket 使交换的知识从联邦训练到接收方推理均可直接使用，验证了接收方执行作为设计约束的有效性与必要性。

Abstract: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. Joint also improves over Q alone on all four heterogeneous endpoints, demonstrating the value of combining local and exchanged predictions. Teacher controls, sharing-path interventions, and component factorials identify the roles of supervision, sharing, and deployment. FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge directly usable from federated training to recipient inference.

</details>


### [172] [TomoTransformer: Towards a Foundation Model for CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37605)
*AmirEhsan Khorashadizadeh,Benjamín Béjar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 TomoTransformer，一种基于 Transformer 的稀疏视图断层重建基础模型，将局部滤波投影视为 token，在反投影空间中通过自注意力预测缺失视图，可免重训练处理任意数量的输入/目标投影、任意角度与探测器尺寸，在多基准上超越 ViewTrans 并在真实同步辐射纳米脑数据上零样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统监督深度学习重建模型通常将 FBP 图像或正弦图映射为干净重建结果，存在分布偏移下的脆弱性：投影数量与角度、探测器分辨率或数据分布一旦变化便需重训练，限制了实际部署。因此需要一个对输入/目标投影数量、角度与探测器尺寸均不敏感的统一基础模型。

Method: TomoTransformer 将每个局部滤波投影作为独立 token，利用自注意力预测缺失视图。关键在于在反投影空间（back-projection space）中操作，将投影按空间位置分离，使视图插值在几何上适定，并对探测器尺寸不变。此设计允许单一模型处理任意数量输入投影、任意角位置与探测器维度，并查询任意数量目标角度而无需重训练。模型在大规模数据集上训练，涵盖多样医学 CT 解剖结构与自然图像。

Result: 在多个稀疏视图基准数据集上，TomoTransformer 显著优于通用多用途模型 ViewTrans，并匹配或超过强协议专用基线，且对输入与目标投影数量完全无关。在 X 射线同步辐射采集的真实纳米尺度脑数据上展现出稳健的零样本泛化能力与实用价值。

Conclusion: 通过反投影空间中的 token 化自注意力建模，TomoTransformer 实现了免重训练、跨解剖/材料/分辨率的通用稀疏视图重建，并具备真实实验数据的零样本泛化能力，为实际部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Supervised deep learning has advanced sparse-view tomographic reconstruction. However, conventional models, which typically map filtered back-projection (FBP) images or sinograms to clean reconstructions, are brittle under distribution shifts. Because they require retraining whenever projection counts and angles, detector resolutions, or data distributions change, their deployment in real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce TomoTransformer, a transformer-based architecture that treats each \textit{local} filtered projection as an individual token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Crucially, TomoTransformer operates in a \emph{back-projection space} that separates projections across spatial locations, making view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector size. This design yields a single foundation model that can process any number of input projections, at arbitrary angular locations and detector dimensions, and query any number of target angles without retraining. Trained on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, TomoTransformer generalizes effectively across anatomies, materials, and resolutions. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark sparse-view datasets show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms concurrent multi-purpose models like ViewTrans and matches or exceeds strong protocol-specific baselines, while remaining fully agnostic to the number of input and target projections. Furthermore, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real experimental nanoscale brain data collected from an X-ray synchrotron, showcasing its practical utility for real-world applications.

</details>


### [173] [Targeted Visual Counterfactual Explanations for Contrastive Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37638)
*Van Bach Nguyen,Jörg Schlötterer,Christin Seifer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MACE，一种面向CLIP零样本分类的定向视觉反事实解释方法：通过自适应掩码（源自源归因或源-目标归因差异）结合潜在扩散修复与冻结CLIP引导，在四个数据集上实现高效定向修改，但有效性（反事实成功率）与源图保真度之间存在权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CLIP等对比视觉-语言模型的可解释方法多停留在识别重要区域，未回答"如何修改输入以获得目标预测"这一关键问题。定向视觉反事实方法能够给出具体可执行的修改方案，但此前主要针对普通分类模型，缺乏针对CLIP零样本分类的定制方案。

Method: MACE（Mask-guided Adaptive Counterfactual Explanations）构造可编辑区域：或基于源归因（source attribution），或基于源-目标归因差异（source-target attribution difference）；掩码仅按需扩展直至达到指定目标类。随后用潜在扩散修复模型（latent diffusion inpainting）修改选定区域，冻结的CLIP同时提供修改引导，并将剩余图像内容锚定至原输入。

Result: 在ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets、CUB-200上评估：source-mask变体在四数据集上均取得最高目标top-1成功率；difference-mask变体产生最小的像素级与感知变化，并取得最佳真实感评分。两种变体在相近性与真实感上均优于使用相同生成骨干的Stable Diffusion-only基线。

Conclusion: 自适应掩码引导的编辑能生成有效的CLIP反事实解释。研究进一步揭示了反事实有效性（validity）与源图保持（preservation）之间存在权衡；不同掩码策略适用于不同需求场景。

Abstract: Current explanation methods for contrastive vision--language models such as CLIP mainly identify important regions without showing how to change the input in order to get a target prediction. We introduce \textbf{M}ask-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{C}ounterfactual \textbf{E}xplanations (\mace), a targeted visual counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. \mace constructs an editable region from either source attribution or source--target attribution differences and expands the mask only when needed to reach a specified target class. A latent diffusion inpainting model then modifies the selected region, while a frozen CLIP model provides modification guidance and anchors the remaining image content to the original input. We evaluate \mace on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. The source-mask variant achieves the highest target top-1 success rate across all four datasets, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest pixel-level and perceptual changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline using the same generative backbone. These results show that adaptive mask-guided editing produces effective CLIP counterfactuals. They further reveal a tradeoff between counterfactual validity and source-image preservation.

</details>


### [174] [Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38155)
*Hui Ren,Lei Fan,Henry Pao,Han Guo,Zeeshan Zia,Ying Chen,Alexander Schwing,Gang Hua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Grounded Entity Biographies（GEB）长视频记忆框架，通过跨片段对同一物理实体的视觉观察进行身份关联并构建可检索"传记"，在问答时结合传记与情景证据，在四个基准上优于既有记忆框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频问答需要将同一对象跨越数小时甚至数天的事件关联起来。但按时间顺序的描述与文本派生实体无法解决物理身份同一性问题：不同对象可能共享同一描述，而同一对象在不同事件中的观察却彼此割裂。因此仅检索相关事件并不能恢复问题所指向的特定实体的"传记"。

Method: GEB将跨片段中同一物理实例的视觉接地观察归组为可检索的"传记"，同时保留每个时刻的上下文。在问答阶段，传记与情景证据一同被检索，使模型能够借助记忆构建阶段建立的身份链接，沿着事件追踪某一实体。

Result: 在四个基准（含全天与整周录像）上，GEB在多项选择与开放式问答中均优于此前的记忆框架。在EgoLifeQA上达到72.0%准确率，比最佳已发表结果高4.4个百分点。消融实验显示，接地的身份关联与传记读取均有贡献，而仅靠额外描述无法完全弥补。

Conclusion: 显式建立跨片段的视觉身份关联并以此构建实体"传记"，比单纯依赖文本描述或事件检索更能支撑长视频中的实体级推理，是长视频记忆框架的有效设计方向。

Abstract: Answering questions about long videos often requires connecting events involving the same objects across hours or days. Chronological descriptions and text-derived entities can leave physical identity unresolved: different objects may share a description, while observations of the same object remain disconnected across events. Retrieving relevant events therefore does not necessarily recover the "biography" of the particular entity a question concerns. To address this, we introduce Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB), a long-video memory framework that groups visually grounded observations of the same physical instance across clips into retrievable biographies while preserving the context of each moment. During question answering, the biography is retrieved alongside episodic evidence, allowing the model to follow an entity through events using identity links established during memory construction. Evaluations across four benchmarks, including day-long and week-long recordings, demonstrate improvements over prior memory frameworks in both multiple-choice and open-ended question answering. On EgoLifeQA, GEB achieves 72.0% accuracy, 4.4 percentage points above the best published result. Ablations show that grounded identity association and biography reading both contribute to the gains, which additional descriptions alone do not fully recover.

</details>


### [175] [VoxelSage: Tool-Augmented 3D CT Analysis and Simulator-Shielded Sequential Resection Planning for Liver Tumors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37648)
*Binghong Qian,Xuanhe Liu,Yifan Xing,Wenjie Deng,Jian Wu,Haochao Ying*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多模态系统 VoxelSage，采用双端口架构将语言模型编排与图像计算分离，集成八项技能支持肝脏肿瘤分析与术前切除规划，仿真实验中手术时间与出血量均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术前肝脏肿瘤评估需要从同一三维 CT 体数据中完成分割、物理空间测量、视觉证据与切除规划，但现有工具通常将这些步骤割裂处理；语言模型又无法可靠地直接从 CT 中计算物理测量值，因此需要一个整合式工作流。

Method: 系统采用双端口架构：Port A 负责解析请求并选择技能，Port B 将技能作用于 CT 体数据与分割掩膜并返回结构化结果，物理测量保留在 Port B 以避免 LLM 直接计算导致数值捏造。内置八项技能覆盖定量分析、视觉证据生成、三维重建、分割细化与序贯切除规划，并支持用户自定义技能。序贯规划使用行为克隆神经排序器对候选切除目标排序，并由基于模拟器的 shield 按预设约束进行校验。

Result: 在 256 个未见过的模拟器场景中，相较于确定性基线，平均模拟时间由 34.274 min 降至 33.388 min（减少 0.886 min，2.59%），平均模拟出血量由 300.847 mL 降至 183.852 mL（减少 116.995 mL，38.89%）。

Conclusion: 结果证明了系统的集成性与模拟器层面的性能，但不代表临床有效性或安全性；公开实现已发布于指定 GitHub 仓库。

Abstract: Preoperative liver-tumor assessment requires segmentation, physical-space measurement, visual evidence, and resection planning from the same three-dimensional CT volume. Existing tools often handle these steps separately, while language models cannot reliably compute physical measurements from CT. To provide an integrated workflow, we present VoxelSage, a multi-modal system for two- and three-dimensional visualization, liver-tumor analysis, and preoperative resection planning. Its dual-port architecture separates language-model orchestration from image computation: Port A interprets requests and selects skills, while Port B applies them to CT volumes and segmentation masks and returns structured results. Keeping physical measurements in Port B prevents the LLM from computing them directly and reduces the risk of fabricated numerical results. Eight built-in skills support quantitative analysis, visual evidence generation, three-dimensional reconstruction, segmentation refinement, and sequential resection planning; user-defined skills can extend these functions. For sequence planning, a behavior-cloned neural ranker orders candidate resection targets, while a simulator-based shield checks them against predefined constraints. Across 256 unseen simulator scenes, this approach reduced mean simulated time from 34.274 to 33.388 min (0.886 min, 2.59%) and mean simulated blood loss from 300.847 to 183.852 mL (116.995 mL, 38.89%) relative to a deterministic baseline. These results demonstrate system integration and simulator-level performance, not clinical efficacy or safety. The public implementation is available at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage.

</details>


### [176] [Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38177)
*Jaewoo Jung,Hyeonseo Yu,Honggyu An,Jisang Han,Mungyeom Kim,Minkyeong Jeon,Heeseong Shin,Wonjun Moon,Federico Tombari,Daniel Barath,Marc Pollefeys,Seungryong Kim,Sunghwan Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Imagine3D-LLM，通过让 MLLM 学习用可学习摘要 token 重建紧凑 3D 高斯表示，再基于该表示作答，从而提升多视图 3D 空间推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视图 3D 世界推理对 MLLM 仍是难题：模型擅长单图理解，却难以跨视角整合证据形成一致的 3D 理解。已有方法或强化像素级跨视图对应，或融合 3D 几何基础模型特征，但与人类推理仍有明显差距。本文受人类空间推理启发——人类不依赖细粒度几何线索，而是粗识别跨视图共同物体、推断视角间相对几何、组装粗略 3D 布局。

Method: 在图像 token 后追加少量可学习摘要 token，将其解码为紧凑的 3D 高斯泼溅表示，并用光度重建损失监督；同时与标准下一 token 预测目标联合训练。仅摘要 token 接受直接重建监督。

Result: 虽只有摘要 token 受重建监督，该目标仍使 LLM 底层图像特征获得更强的跨帧对应，表明"学习重建"将 3D 感知信号传播到整个模型。Imagine3D-LLM 在多个空间推理与 3D 理解基准上持续优于先前方法。

Conclusion: 让模型"想象"场景，比直接告知其像素级几何更有效；学习组装紧凑 3D 表示可作为提升 MLLM 三维空间推理的有效范式。

Abstract: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a substantial gap to human reasoning persists. In this work, we revisit human spatial reasoning, which suggests that rather than relying on fine-grained geometry cues, humans roughly identify common objects across views, infer the relative geometry between viewpoints, and assemble a coarse 3D layout of the scene. Inspired by this process, we introduce Imagine3D-LLM, an MLLM that learns to assemble a similar compact 3D representation of the scene and conditions its answer on this representation. Concretely, we append a small set of learnable summary tokens after the image tokens, decode them into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation supervised by a photometric reconstruction loss, and train jointly with the standard next-token prediction objective. Notably, although only the summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, this objective also induces stronger cross-frame correspondence within the LLM's underlying image features, suggesting that learning to reconstruct propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the model. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple spatial reasoning and 3D understanding benchmarks, suggesting that imagining the scene can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.

</details>


### [177] [Exemplar2VQA: A Scalable Exemplar-Driven Visual Question Answering Generation Framework via Multi-Agent Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37655)
*Jiayu Ying,Qijian Tian,Ruijie Xu,Xinnan Zhu,Daoguo Dong,Jiachen Xu,Xin Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Exemplar2VQA：一种以样例驱动、多智能体编码的3D空间VQA数据合成框架，通过确定性几何代码执行规避LLM空间推理缺陷，仅用合成室内数据微调Qwen2.5-VL即可跨域显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM空间智能受限于复杂、可扩展3D问答数据稀缺；人工标注成本高，而直接用LLM合成QA对因其空间与几何计算能力不足而效果差。

Method: 提出Exemplar2VQA：在仿真环境中以多智能体编码方式，为协作智能体配备精心设计的几何工具库，用确定性代码执行替代LLM的空间推理；以多样化的静态、物体中心空间查询模板为样例，自动、无缝地扩展为大规模高保真合成数据集。

Result: 仅在Exemplar2VQA生成的合成室内数据上微调Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B），在多个基准上取得显著提升；效果不限于域内室内数据，还能稳健迁移到室外与混合场景基准。

Conclusion: Exemplar2VQA为弥合具身智能的仿真到现实差距提供了一种可扩展且有力的范式。

Abstract: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs' spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA

</details>


### [178] [Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37656)
*Bowen Yuan,Danny Wang,Ruihong Qiu,Zijian Wang,Zi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VTrace多模态token归因框架，通过追踪中间推理路径并跨模态校准，提升LVLM响应归因的忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有token归因方法主要针对纯文本语言模型，在复杂多模态场景下存在两大问题：一是图文联合归因会低估视觉证据，遮蔽支撑响应的图像区域；二是视觉证据可能经多条中间推理路径影响响应，而现有方法仅追踪有限子集，导致重要视觉贡献被低估。

Method: VTrace包含三部分：1）构建成对归因，突出token特有的贡献；2）以闭式形式聚合所有前向归因路径，兼顾直接与间接贡献；3）跨模态校准，利用由响应似然变化估计的模态贡献对图文归因分数重缩放，实现统一的输入token排序。

Result: 在六个视觉推理基准上与七种基线方法对比，VTrace展现出更优的归因忠实度。

Conclusion: 通过追踪完整推理路径并校准跨模态分数，VTrace有效解决了多模态归因中视觉证据被低估的问题，提升了LVLM响应的可解释性与归因忠实度。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the visual and textual evidence supporting the generated responses remains difficult to identify. Faithful token attribution explains an LVLM's response by assigning scores that rank image and prompt tokens by how much the model relies on them, such that removing higher-ranked tokens causes the likelihood of the generated response to drop more rapidly. However, existing token-attribution methods have been developed mainly for text-based language models, and our empirical study reveals two challenges when complex multimodal sources are involved. First, the joint image-text attribution can underrepresent visual evidence relative to text, obscuring the image regions supporting the response. Second, visual evidence may influence the generated response through multiple intermediate reasoning paths, while existing methods trace only a limited subset of these paths, causing important visual contributions to be underestimated. Motivated by these insights, we introduce VTrace, a multimodal token-attribution framework that traces input contributions through intermediate reasoning and calibrates attribution scores across modalities. VTrace constructs pairwise attributions that highlight token-specific contributions and aggregates all forward attribution paths in closed form to account for both direct and indirect contributions. Cross-modal calibration then rescales image and text attribution scores using modality contributions estimated from response-likelihood changes, enabling a unified ranking of input tokens. Evaluations against seven baselines across six visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the superior attribution faithfulness. Project page: https://vtrace-attribution.github.io/.

</details>


### [179] [Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37659)
*Adhemar de Senneville,Xavier Bou,Jérémy Anger,Rafael Grompone,Gabriele Facciolo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文在大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中发现了一个共享判别几何（SDG）：一个跨所有图像分类任务共享的低维空间，上下文图像在其中被压缩为线性可分的表示，用于后续分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于上下文学习（ICL）的工作多聚焦于归纳电路（induction circuit），即利用每个上下文标注样本的线性表示来分类未标注查询，但少有研究探讨这些线性表示最初是如何构建的。作者借助视觉模态相比文本更强的表达性，试图揭示上下文图像线性表示的形成机制。

Method: 1. 实证观察：在LVLMs中发现共享判别几何（SDG），即跨任务的低维共享空间，上下文图像被压缩为线性可分表示，且这是模型在早期层对视觉表示做降维的结果。2. 理论分析：证明线性自注意力可通过将上下文数据投影到其主成分上实现降维，每一层相当于朝该目标执行一步梯度下降。3. 实验验证：提供证据表明训练后的LVLMs通过类似机制在早期层降低视觉表示的维度。

Result: 发现LVLMs内部存在跨所有图像分类任务共享的低维SDG空间，上下文图像被压缩为线性可分表示；分析证明线性自注意力可执行向主成分投影的降维，每层对应一步梯度下降；实验证据表明训练后的LVLMs在早期层确实以类似机制降低视觉表示维度。

Conclusion: LVLMs的ICL中，上下文线性表示源于早期层的降维过程，该过程形成跨任务共享的判别几何空间，其机制可类比为线性自注意力逐步逼近主成分投影的梯度下降，为理解ICL中线性表示的构建提供了新视角。

Abstract: There has been significant work on understanding the In-Context Learning capabilities of Large Language Models, especially on the induction circuit. For a few-shot classification task, the induction circuit leverages linear representations of each labeled example in-context in order to classify an unlabeled query. However, few works focus on how those linear representations are built in the first place. Leveraging the expressivity of the vision modality compared to text, we uncover a Shared Discriminative Geometry (SDG) inside Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). It is a low-dimensional space, shared across all image classification tasks, in which in-context images are compressed into linearly separable representations later used to perform classification. We observe that this is the result of the model performing a dimensionality reduction of vision representations in early layers. In order to explain this phenomenon: (1) We show analytically that linear self-attention can perform a dimensionality reduction by projecting in-context data onto its principal components, with each layer implementing one gradient descent step toward this objective. (2) We provide evidence that trained LVLMs reduce the dimensionality of vision representations in early layers via a similar mechanism.

</details>


### [180] [Med-RADIO: Reducing All Medical Domains Into One via Multi-Teacher Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37682)
*Chu Zhang,Haoyu Jiang,Hongyuan Zhang,Hongbin Liu,Dong Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Med-RADIO 提出一种医学多教师蒸馏框架，将多个领域专家模型的能力压缩进统一的医学视觉基础模型，从而在多种模态上提升通用模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学基础模型存在两条路线：面向特定模态的专家模型与面向多模态的通用模型。通用模型相较自然图像通用模型数据规模不足，相较医学专家模型领域深度不够。经验上，通用模型提供跨模态性能基线，专家模型定义各自领域上限，因此需要将基线提升至上限。

Method: 提出 Med-RADIO 多教师蒸馏框架，将多领域专家知识"归并为一体"。具体包括：筛选通用与专家教师；分配与模态对齐的蒸馏流，重组通用预训练数据以匹配专家领域；采用平衡损失，防止单一教师主导蒸馏过程。

Result: 在涵盖五种模态的内部与外部分类基准上，Med-RADIO 在线性探测下优于强医学通用模型，并在多数评估模态上与代表性专家模型保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过多教师蒸馏整合互补的领域专家知识，可将医学通用基础模型的跨模态性能基线有效提升，兼顾多模态通用性与领域专业性。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of large-scale medical datasets and computational resources has driven significant progress in medical foundation models. Given the inherent heterogeneity of medical imaging modalities, current research mainly follows two paths: specialized models optimized for specific modalities, and generalist models designed to handle multiple modalities. However, medical generalist models suffer from both insufficient training data scale relative to natural image generalists and inadequate domain-specific depth relative to medical specialists. Empirically, generalist models establish a cross-modality performance baseline, while specialists define the performance ceiling within their respective domains. To elevate this baseline toward these ceilings, we propose Med-RADIO, a medical multi-teacher distillation framework that Reduces All Domains Into One by compressing complementary expertise from multiple domain-specific teachers into a unified medical vision foundation model. Our method curates both generalist and specialist teachers, allocates modality-aligned distillation streams to reorganize generalist pretraining data so it matches specialist domains, and uses a balanced loss to prevent any single teacher from dominating the distillation process. On internal and external classification benchmarks spanning five modalities, Med-RADIO improves over strong medical generalists under linear probing and remains competitive with representative specialists on most evaluated modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIR-HKISI/Med-RADIO.

</details>


### [181] [PAIQ: Patch-Aligned Semantic Injection via Residual Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37685)
*Pinze Ren,Yuwei Zhang,Hao Chen,Linghao Meng,Chang Li,Qiankun Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PAIQ 是一种即插即用的 patch 对齐语义注入框架：以冻结的 DINOv3 patch 特征为空间基底，通过跨编码器内容匹配聚合 SigLIP 语义特征，并用共享正交变换注入残差，在仅训练投影与融合参数、保持 196 个视觉 token 的约束下提升了多模态大模型的事实正确性并降低幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言对齐编码器（如 SigLIP）擅长语义抽象，自监督编码器（如 DINOv3）擅长空间细节，二者具有互补性。但融合互补信息时需在丰富局部特征的同时，避免语义相近 patch 之间的可区分性被破坏，即需解决"语义聚合"与"patch 可分性"之间的权衡。

Method: PAIQ 以 DINOv3 patch 特征为空间基底，通过联合源分配实现基于内容的跨编码器匹配，聚合互补的 SigLIP 特征；再用共享正交变换 Q 注入"聚合—基底"的差异作为残差更新。该旋转在保持残差范数与成对夹角的前提下自适应更新方向。作者对固定投影特征推导了相似语义聚合下的 patch 可分性条件，并证明当聚合共享时，旋转相较直接插值会增加一个非负的分离项。训练仅涉及投影与融合参数，两个视觉编码器与语言模型均冻结，融合后仍保留 196 个视觉 token。

Result: 在多种语言骨干网络上，PAIQ 在图像描述与视觉问答任务中相较单编码器接口在评判型正确性上取得普遍提升，并降低幻觉严重程度。在 2B 与 9B Qwen 骨干上，该紧凑接口平均比最强的融合或 token 压缩基线高出约 2.9 个正确性点。

Conclusion: 通过正交约束的残差式跨编码器语义注入，可在不增加视觉 token 数与不微调编码器/语言模型的前提下有效融合语义抽象与空间细节，兼顾 patch 可分性并带来稳定的正确性收益与幻觉缓解。

Abstract: Language-aligned and self-supervised visual encoders offer complementary strengths in semantic abstraction and spatial detail. Harnessing this complementarity requires enriching local features while retaining distinctions between semantically related patches. We introduce PAIQ, a patch-aligned semantic injection framework that combines content-based cross-encoder matching with orthogonally constrained residual updates. Using DINOv3 patch features as the spatial base, PAIQ aggregates complementary SigLIP features through joint source allocation and injects the aggregate--base differences through a shared orthogonal transformation Q. This rotation adapts update directions while preserving residual norms and pairwise angles. For fixed projected features, we derive conditions for patch separability under similar semantic aggregates and show that rotation adds a nonnegative separation term over direct interpolation when the aggregate is shared. Only the projection and fusion parameters are trained; both visual encoders and the language model remain frozen, and fusion retains 196 visual tokens. Across diverse language backbones, PAIQ yields broad gains in judge-assessed correctness and reductions in hallucination severity over single-encoder interfaces on image description and visual question answering. On the 2B and 9B Qwen backbones, this compact interface outperforms the strongest evaluated fusion or token-compression baselines by about 2.9 correctness points on average.

</details>


### [182] [Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37690)
*Jack Wei Lun Shi,Kaichen Zhou,Haoyu Chen,Yufeng Weng,Keane Ong,Ruojin Cai,Hang Hua,Justin K. W. Yeoh,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Honeycomb视频世界模型及其核心HexMemory——一种固定大小的低秩空间记忆，用六个空间/时空平面存储场景特征，实现恒定存储开销下的长时程视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间记忆系统累积RGB观测或潜特征，存储需求随生成过程不断增长，难以支撑长时程视频生成中的场景一致性。

Method: HexMemory以六个空间与时空平面构成的低秩固定尺寸记忆表示场景特征；前馈writer将最新生成的视频块映射为平面特征，随空间覆盖或时间范围扩展时通过warp保持平面维度，并以置信度加权池化和学习残差校正融合新特征；reader从HexMemory检索潜特征以条件化后续生成。writer仅处理最新块观测，避免逐场景优化和历史重复处理。

Result: 在WorldScore和RealEstate10K上展现出强视频生成质量，并在重访已观测区域时保持稳健一致性，同时在整个生成过程中维持恒定的特征存储需求。

Conclusion: Honeycomb通过固定尺寸的低秩HexMemory记忆机制，实现了常量存储下的持久场景记忆，为长时程视频世界模型提供了一种高效且一致的解决方案。

Abstract: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memory systems accumulate RGB observations or latent features, causing storage requirements to grow as generation proceeds. We introduce **Honeycomb**, a video world model built on **HexMemory**, a compact low-rank representation that stores scene features in a fixed-size memory comprising six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each newly generated video chunk to plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, HexMemory warps the existing planes while preserving their dimensions, then integrates new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latent features from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. Because the writer processes only observations from the latest chunk, Honeycomb avoids per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full generation history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust consistency when revisiting previously observed regions, while maintaining constant feature-storage requirements throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/.

</details>
